verses.decoded: The LORD is my strength and protection; I trusted him and was helped. So my heart is filled with joy, and I will praise him with songs.

verses.kjv: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
verses.decoded: The LORD is their strength and the source of salvation for his chosen one.

verses.kjv: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
verses.decoded: Save your people and bless those who belong to you; care for them and support them forever.

verses.kjv: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.decoded: Give to the LORD, you powerful ones, give the LORD glory and strength.

verses.kjv: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
verses.decoded: Give the LORD the honor that belongs to His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of holiness.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.
verses.decoded: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the glorious God thunders; the LORD is over the vast waters.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
verses.decoded: The voice of the LORD is mighty; the voice of the LORD is majestic.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.decoded: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; yes, the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.kjv: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
verses.decoded: He makes them leap like a young calf; Lebanon and Sirion (Mount Hermon) like young wild oxen.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
verses.decoded: The voice of the LORD splits the flames of fire.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.decoded: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.kjv: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
verses.decoded: The voice of the LORD causes the deer to give birth and reveals the forests; and in His temple, everyone proclaims His glory.

verses.kjv: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.
verses.decoded: The LORD rules over the floodwaters; yes, the LORD reigns as King forever.

verses.kjv: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
verses.decoded: The LORD will give strength to His people; the LORD will bless His people with peace.

verses.kjv: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.decoded: I will praise you, LORD, because you have helped me and have not let my enemies celebrate my defeat.

verses.kjv: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
verses.decoded: LORD my God, I called out to you, and you healed me.

verses.kjv: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.decoded: LORD, you saved me from death and kept me alive so I would not descend into the grave.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.decoded: Sing to the LORD, all his faithful people, and give thanks as you remember how holy he is.

verses.kjv: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
verses.decoded: His anger lasts only a short time, but his favor brings life. We may cry and be sad at night, but joy comes with the morning.

verses.kjv: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
verses.decoded: When I was doing well, I thought I would never be shaken.

verses.kjv: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
verses.decoded: LORD, because of your kindness, you made me strong like a mountain. But when you turned away, I was deeply troubled.

verses.kjv: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.
verses.decoded: I called out to you, LORD, and begged for your help.

verses.kjv: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
verses.decoded: What good is my life if I die and go to the grave? Can the dead praise you or tell others about your faithfulness?

verses.kjv: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.
verses.decoded: Listen to me, LORD, have mercy on me, and be my helper.

verses.kjv: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.decoded: You changed my sadness into joy; you took away my mourning clothes and dressed me in happiness.

verses.kjv: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
verses.decoded: So that I may praise you with my whole being and never be silent. LORD my God, I will thank you forever.

verses.kjv: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
verses.decoded: Lord, I trust in you; don’t let me be put to shame. Save me because of your faithful justice.

verses.kjv: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
verses.decoded: Listen to me and rescue me quickly. Be my strong rock and a safe place where I can find protection.

verses.kjv: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.
verses.decoded: You are my solid rock and my fortress. Because of your reputation, lead me and show me the way.

verses.kjv: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
verses.decoded: Rescue me from the trap they secretly set for me, because you are my strength.

verses.kjv: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.
verses.decoded: I entrust my life into your hands; you have saved me, Lord, God of truth.

verses.kjv: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.
verses.decoded: I hate those who worship worthless lies, but I trust in the Lord.

verses.kjv: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
verses.decoded: I will be joyful and celebrate your mercy because you have noticed my suffering and understood my troubles.

verses.kjv: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
verses.decoded: You have not handed me over to my enemies; instead, you have given me freedom and safety.

verses.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
verses.decoded: Lord, have mercy on me because I am in deep trouble; my eyes are worn out from crying, and my soul and body suffer.

verses.kjv: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
verses.decoded: My life is filled with sorrow, and my years pass with sighs. My strength fails because of my sins, and my body wastes away.

verses.kjv: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
verses.decoded: I have become a disgrace to all my enemies, especially to my neighbors. Even people I know are afraid of me and avoid me.

verses.kjv: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.decoded: I am forgotten like someone who is dead and gone; I am like a shattered pot.

verses.kjv: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.decoded: I have heard many people speak evil about me, and fear surrounds me. They have planned together to kill me.

verses.kjv: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.
verses.decoded: But I trusted in you, Lord, and declared, You are my God.

verses.kjv: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.decoded: My life is in your hands; save me from my enemies and those who chase me.

verses.kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.
verses.decoded: Let your face shine on your servant; save me because of your unfailing love.

verses.kjv: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
verses.decoded: Do not let me be put to shame, Lord, because I have called on you. But let the wicked be ashamed and remain silent in death.

verses.kjv: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.decoded: Silence the lying lips that speak arrogantly and cruelly against those who live right.

verses.kjv: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
verses.decoded: How great is your goodness, which you have stored up for those who fear you, and done for those who trust you, in the sight of all people!

verses.kjv: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.decoded: You will keep them safe in your presence, hidden from the proud and protected from gossip and conflict.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
verses.decoded: Praise the Lord! He has shown me his wonderful kindness while I was in a secure place.

verses.kjv: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
verses.decoded: In my panic, I thought I was forgotten by you, but you heard my prayers when I called out.

verses.kjv: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
verses.decoded: Love the Lord, all his faithful people, because he protects those who are loyal and punishes those who do wrong.

verses.kjv: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
verses.decoded: Be strong and courageous; those who trust in the Lord will have their hearts strengthened.

verses.kjv: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.decoded: Happy is the person whose wrongdoing is forgiven and whose sin is hidden.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.decoded: Happy is the person whom the LORD does not count as guilty and who is honest in heart.

verses.kjv: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
verses.decoded: When I stayed silent, my body wasted away because I groaned all day long.

verses.kjv: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
verses.decoded: Because your hand was heavy on me day and night, my strength dried up like a summer drought. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.decoded: I admitted my sin to you and did not hide my guilt. I said, 'I will confess my sins to the LORD,' and you forgave me. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
verses.decoded: Because of this, all who live right will pray to you when you can be found; even in overwhelming troubles, they will be safe and not swept away.

verses.kjv: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.decoded: You are my refuge; you protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of rescue. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
verses.decoded: I will guide and teach you the right path; I will watch over you closely.

verses.kjv: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
verses.decoded: Don’t be stubborn like horses or mules that lack understanding and need to be controlled with a bit and bridle.

verses.kjv: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.
verses.decoded: The wicked will face many troubles, but those who trust in the LORD will be surrounded by mercy.

verses.kjv: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
verses.decoded: Be happy and rejoice in the LORD, all you who live right and have sincere hearts.

verses.kjv: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
verses.decoded: Celebrate the Lord, you who live right; praising Him is fitting for those who are honest.

verses.kjv: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
verses.decoded: Praise the Lord with the harp; sing to Him with the psaltery and a ten-stringed instrument.

verses.kjv: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
verses.decoded: Sing a new song to Him; play skillfully and loudly.

verses.kjv: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.
verses.decoded: The Lord’s word is perfect, and everything He does is done with truth.

verses.kjv: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
verses.decoded: He loves justice and fairness; the earth is filled with the Lord’s faithful love.

verses.kjv: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.decoded: The heavens were created by the Lord’s command, and all their stars by the breath of His mouth.

verses.kjv: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
verses.decoded: He gathers the seas into one place and stores the deep waters in his hidden reservoirs.

verses.kjv: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.decoded: Let everyone on earth respect the Lord; let all people everywhere stand in awe of Him.

verses.kjv: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.decoded: He spoke, and it happened; He commanded, and it stood firm.

verses.kjv: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
verses.decoded: The Lord frustrates the plans of the nations and makes the people’s schemes useless.

verses.kjv: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.decoded: The Lord’s plans last forever; the intentions of His heart endure through all generations.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.decoded: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, the people He has chosen as His special possession.

verses.kjv: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
verses.decoded: The Lord watches from heaven and sees all people on earth.

verses.kjv: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.decoded: From His dwelling place, He observes everyone living on the earth.

verses.kjv: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
verses.decoded: He shapes every heart the same way and carefully watches all their actions.

verses.kjv: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
verses.decoded: No king is saved just because he has a large army; no strong warrior is rescued simply by his great power.

verses.kjv: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
verses.decoded: Relying on horses for safety is useless; their great strength cannot save anyone.

verses.kjv: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
verses.decoded: Look, the LORD watches over those who respect Him and trust in His unfailing love.

verses.kjv: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.decoded: He rescues their lives from death and keeps them alive even during famine.

verses.kjv: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.
verses.decoded: We put our hope in the LORD; He is our helper and our protector.

verses.kjv: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.decoded: Our hearts will be glad because we trust in His holy name.

verses.kjv: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
verses.decoded: Lord, let Your mercy be with us just as we are putting our hope in You.

verses.kjv: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.decoded: A Psalm of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who then sent him away. I will always praise the LORD; his praise will always be on my lips.

verses.kjv: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
verses.decoded: I will proudly praise the LORD; the humble will hear this and be joyful.

verses.kjv: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.decoded: Come, let’s praise the LORD together and lift up his name.

verses.kjv: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.decoded: I asked the LORD for help, and he listened and saved me from all my fears.

verses.kjv: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
verses.decoded: Those who look to him are filled with joy; their faces show no shame.

verses.kjv: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.decoded: The needy person cried out, and the LORD heard and rescued him from all his troubles.

verses.kjv: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
verses.decoded: The angel of the LORD surrounds and protects those who respect him, saving them.

verses.kjv: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
verses.decoded: Try and experience for yourself how good the LORD is; blessed are those who trust him.

verses.kjv: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
verses.decoded: Respect the LORD, all his holy people, because those who fear him lack nothing.

verses.kjv: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
verses.decoded: Young lions may go hungry, but those who seek the LORD will have everything they need.

verses.kjv: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Listen to me, children; I will teach you how to respect the LORD.

verses.kjv: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?
verses.decoded: Who wants to live a good life and enjoy many days of happiness?

verses.kjv: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.decoded: Avoid speaking evil or telling lies with your words.

verses.kjv: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.decoded: Turn away from evil, do what is right, and actively seek peace.

verses.kjv: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
verses.decoded: The LORD watches over those who do right and listens when they call out to him.

verses.kjv: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.decoded: God opposes those who do evil and will erase their memory from the earth.

verses.kjv: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
verses.decoded: When the righteous call out, God listens and rescues them from all their problems.

verses.kjv: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.decoded: The Lord is close to those who are brokenhearted and saves those who are truly humble.

verses.kjv: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
verses.decoded: The righteous face many troubles, but God rescues them from every one.

verses.kjv: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
verses.decoded: God protects the righteous completely; not even one of their bones will be broken.

verses.kjv: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
verses.decoded: Evil will destroy the wicked, and those who hate the righteous will be left in ruin.

verses.kjv: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
verses.decoded: The Lord rescues the lives of his servants, and those who trust in Him will never be abandoned.

verses.kjv: Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
verses.decoded: O LORD, defend me against those who oppose me; fight against those who fight against me.

verses.kjv: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
verses.decoded: Take up your shield and protection, and come to my aid.

verses.kjv: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
verses.decoded: Draw your spear and block the path of those who pursue me; tell my soul, 'I am your salvation.'

verses.kjv: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
verses.decoded: May those who try to harm me be confused and ashamed; may their plans fail and they be embarrassed.

verses.kjv: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.
verses.decoded: May they be like chaff blown away by the wind, and may the angel of the LORD pursue them.

verses.kjv: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
verses.decoded: May their path be dark and slippery, and may the angel of the LORD chase them.

verses.kjv: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
verses.decoded: They have secretly set a trap for me without any reason, digging a pit to catch my life.

verses.kjv: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
verses.decoded: May disaster suddenly strike him; may the trap he set catch him, and may he fall into his own destruction.

verses.kjv: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.decoded: But I will be joyful in the LORD and celebrate his saving help.

verses.kjv: All my bones shall say, LORD, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
verses.decoded: Every part of me will say, 'LORD, who is like you? You rescue the poor and needy from those stronger than them.

verses.kjv: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
verses.decoded: False witnesses stood against me, accusing me of things I didn’t know about.

verses.kjv: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
verses.decoded: They repaid me evil for the good I did, trying to destroy my life.

verses.kjv: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
verses.decoded: When they were suffering, I wore sackcloth and humbled myself by fasting; my prayers stayed within me.

verses.kjv: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
verses.decoded: I treated them like friends or brothers, grieving deeply as one mourns a mother.

verses.kjv: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
verses.decoded: But when I was in trouble, they celebrated and gathered against me without my knowledge; they attacked me relentlessly.

verses.kjv: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
verses.decoded: At celebrations, those who pretend to be friendly mocked me and showed their anger like wild animals.

verses.kjv: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
verses.decoded: Lord, how long will you just watch? Save me from their attacks, protect my precious life from danger.

verses.kjv: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
verses.decoded: I will thank you publicly among a large crowd; I will praise you in front of many people.

verses.kjv: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
verses.decoded: May my enemies not falsely celebrate my downfall, nor secretly signal each other with hate for no reason.

verses.kjv: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
verses.decoded: They do not wish for peace; instead, they plot lies against those who live peacefully.

verses.kjv: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
verses.decoded: They openly mocked me, saying, 'Ha! Ha! We have seen this happen!'

verses.kjv: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
verses.decoded: Lord, you have seen all this; don’t stay silent. Please don’t be far away from me.

verses.kjv: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.decoded: Wake up and act on my behalf; defend my case, my God and Lord.

verses.kjv: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
verses.decoded: Judge me fairly, Lord my God, and don’t let my enemies celebrate my defeat.

verses.kjv: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
verses.decoded: May they not secretly say, 'This is exactly what we wanted,' or boast, 'We have destroyed him.'

verses.kjv: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
verses.decoded: May those who celebrate my pain be embarrassed and confused; may those who boast against me be covered with shame and disgrace.

verses.kjv: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
verses.decoded: Let those who support my just cause rejoice and be glad; let them always say, 'Praise the LORD, who delights in the success of his servant.'

verses.kjv: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
verses.decoded: My words will tell of your justice and praise all day long.

verses.kjv: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.decoded: The sin of the wicked tells me deep inside that they have no respect or reverence for God.

verses.kjv: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
verses.decoded: They deceive themselves and feel confident until their sin becomes so obvious that it is hated.

verses.kjv: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
verses.decoded: What they say is full of sin and lies; they have stopped being wise and doing what is right.

verses.kjv: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.
verses.decoded: They plan evil even while resting; they choose a harmful path and do not hate wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.decoded: Your mercy, Lord, is as vast as the heavens, and your faithfulness extends as high as the clouds.

verses.kjv: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.
verses.decoded: Your righteousness is like mighty mountains, and your judgments are like a deep ocean; Lord, you protect both people and animals.

verses.kjv: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
verses.decoded: Your loving kindness is wonderful, God! That’s why people find safety and trust in your protection.

verses.kjv: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
verses.decoded: They will be fully satisfied with the richness of your presence, and you will give them joy like a flowing river.

verses.kjv: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
verses.decoded: You are the source of life; in your light, we see true understanding and clarity.

verses.kjv: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.decoded: Please keep showing your loving kindness to those who know you and your righteousness to those who are honest and sincere.

verses.kjv: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
verses.decoded: Don’t let pride attack me or allow evil people to harm me.

verses.kjv: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.decoded: The evil doers have fallen; they are defeated and will not be able to get back up.

verses.kjv: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
verses.decoded: Don't worry or get upset because of those who do evil, and don't be jealous of those who do wrong.

verses.kjv: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
verses.decoded: They will soon be destroyed like grass that is cut down and withers away.

verses.kjv: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
verses.decoded: Put your trust in the Lord and do what is right; then you will live safely in the land and be provided for.

verses.kjv: Delight thyself also in the LORD: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
verses.decoded: Find joy in the Lord, and He will give you what your heart truly wants.

verses.kjv: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.decoded: Give your plans and life over to the Lord, trust Him, and He will make it happen.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
verses.decoded: God will make your goodness shine clearly like daylight and your decisions as obvious as noon.

verses.kjv: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verses.decoded: Be calm and patient, trusting the Lord; don’t be upset because someone who does wrong is succeeding.

verses.kjv: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
verses.decoded: Stop being angry and give up your rage; don’t let yourself be upset enough to do wrong.

verses.kjv: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
verses.decoded: Those who do evil will be destroyed, but those who patiently trust the Lord will receive the earth as their inheritance.

verses.kjv: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
verses.decoded: Soon the wicked will be gone; you will look for them, but they will no longer be there.

verses.kjv: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.decoded: But those who are humble will inherit the earth and enjoy great peace.

verses.kjv: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.decoded: The wicked plan harm against the righteous and show their anger like a fierce animal baring its teeth.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
verses.decoded: But the Lord will laugh at the wicked because He knows their time of judgment is near.

verses.kjv: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
verses.decoded: The wicked have prepared weapons to attack the poor and helpless and to kill those who live honestly.

verses.kjv: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.decoded: But their own weapons will harm them, and their strength will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
verses.decoded: What a righteous person has, even if little, is better than the vast wealth of many wicked people.

verses.kjv: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
verses.decoded: The power of the wicked will be destroyed, but God supports those who are righteous.

verses.kjv: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.decoded: God watches over the lives of those who live rightly, and their blessings will last forever.

verses.kjv: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.decoded: They won’t be humiliated during hard times, and even in famine, they will have enough to eat.

verses.kjv: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
verses.decoded: But the wicked will be destroyed; those who oppose God will vanish like fat burning away in smoke.

verses.kjv: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
verses.decoded: The wicked borrow money but never repay it, while the righteous are compassionate and generous.

verses.kjv: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.decoded: Those whom God blesses will inherit the land, but those He curses will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
verses.decoded: God directs the path of a good person, and He takes pleasure in their journey.

verses.kjv: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
verses.decoded: Even if he stumbles, he won’t be completely defeated because God supports him.

verses.kjv: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
verses.decoded: I have lived a long time and have never seen a righteous person or their children left without help or food.

verses.kjv: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
verses.decoded: The righteous are always kind and willing to help others, and their children are blessed.

verses.kjv: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.decoded: Turn away from evil, do what is right, and you will live forever.

verses.kjv: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.decoded: God loves fairness and never abandons His faithful ones; they are kept safe forever, but the descendants of the wicked will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
verses.decoded: The righteous will receive the land as their inheritance and live there forever.

verses.kjv: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
verses.decoded: A righteous person speaks wisely and talks about doing what is right.

verses.kjv: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
verses.decoded: God's law is written in his heart; he will not stumble or fall.

verses.kjv: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
verses.decoded: The wicked watch the righteous closely and try to harm them.

verses.kjv: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.decoded: But the LORD will not allow the wicked to succeed or condemn the righteous when they are judged.

verses.kjv: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
verses.decoded: Be patient and trust the LORD; follow His path, and He will honor you by giving you the land. You will see the wicked destroyed.

verses.kjv: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
verses.decoded: I have seen the wicked become powerful and flourish like a healthy green tree.

verses.kjv: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.decoded: But then he disappeared and was gone; I looked for him, but he could not be found.

verses.kjv: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
verses.decoded: Observe the blameless and the honest, because their final outcome is peace.

verses.kjv: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.decoded: But those who sin will be destroyed together; the wicked will come to an end.

verses.kjv: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.decoded: The LORD is the source of salvation for the righteous; He is their strength when they face difficulties.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
verses.decoded: The LORD will help and rescue them; He will save them from the wicked because they trust in Him.

verses.kjv: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.decoded: Lord, please do not punish me in your anger or discipline me when you are very upset.

verses.kjv: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
verses.decoded: Your arrows pierce me deeply, and your hand weighs heavily on me.

verses.kjv: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
verses.decoded: My body is weak and unhealthy because of your anger; my bones have no peace because of my sins.

verses.kjv: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.decoded: My sins are overwhelming me like a heavy burden that I cannot carry.

verses.kjv: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
verses.decoded: My wounds are infected and foul because of my foolish mistakes.

verses.kjv: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.decoded: I am deeply distressed and bent over with sorrow; I grieve all day long.

verses.kjv: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.decoded: My lower body is afflicted with a terrible disease; my whole body is unhealthy.

verses.kjv: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
verses.decoded: I am weak and badly hurt; I cry out because my heart is full of turmoil.

verses.kjv: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
verses.decoded: Lord, you know everything I want and my sighs are not hidden from you.

verses.kjv: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.decoded: My heart is racing, my strength is gone, and even the sparkle in my eyes has disappeared.

verses.kjv: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.decoded: Those who once loved me and my friends stay away from my suffering; even my relatives keep their distance.

verses.kjv: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
verses.decoded: Those who want to harm me set traps; those who wish me evil spread lies and plan tricks all day.

verses.kjv: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
verses.decoded: But I did not listen, like a deaf person; I remained silent, like someone who cannot speak.

verses.kjv: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.decoded: I acted like someone who does not hear and does not reply with complaints or accusations.

verses.kjv: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
verses.decoded: But I trust in you, Lord; I believe you will listen to me, my God.

verses.kjv: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
verses.decoded: I said, 'Listen to me,' so that they would not celebrate my downfall; when I stumble, they become proud and attack me.

verses.kjv: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
verses.decoded: I am about to stumble, and my sadness is always with me.

verses.kjv: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.decoded: I will admit my wrongdoing and feel deep regret for my sins.

verses.kjv: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
verses.decoded: But my enemies are active and powerful; those who hate me without cause are many.

verses.kjv: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
verses.decoded: Those who repay kindness with evil are my enemies because I try to do what is right.

verses.kjv: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
verses.decoded: Do not abandon me, Lord; my God, please stay close to me.

verses.kjv: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
verses.decoded: Hurry to help me, Lord, my Savior.

verses.kjv: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
verses.decoded: I decided to be careful about how I live so I wouldn't sin by what I say. I would control my speech like holding a bridle on a horse, especially when wicked people are around me.

verses.kjv: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
verses.decoded: I stayed silent and kept quiet even when I wanted to say something good, but deep inside, my sadness grew.

verses.kjv: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
verses.decoded: My heart was burning inside me as I thought deeply, and then I spoke out with my words.

verses.kjv: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: that I may know how frail I am.
verses.decoded: Lord, help me understand how short my life will be and how limited my time is, so I can realize how fragile I am.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
verses.decoded: You have made my life very short, like a small handbreadth, and my time on earth means nothing to you. Truly, even when people are at their best, they are completely meaningless. Pause and think about this.

verses.kjv: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
verses.decoded: Everyone lives like a shadow or an illusion; they worry for no real reason. People gather wealth but don’t know who will inherit it.

verses.kjv: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
verses.decoded: So now, Lord, what am I waiting for? My hope is in you.

verses.kjv: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
verses.decoded: Save me from all my sins and don’t let me become a disgrace among foolish people.

verses.kjv: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
verses.decoded: I stayed silent and didn’t say anything because you were the one who caused it.

verses.kjv: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
verses.decoded: Please take away your punishment from me; I am worn out by the pain from your hand.

verses.kjv: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
verses.decoded: When you correct people for their sins, their strength and beauty fade away like a moth eating through cloth. Truly, everyone is meaningless. Pause and think about this.

verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
verses.decoded: Listen to my prayer, Lord, and pay attention to my cry. Don’t ignore my tears, because I am a stranger here, just like my ancestors were.

verses.kjv: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
verses.decoded: Please be merciful and let me regain my strength before I die and disappear forever.

verses.kjv: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verses.decoded: I waited patiently for the LORD, and He listened to me and heard my prayer.

verses.kjv: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
verses.decoded: He lifted me out of a terrible pit, out of the muddy clay, and set my feet on solid ground, making my steps secure.

verses.kjv: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
verses.decoded: He has given me a new song to sing, a song of praise to our God. Many will see this, be afraid, and put their trust in the LORD.

verses.kjv: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
verses.decoded: Blessed is the person who trusts in the LORD and does not follow the proud or those who turn away to falsehood.

verses.kjv: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
verses.decoded: LORD my God, You have done many wonderful things, and Your plans for us are beyond counting. If I tried to tell about them all, they would be too many to number.

verses.kjv: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
verses.decoded: You do not want sacrifices and offerings; You have opened my ears. You do not require burnt offerings or sin offerings.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
verses.decoded: Then I said, 'Here I am; I have come. It is written about me in the scroll.'

verses.kjv: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.
verses.decoded: I take pleasure in doing Your will, O my God; Your law is deep within my heart.

verses.kjv: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.
verses.decoded: I have proclaimed righteousness to the large assembly; I have not held back my words, LORD, You know this.

verses.kjv: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
verses.decoded: I have not kept Your righteousness to myself; I have told about Your faithfulness and salvation. I have not hidden Your love and truth from the large assembly.

verses.kjv: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
verses.decoded: Do not withhold Your mercy from me, LORD; let Your love and faithfulness always protect me.

verses.kjv: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
verses.decoded: Countless troubles surround me; my sins have overwhelmed me so much that I cannot even look up. They are more than the hairs on my head, and my heart is faint.

verses.kjv: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.
verses.decoded: LORD, please be willing to rescue me; LORD, hurry to help me.

verses.kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
verses.decoded: May those who try to harm me be ashamed and confused; may those who want to hurt me be turned back and disgraced.

verses.kjv: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
verses.decoded: May those who mock me with 'Aha! Aha!' be left in ruin as a punishment for their shame.

verses.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
verses.decoded: May everyone who looks to you be filled with joy and gladness; may those who love your saving help always say, 'The LORD is great!'

verses.kjv: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
verses.decoded: I am poor and in need, but the Lord remembers me; you are my helper and rescuer—do not delay, my God.

verses.kjv: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
verses.decoded: Happy is the one who cares about the poor; the Lord will rescue him when trouble comes.

verses.kjv: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
verses.decoded: The Lord will protect him and keep him alive; he will be blessed in this life, and you will not allow his enemies to harm him.

verses.kjv: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
verses.decoded: The Lord will give him strength even when he is sick in bed; you will care for him during his illness.

verses.kjv: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
verses.decoded: I said, Lord, have mercy on me; heal my inner self because I have sinned against you.

verses.kjv: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
verses.decoded: My enemies say bad things about me, asking, 'When will he die? When will his name be forgotten?'

verses.kjv: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
verses.decoded: Even when he visits me, he says empty words; his heart collects evil plans, and when he leaves, he spreads them around.

verses.kjv: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
verses.decoded: Everyone who hates me talks secretly against me; they plan to harm me.

verses.kjv: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
verses.decoded: They say, 'A terrible disease has stuck to him; now that he is lying down, he will never get up again.'

verses.kjv: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.decoded: Even my close friend, whom I trusted and shared meals with, has turned against me.

verses.kjv: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
verses.decoded: But Lord, be merciful to me and lift me up so I can repay them.

verses.kjv: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
verses.decoded: I know you favor me because my enemies have not won against me.

verses.kjv: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
verses.decoded: You support me because I am innocent, and you keep me in your presence forever.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
verses.decoded: Praise the Lord God of Israel forever and ever. Amen and Amen.

verses.kjv: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
verses.decoded: Just as a deer longs for streams of water, my soul longs for you, God.

verses.kjv: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
verses.decoded: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When will I be able to come and stand before Him?

verses.kjv: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
verses.decoded: I have been crying day and night, while people keep asking me, 'Where is your God?'

verses.kjv: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
verses.decoded: When I think about these things, I pour out my feelings because I used to go with the crowd to God's house, singing joyfully with those celebrating a festival.

verses.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
verses.decoded: Why are you so sad, my soul? Why are you so disturbed inside me? Put your hope in God, because I will still praise Him for the help He gives me.

verses.kjv: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
verses.decoded: My soul is deeply troubled, God, but I will remember you even from distant places like the land of Jordan, the Hermon region, and Mount Mizar.

verses.kjv: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
verses.decoded: One deep calls to another deep because of the roaring of your waterfalls; all your waves and breakers have swept over me.

verses.kjv: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.
verses.decoded: But during the day, the LORD shows His unfailing love, and at night, I sing to Him and pray to the God who gives me life.

verses.kjv: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.decoded: I ask God, my rock, 'Why have you forgotten me? Why do I keep feeling sad because my enemies oppress me?'

verses.kjv: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?
verses.decoded: My enemies insult me like a sword piercing my bones, and every day they ask me, 'Where is your God?'

verses.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
verses.decoded: Why are you so sad, my soul? Why are you so disturbed inside me? Put your hope in God, because I will still praise Him, who gives me strength and is my God.

verses.kjv: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
verses.decoded: God, please judge me and defend my case against a cruel and unmerciful nation. Rescue me from those who are dishonest and unfair.

verses.kjv: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.decoded: You are the source of my strength; why have you abandoned me? Why do I continue to grieve because my enemies oppress me?

verses.kjv: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
verses.decoded: Please send your light and truth to guide me; lead me to your sacred mountain and your dwelling place.

verses.kjv: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
verses.decoded: Then I will go to God's altar, the source of my great joy, and praise you with music, O my God.

verses.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
verses.decoded: Why are you so discouraged, my soul? Why are you so upset inside me? Put your hope in God, because I will still praise him—he is the source of my strength and my God.

verses.kjv: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
verses.decoded: God, we have heard with our own ears; our ancestors have told us about the mighty things you did in their time, long ago.

verses.kjv: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
verses.decoded: You drove out the nations with your power and settled your people in their place; you crushed other peoples and removed them.

verses.kjv: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
verses.decoded: They did not take the land by their own strength or sword; it was your powerful hand, your strength, and your favor that gave them victory.

verses.kjv: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
verses.decoded: You are my King, God; please lead Jacob to victory and rescue.

verses.kjv: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
verses.decoded: With your help, we will defeat our enemies; by your name, we will crush those who oppose us.

verses.kjv: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
verses.decoded: I will not rely on my bow or sword to save me.

verses.kjv: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
verses.decoded: But you have saved us from our enemies and made those who hate us ashamed.

verses.kjv: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
verses.decoded: We proudly trust in God all day and praise your name forever. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
verses.decoded: But now you have rejected us and brought us shame; you do not go with our armies anymore.

verses.kjv: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
verses.decoded: You make us retreat from our enemies, and those who hate us take what belongs to us.

verses.kjv: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
verses.decoded: You have made us like sheep to be slaughtered and scattered us among the nations.

verses.kjv: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
verses.decoded: You sell your people for nothing and do not gain anything from their loss.

verses.kjv: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
verses.decoded: You have made us a disgrace to our neighbors, a laughingstock to those around us.

verses.kjv: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
verses.decoded: You have made us a proverb among the nations, a subject of mockery and shaking heads.

verses.kjv: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
verses.decoded: I am constantly filled with shame, and my face is covered with disgrace.

verses.kjv: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
verses.decoded: Because of the enemy and avenger, we hear the insults and blasphemies of those who mock us.

verses.kjv: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
verses.decoded: All these troubles have come upon us, but we have not forgotten you, nor have we broken our agreement with you.

verses.kjv: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
verses.decoded: Our hearts have not turned away, and our actions have not strayed from your path.

verses.kjv: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.decoded: Even though you have severely crushed us in a dangerous place and surrounded us with death’s shadow.

verses.kjv: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
verses.decoded: If we have forgotten the name of our God or reached out to worship other gods;

verses.kjv: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
verses.decoded: Wouldn’t God investigate this? He knows the secrets of every heart.

verses.kjv: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.decoded: Yes, we are being killed all day long because of you; we are like sheep being led to the slaughter.

verses.kjv: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
verses.decoded: Wake up, Lord! Why do you sleep? Rise up and don’t reject us forever.

verses.kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
verses.decoded: Why do you hide your face and forget our suffering and oppression?

verses.kjv: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
verses.decoded: Our souls are crushed to the ground; our strength is gone.

verses.kjv: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.
verses.decoded: Rise up to help us and rescue us because of your unfailing love.

verses.kjv: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.decoded: My heart is full of a good message; I am speaking about the things I have prepared concerning the king. My words flow like a skilled writer's pen.

verses.kjv: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
verses.decoded: You are more handsome than any man; kindness flows from your lips. Because of this, God has blessed you forever.

verses.kjv: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
verses.decoded: Belt your sword around your waist, mighty one, dressed in glory and majesty.

verses.kjv: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
verses.decoded: Ride in your majesty, prospering because of truth, humility, and justice; your strong hand will show you awesome power.

verses.kjv: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.
verses.decoded: Your arrows are sharp against the king’s enemies; with them, you defeat nations.

verses.kjv: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
verses.decoded: Your throne, O God, will last forever; your kingdom’s rule is just and right.

verses.kjv: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.decoded: You love justice and hate evil; so God, your God, has anointed you with joy more than anyone else.

verses.kjv: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
verses.decoded: All your clothes smell of myrrh, aloes, and cassia, coming from ivory palaces, making you joyful.

verses.kjv: Kings’ daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.decoded: Daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, dressed in Ophir gold.

verses.kjv: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;
verses.decoded: Listen carefully, daughter; pay attention and forget your own people and your father’s family.

verses.kjv: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.
verses.decoded: Then the king will deeply desire your beauty, for he is your lord; worship him.

verses.kjv: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
verses.decoded: The daughter of Tyre will come with gifts, and the wealthy will seek your favor.

verses.kjv: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
verses.decoded: The king’s daughter is radiant inside; her clothes are made of finely worked gold.

verses.kjv: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
verses.decoded: She will be brought to the king wearing beautifully embroidered clothes; her virgin companions will also be brought to you.

verses.kjv: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.
verses.decoded: They will be brought with joy and celebration into the king’s palace.

verses.kjv: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
verses.decoded: Your children will succeed you, and you can appoint them as leaders throughout the world.

verses.kjv: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: I will ensure your name is remembered forever, so people will praise you through all generations.

verses.kjv: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.decoded: God is our safe place and our strength, always ready to help us when we are in trouble.

verses.kjv: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.decoded: So we will not be afraid, even if the earth shakes or the mountains fall into the sea.

verses.kjv: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
verses.decoded: Even if the waters roar and become turbulent, and the mountains shake because of the waves. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
verses.decoded: There is a river whose streams bring joy to God's city, the sacred home of the Most High.

verses.kjv: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
verses.decoded: God is present in the city; it will not be shaken. God will help it quickly, at the break of dawn.

verses.kjv: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
verses.decoded: Nations were angry and kingdoms shook, but when God spoke, the earth melted.

verses.kjv: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.decoded: The Lord of heavenly armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our safe place. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
verses.decoded: Come and see what the Lord has done, the destruction He has brought on the earth.

verses.kjv: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
verses.decoded: He ends wars everywhere; he breaks bows, cuts spears in two, and burns chariots with fire.

verses.kjv: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.decoded: Be calm and recognize that I am God; I will be honored among all nations and throughout the earth.

verses.kjv: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.decoded: The Lord of heavenly armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our safe place. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
verses.decoded: Everyone, clap your hands and shout to God with joyful praise.

verses.kjv: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
verses.decoded: The LORD Almighty is awe-inspiring and powerful; He is the supreme King over the whole world.

verses.kjv: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
verses.decoded: He will bring other peoples under our control and place nations beneath our authority.

verses.kjv: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.decoded: He will give us our special inheritance, the best part of Jacob’s land, whom He loves. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.decoded: God has ascended with a shout; the LORD with the blast of a trumpet.

verses.kjv: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
verses.decoded: Sing joyful songs to God; sing praises to our King; keep singing praises.

verses.kjv: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
verses.decoded: God is the King over the entire earth; praise Him wisely and with understanding.

verses.kjv: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
verses.decoded: God rules over all nations; He sits on His holy throne.

verses.kjv: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.
verses.decoded: The leaders of the nations assemble, along with the people of Abraham’s God; for God owns the shields of the earth and is highly exalted.

verses.kjv: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
verses.decoded: The LORD is great and deserves highest praise in the city of our God, on His holy mountain.

verses.kjv: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.decoded: Mount Zion is beautifully located and brings joy to the whole earth; it is the city of the great King, situated on the northern side.

verses.kjv: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
verses.decoded: God is recognized in her palaces as a place of safety and protection.

verses.kjv: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
verses.decoded: Look, the kings gathered and marched together.

verses.kjv: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
verses.decoded: When they saw it, they were amazed, frightened, and quickly retreated.

verses.kjv: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.decoded: Fear gripped them there, causing pain like the agony of a woman giving birth.

verses.kjv: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
verses.decoded: You shatter the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

verses.kjv: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
verses.decoded: Just as we heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD Almighty, our God’s city: God will keep it secure forever. Pause and think about that.

verses.kjv: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
verses.decoded: We remember your faithful love, O God, right in your temple.

verses.kjv: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.decoded: Your praise reaches to the ends of the earth, O God, just as your name is great; your right hand is full of justice.

verses.kjv: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
verses.decoded: Let Mount Zion be glad, and let the people of Judah rejoice because of your fair decisions.

verses.kjv: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
verses.decoded: Walk around Zion, go all around it, and report on its towers.

verses.kjv: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.
verses.decoded: Pay close attention to her defenses and examine her palaces so you can tell future generations about them.

verses.kjv: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
verses.decoded: For this God is our God forever and ever; He will lead us even to death.

verses.kjv: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
verses.decoded: Listen carefully, everyone everywhere on earth.

verses.kjv: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
verses.decoded: This message is for everyone—both the humble and the powerful, the rich and the poor alike.

verses.kjv: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
verses.decoded: I will speak words of wisdom and think deeply about understanding.

verses.kjv: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
verses.decoded: I will listen carefully to a wise saying and explain its meaning through music.

verses.kjv: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
verses.decoded: Why should I be afraid during hard times when trouble surrounds me?

verses.kjv: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
verses.decoded: Some people put their confidence in their money and brag about how rich they are.

verses.kjv: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
verses.decoded: But no one can pay a price to save a loved one or offer a ransom to God for them.

verses.kjv: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
verses.decoded: Because the cost to save a soul is too great and impossible to pay.

verses.kjv: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.
verses.decoded: No one lives forever or escapes decay after death.

verses.kjv: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
verses.decoded: He knows that both wise and foolish people die, leaving their riches to others.

verses.kjv: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
verses.decoded: They think their homes and lands will last forever, and they name their property after themselves.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.
verses.decoded: But even honored people do not last; they are like animals that die.

verses.kjv: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
verses.decoded: This attitude is foolish, yet their descendants agree with their thinking. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
verses.decoded: Like sheep, they are buried in the grave where death consumes them; the righteous will rule over them, and their strength fades away in the grave.

verses.kjv: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
verses.decoded: But God will rescue my soul from death’s power; He will welcome me. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
verses.decoded: Don't be afraid when someone becomes wealthy and their home grows impressive;

verses.kjv: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
verses.decoded: Because when they die, they take nothing with them; their wealth and honor do not follow them.

verses.kjv: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
verses.decoded: Even though during his life he enjoyed his wealth and people praise you when you prosper yourself,

verses.kjv: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
verses.decoded: He will join his ancestors in death and will never see the light again.

verses.kjv: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.
verses.decoded: A person who is respected but lacks understanding is like animals that perish.

verses.kjv: The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
verses.decoded: A Psalm by Asaph. The powerful God, the LORD himself, has spoken and summoned the whole earth from sunrise to sunset.

verses.kjv: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
verses.decoded: God shines forth from Zion, the most beautiful place.

verses.kjv: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
verses.decoded: Our God is coming and will not remain silent; fire will consume everything before Him, and a powerful storm will surround Him.

verses.kjv: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
verses.decoded: He will call out to the heavens above and the earth below to judge His people.

verses.kjv: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
verses.decoded: Gather my faithful followers who have made a promise to me through their sacrifices.

verses.kjv: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.
verses.decoded: The heavens will proclaim His justice because God Himself is the judge. Pause and reflect.
