verses.kjv: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.
verses.decoded: Listen, my people, I am speaking; Israel, I am giving testimony against you. I am God, your God.

verses.kjv: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
verses.decoded: I am not criticizing you for your sacrifices or burnt offerings that you have regularly brought before me.

verses.kjv: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.
verses.decoded: I do not need bulls from your house or goats from your pens.

verses.kjv: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
verses.decoded: All the animals in the forest and all the cattle on a thousand hills belong to me.

verses.kjv: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.
verses.decoded: I know every bird in the mountains, and the wild animals in the fields belong to me.

verses.kjv: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
verses.decoded: If I were hungry, I wouldn’t tell you, because the whole world and everything in it belongs to me.

verses.kjv: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.decoded: Do you think I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?

verses.kjv: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
verses.decoded: Instead, offer God your thanks and fulfill your promises to the Most High.

verses.kjv: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
verses.decoded: Call on me when you are in trouble, and I will rescue you, so you can honor me.

verses.kjv: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
verses.decoded: But to the wicked, God says, Why do you talk about my laws and claim my covenant with your mouth?

verses.kjv: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and casteth my words behind thee.
verses.decoded: You hate my teachings and reject my words.

verses.kjv: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
verses.decoded: When you saw a thief, you agreed with him and joined yourself with adulterers.

verses.kjv: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
verses.decoded: You speak evil and use your tongue to lie.

verses.kjv: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.
verses.decoded: You sit and speak against your own brother; you slander your own family member.

verses.kjv: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
verses.decoded: You have done all these things, and I remained silent; you thought I was just like you. But now I will correct you and make you see clearly what you have done.

verses.kjv: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
verses.decoded: Think about this, you who forget God, or I will destroy you completely, and no one will be able to save you.

verses.kjv: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.
verses.decoded: Whoever offers praise honors me; and to the person who lives rightly, I will reveal God's salvation.

verses.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
verses.decoded: God, please be merciful to me because of your great love. Because you are so kind and compassionate, erase all my sins.

verses.kjv: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.decoded: Cleanse me completely from my wrongdoing and purify me from my sin.

verses.kjv: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
verses.decoded: I admit my sins; I am always aware of my wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
verses.decoded: I have sinned against you alone and done what is wrong in your eyes, so that you are right when you judge me and fair when you pass judgment.

verses.kjv: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
verses.decoded: I was born sinful; my mother conceived me already guilty.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
verses.decoded: You want honesty deep inside me; teach me wisdom in my innermost being.

verses.kjv: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.decoded: Cleanse me completely, and I will be pure; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

verses.kjv: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
verses.decoded: Let me hear joy and happiness again, so that the broken parts of me can be glad.

verses.kjv: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
verses.decoded: Turn away from my sins and erase all my wrongdoings.

verses.kjv: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.decoded: God, make my heart pure and create a steady, willing spirit within me.

verses.kjv: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
verses.decoded: Don’t reject me or remove your Holy Spirit from me.

verses.kjv: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
verses.decoded: Bring back the joy of your salvation to me and support me with your generous Spirit.

verses.kjv: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
verses.decoded: Then I will teach sinners your ways, and they will turn back to you.

verses.kjv: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
verses.decoded: Save me from guilt over shedding blood, God, my Savior, and I will praise your righteousness loudly.

verses.kjv: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
verses.decoded: Lord, open my lips so I can declare your praise.

verses.kjv: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
verses.decoded: You do not want sacrifices; otherwise, I would offer them. You do not take pleasure in burnt offerings.

verses.kjv: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
verses.decoded: The sacrifices God wants are a broken spirit and a humble, repentant heart; God will not reject these.

verses.kjv: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Please do good to Zion as you desire; rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
verses.decoded: Then you will be pleased with righteous sacrifices, with burnt offerings and whole burnt offerings; then people will offer bulls on your altar.

verses.kjv: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.
verses.decoded: Why do you proudly plan evil, mighty man? God's kindness lasts forever.

verses.kjv: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.decoded: Your words create harm; like a sharp razor, they work deceitfully.

verses.kjv: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
verses.decoded: You prefer evil over good and lies instead of truth. Pause and think about that.

verses.kjv: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
verses.decoded: You enjoy speaking destructive lies, you deceitful tongue.

verses.kjv: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
verses.decoded: God will destroy you completely; He will remove you from your home and uproot you from the land of the living. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
verses.decoded: The righteous will see this, be afraid, and then laugh at you.

verses.kjv: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
verses.decoded: Look, this is the person who did not rely on God but trusted in his wealth and grew strong through evil.

verses.kjv: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: But I am like a healthy olive tree in God's house; I trust in God's mercy forever.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.
verses.decoded: I will praise you forever because you have acted; I will wait on your name because it is good to your faithful people.

verses.kjv: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.
verses.decoded: The fool has declared in his heart, 'There is no God.' They are corrupt and have committed terrible sins; no one does what is good.

verses.kjv: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
verses.decoded: God looked down from heaven at all people to see if anyone truly understands and seeks Him.

verses.kjv: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.decoded: Everyone has turned away; they have all become corrupt. No one does good, not even one.

verses.kjv: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
verses.decoded: Do those who do evil have no understanding? They destroy my people as easily as eating bread, and they have not called on God.

verses.kjv: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.
verses.decoded: They were terrified in places where there was no real danger, because God has scattered the bones of those who attacked you. You have shamed them because God has rejected them.

verses.kjv: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.decoded: May salvation for Israel come from Zion! When God restores His people from captivity, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad.

verses.kjv: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
verses.decoded: God, save me by your powerful name and defend me with your mighty strength.

verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.decoded: Listen to my prayer, God; pay attention to what I am saying.

verses.kjv: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
verses.decoded: Enemies have risen against me, and cruel people are trying to kill me; they do not respect God. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
verses.decoded: Look, God is my helper; the Lord supports those who keep me alive.

verses.kjv: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
verses.decoded: He will repay my enemies for their evil; destroy them according to your faithful justice.

verses.kjv: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.
verses.decoded: I will offer sacrifices gladly and praise your name, Lord, because you are good.

verses.kjv: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
verses.decoded: He has rescued me from every trouble, and I have seen him deal with my enemies as he wishes.

verses.kjv: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
verses.decoded: God, please listen to my prayer and don’t ignore my request for help.

verses.kjv: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
verses.decoded: Pay attention to me and listen: I am deeply troubled and crying out.

verses.kjv: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
verses.decoded: Because of the enemy’s threats and the cruelty of the wicked who accuse me falsely and hate me with anger.

verses.kjv: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
verses.decoded: My heart is deeply hurting inside me, and I am overwhelmed by the fear of death.

verses.kjv: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
verses.decoded: I am filled with fear and shaking, and horror has taken over me.

verses.kjv: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
verses.decoded: I wish I had wings like a dove so I could fly away and find peace.

verses.kjv: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
verses.decoded: I would escape far away and live alone in the wilderness. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
verses.decoded: I would quickly run away from the violent storm and chaos around me.

verses.kjv: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.decoded: Lord, confuse and stop their speech because I see violence and conflict in the city.

verses.kjv: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
verses.decoded: Day and night they cause trouble around the city walls; evil and sadness are everywhere inside.

verses.kjv: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
verses.decoded: Wickedness is everywhere; lies and trickery never leave the streets.

verses.kjv: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
verses.decoded: It wasn’t an enemy who insulted me—that I could have accepted. It wasn’t a hater who acted proudly against me—I could have avoided him.

verses.kjv: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
verses.decoded: But it was you—someone like me, my companion and friend.

verses.kjv: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.
verses.decoded: We shared pleasant advice and went together to worship God.

verses.kjv: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
verses.decoded: May death take them quickly and send them down to the grave, because their homes are full of evil.

verses.kjv: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
verses.decoded: I will pray to God, and the Lord will rescue me.

verses.kjv: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
verses.decoded: I will pray and cry out to Him evening, morning, and noon, and He will listen to me.

verses.kjv: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
verses.decoded: He has peacefully saved me from the fight against me, even though many were attacking me.

verses.kjv: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
verses.decoded: God will listen and punish them—He who has existed forever. Pause and think. Because they do not change, they do not fear God.

verses.kjv: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
verses.decoded: He has attacked those who trusted him and broken his promises.

verses.kjv: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
verses.decoded: His words were smoother than butter, but he was full of conflict inside; his speech was gentle like oil, but it was really like sharp swords.

verses.kjv: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.decoded: Give your worries to the Lord, and He will support you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.

verses.kjv: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
verses.decoded: But God, You will bring down violent and deceitful people; they won’t live long, but I will put my trust in You.

verses.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
verses.decoded: Have mercy on me, God, because people are trying to destroy me; they attack me every day.

verses.kjv: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
verses.decoded: My enemies want to destroy me every day because many are fighting against me, O Most High God.

verses.kjv: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
verses.decoded: Whenever I am afraid, I will trust in you.

verses.kjv: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
verses.decoded: I will praise God’s promises; I trust in God and will not fear what people can do to me.

verses.kjv: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.decoded: Every day they twist my words; all their plans are to harm me.

verses.kjv: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
verses.decoded: They come together secretly and watch my every move, waiting to kill me.

verses.kjv: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.
verses.decoded: Will they get away with their sins? In your anger, bring them down, O God.

verses.kjv: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
verses.decoded: You keep track of where I go; you collect my tears in your bottle—aren’t they recorded in your book?

verses.kjv: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.
verses.decoded: When I call to you, my enemies will retreat; I know this because God is on my side.

verses.kjv: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.
verses.decoded: I will praise God’s promises; I will praise the LORD’s word.

verses.kjv: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
verses.decoded: I trust in God and will not fear what anyone can do to me.

verses.kjv: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
verses.decoded: I have made promises to you, O God, and I will give you thanks.

verses.kjv: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
verses.decoded: You have saved me from death; will you not keep me from falling so I can live and walk in God’s presence?

verses.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
verses.decoded: Be kind to me, God, be kind to me, because I trust in you. I will find safety under your protection until these troubles have passed.

verses.kjv: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.
verses.decoded: I will call out to the Most High God, the one who works everything out for me.

verses.kjv: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
verses.decoded: He will send help from heaven and rescue me from those who want to destroy me. Pause and think about this. God will show his mercy and faithfulness.

verses.kjv: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.decoded: I am surrounded by fierce enemies like lions; I am among people whose teeth are like spears and arrows, and whose words are like sharp swords.

verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.decoded: God, be lifted high above the heavens; let your glory be greater than all the earth.

verses.kjv: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
verses.decoded: My enemies have set traps to catch me; I am weighed down with sorrow. But they have fallen into the very traps they set. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
verses.decoded: My heart is steady, God, my heart is steady; I will sing and praise you.

verses.kjv: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.decoded: Wake up, my soul; wake up, lyre and harp! I will rise early to praise you.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
verses.decoded: I will praise you, Lord, among the people; I will sing to you among the nations.

verses.kjv: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
verses.decoded: Your mercy reaches to the heavens, and your faithfulness extends to the skies.

verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.decoded: God, be lifted high above the heavens; let your glory be greater than all the earth.

verses.kjv: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
verses.decoded: Do you really speak what is right, you people? Do you judge fairly, you sons of men?

verses.kjv: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.decoded: No, in your hearts you do evil; you measure out violence with your hands on the earth.

verses.kjv: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
verses.decoded: The wicked are corrupt from birth; they go wrong as soon as they are born, telling lies.

verses.kjv: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;
verses.decoded: Their poison is like that of a snake; they are like a deaf snake that refuses to listen.

verses.kjv: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
verses.decoded: It will not listen to the voice of the skilled charmer, no matter how clever the charm.

verses.kjv: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
verses.decoded: God, break their teeth in their mouths; Lord, smash the powerful teeth of young lions.

verses.kjv: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
verses.decoded: Let them disappear like flowing water; when you aim your bow to shoot, may they be cut down.

verses.kjv: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
verses.decoded: Let each of them vanish like a melting snail, like a miscarriage that never sees the light of day.

verses.kjv: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
verses.decoded: Before your cooking pots can feel the thorns, he will sweep them away in a storm, alive and full of anger.

verses.kjv: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.decoded: The righteous will be glad when they see justice done; they will cleanse themselves in the defeat of the wicked.

verses.kjv: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
verses.decoded: Then people will say, 'Surely the righteous are rewarded; truly God judges the earth.'

verses.kjv: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
verses.decoded: God, save me from my enemies; protect me from those who are attacking me.

verses.kjv: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
verses.decoded: Rescue me from those who do evil and save me from violent men.

verses.kjv: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
verses.decoded: Look, they are lying in wait to kill me; powerful enemies have gathered against me, even though I have done nothing wrong, Lord.

verses.kjv: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
verses.decoded: They rush to attack me without cause; please wake up and help me, and watch over me.

verses.kjv: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
verses.decoded: So rise up, Lord God of armies, God of Israel; punish all the nations; show no mercy to wicked sinners. Pause and think about this.

verses.kjv: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.decoded: They come back at night, barking like dogs as they circle the city.

verses.kjv: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?
verses.decoded: Look, they speak arrogantly and threaten with their words like swords, asking, 'Who will listen to us?'

verses.kjv: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
verses.decoded: But you, Lord, will laugh at them and mock all the nations.

verses.kjv: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.
verses.decoded: Because of your power, I will wait for you; God is my protection.

verses.kjv: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
verses.decoded: The God who shows me mercy will protect me; he will let me see my enemies defeated.

verses.kjv: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.decoded: Don't kill them completely, or my people might forget; instead, scatter them with your power and bring them down, Lord, my protector.

verses.kjv: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.decoded: Because of their sinful words and proud speech, and for the curses and lies they tell, let them be caught in their own traps.

verses.kjv: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.decoded: Destroy them in your anger completely so they cease to exist; let them know that God rules over Israel and the whole earth. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.decoded: Let them come back at night, barking like dogs as they roam the city.

verses.kjv: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
verses.decoded: Let them roam around searching for food, growling if they don't find enough.

verses.kjv: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.decoded: I will sing about your strength; yes, I will loudly praise your kindness every morning because you have been my protector and safe place during difficult times.

verses.kjv: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.
verses.decoded: I will sing to you, my strength, because God is my protector and the source of my kindness.

verses.kjv: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
verses.decoded: God, you have rejected us and caused us to be scattered because you are angry; please turn back to us.

verses.kjv: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
verses.decoded: You caused the land to shake and break; please heal its cracks because it is shaking.

verses.kjv: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
verses.decoded: You have brought hardship on your people and made us experience overwhelming distress.

verses.kjv: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.decoded: You have given a flag to those who respect you, so it can be raised in honor of your faithfulness. Pause and think about that.

verses.kjv: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
verses.decoded: Save your chosen ones by your powerful right hand, and listen to my prayer.

verses.kjv: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.decoded: God has declared in his holy presence: I will celebrate by dividing Shechem and assigning the valley of Succoth.

verses.kjv: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
verses.decoded: Gilead and Manasseh belong to me; Ephraim is the power of my leadership; Judah is the one who guides my law.

verses.kjv: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
verses.decoded: Moab is like my basin for washing; I will throw my shoe over Edom as a sign of conquest; Philistia, celebrate because of what I have done.

verses.kjv: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.decoded: Who will lead me into the fortified city? Who will guide me into Edom?

verses.kjv: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
verses.decoded: Won't you, God, who rejected us before, now come with us? Won't you, God, who did not go with our armies, help us now?

verses.kjv: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.decoded: Help us in our distress, because human help is useless.

verses.kjv: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.decoded: With God's help, we will be strong and defeat our enemies.

verses.kjv: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
verses.decoded: God, listen to my desperate call; pay attention to my prayer.

verses.kjv: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.decoded: Even from the farthest place, when I feel overwhelmed, I will call to you; guide me to a safe, strong place beyond my reach.

verses.kjv: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.decoded: You have been my protection and a strong fortress against my enemies.

verses.kjv: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
verses.decoded: I will live in your presence forever; I will find safety under your care. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
verses.decoded: God, you have listened to my promises and granted me the blessings given to those who respect you.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.
verses.decoded: You will extend the king’s life, giving him many years, like generations upon generations.

verses.kjv: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
verses.decoded: He will live in God’s presence forever; please provide mercy and faithfulness to protect him.

verses.kjv: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
verses.decoded: I will praise your name forever and fulfill my promises every day.

verses.kjv: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
verses.decoded: My soul truly waits quietly for God; my salvation comes from Him alone.

verses.kjv: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.decoded: He alone is my strong foundation and my savior; He is my protection, so I will not be shaken.

verses.kjv: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
verses.decoded: How long will you plot evil against a person? You will all be destroyed, like a leaning wall or a fence about to collapse.

verses.kjv: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
verses.decoded: They plan only to bring him down from his honored position; they enjoy deceit. They say kind words but curse secretly. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
verses.decoded: My soul, wait quietly and only for God, because my hope comes from Him.

verses.kjv: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
verses.decoded: He alone is my strong foundation and my savior; He is my protection, so I will not be shaken.

verses.kjv: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
verses.decoded: My salvation and honor come from God; He is my strong rock and my safe refuge.

verses.kjv: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.decoded: Trust Him always, all of you; openly share your feelings with Him. God is our safe place. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
verses.decoded: People of low status are meaningless, and those of high status are false; weighed together, they are all lighter than nothing.

verses.kjv: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
verses.decoded: Don’t trust in wrongdoing or become proud from stealing; even if your wealth grows, don’t put your heart into it.

verses.kjv: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.
verses.decoded: God has spoken once, and I have heard it twice: power belongs to God alone.

verses.kjv: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
verses.decoded: Lord, mercy belongs to You too, because You reward each person according to what they have done.

verses.kjv: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verses.decoded: God, you are my God; I will seek you early in the morning. My soul thirsts for you, my body longs for you in a dry and thirsty land where there is no water.

verses.kjv: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: I want to see your power and glory, just as I have seen you in your holy place.

verses.kjv: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
verses.decoded: Because your faithful love is better than life itself, my lips will praise you.

verses.kjv: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
verses.decoded: I will bless you as long as I live; I will lift up my hands and praise your name.

verses.kjv: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
verses.decoded: My soul will be satisfied like one enjoying rich, nourishing food; my mouth will praise you with joyful lips.

verses.kjv: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
verses.decoded: When I think of you while lying in bed and meditate on you during the quiet hours of the night.

verses.kjv: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
verses.decoded: Because you have helped me, I will rejoice under the protection of your wings.

verses.kjv: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
verses.decoded: My soul eagerly pursues you; your right hand holds me up and supports me.

verses.kjv: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.decoded: But those who try to kill me will be sent down to the depths of the earth.

verses.kjv: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.decoded: They will fall by the sword and become food for foxes.

verses.kjv: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.decoded: But the king will find joy in God; everyone who promises by him will take pride, while liars will be silenced.

verses.kjv: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.decoded: God, listen to my prayer and protect me from being afraid of my enemies.

verses.kjv: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
verses.decoded: Keep me safe from the secret plans of evil people and from those who plot wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
verses.decoded: They sharpen their words like swords and aim their bitter insults like arrows.

verses.kjv: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.decoded: They secretly attack innocent people suddenly and without fear.

verses.kjv: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
verses.decoded: They plan evil together and secretly set traps, thinking no one will notice.

verses.kjv: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
verses.decoded: They carefully investigate every evil thought and deep intention in people's hearts.

verses.kjv: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
verses.decoded: But God will strike them suddenly and wound them like an arrow.

verses.kjv: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
verses.decoded: Their own words will bring them down, and everyone who sees this will run away in fear.

verses.kjv: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
verses.decoded: Everyone will fear God and speak about what He has done, understanding His wisdom.

verses.kjv: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.decoded: Those who are righteous will rejoice in the Lord, trust Him, and take pride in their sincere hearts.

verses.kjv: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.decoded: God, praise is ready for you in Zion; people will fulfill their promises to you.

verses.kjv: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
verses.decoded: You hear prayers; everyone will come to you.

verses.kjv: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
verses.decoded: Sin overwhelms me, but you will forgive our wrongdoings.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
verses.decoded: Happy is the person you choose to come near and live in your presence; we will be filled with the blessings of your holy temple.

verses.kjv: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
verses.decoded: You respond to us with awesome acts of justice, God who saves us, the hope of everyone everywhere, even those far away across the sea.

verses.kjv: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
verses.decoded: You use your strength to secure the mountains, dressed in power.

verses.kjv: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
verses.decoded: You calm the roaring seas, the crashing waves, and the chaos of the nations.

verses.kjv: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.decoded: Even those living in the farthest places are in awe of your signs; you make the sunrise and sunset joyful.

verses.kjv: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
verses.decoded: You care for the earth and water it; you richly supply it with the river of God, full of water; you prepare the grain after providing rain.

verses.kjv: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
verses.decoded: You water the hills generously, smooth the furrows, soften the ground with rain, and bless the new growth.

verses.kjv: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
verses.decoded: You crown the year with your blessings, and your ways drip with abundance.

verses.kjv: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.decoded: Your blessings fall on the desert pastures, and the small hills are filled with joy all around.

verses.kjv: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.decoded: The fields are covered with sheep, the valleys are full of grain; they shout and sing for joy.

verses.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
verses.decoded: Shout with joy to God, all the earth!

verses.kjv: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
verses.decoded: Sing praises to honor his name; make his praise glorious.

verses.kjv: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
verses.decoded: Tell God, 'How awesome are your deeds!' Because of your great power, your enemies will submit to you.

verses.kjv: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
verses.decoded: All the earth will worship you and sing to you; they will sing your name. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
verses.decoded: Come and witness the amazing works of God; he is awesome in what he has done for humanity.

verses.kjv: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
verses.decoded: He made the sea dry land, so they crossed the flood on foot; there we rejoiced in him.

verses.kjv: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.decoded: He rules with power forever; he watches all nations. Do not let the rebellious become proud. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
verses.decoded: All you people, praise our God and let your voices be heard in his praise.

verses.kjv: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
verses.decoded: He keeps our lives safe and does not let our feet slip.

verses.kjv: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
verses.decoded: God, you have tested us and refined us like silver is purified.

verses.kjv: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
verses.decoded: You trapped us and placed hardships on us.

verses.kjv: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
verses.decoded: You let enemies oppress us; we passed through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.

verses.kjv: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
verses.decoded: I will enter your house with burnt offerings and fulfill my promises to you.

verses.kjv: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
verses.decoded: These are the promises I spoke aloud when I was in trouble.

verses.kjv: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
verses.decoded: I will offer you burnt sacrifices of fattened animals, with the smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
verses.decoded: Come and listen, all of you who respect God, and I will tell you what He has done for me.

verses.kjv: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
verses.decoded: I called out to Him with my voice, and I praised Him with my words.

verses.kjv: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
verses.decoded: If I hold sin in my heart, the Lord will not listen to me.

verses.kjv: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.decoded: But truly, God has listened to me; He has paid attention to my prayer.

verses.kjv: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
verses.decoded: Praise be to God, who has not rejected my prayer or taken His mercy away from me.

verses.kjv: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
verses.decoded: May God be kind to us and bless us; may He show us His favor and kindness. Pause and think about that.

verses.kjv: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
verses.decoded: So that your way of life and salvation will be known everywhere on earth, among all nations.

verses.kjv: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.decoded: May everyone praise you, O God; may all people give you praise.

verses.kjv: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
verses.decoded: May the nations be happy and sing with joy because you judge people fairly and lead the nations on earth. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.decoded: May everyone praise you, O God; may all people give you praise.

verses.kjv: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.
verses.decoded: Then the earth will produce its crops, and God—our own God—will bless us.

verses.kjv: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.decoded: God will bless us, and people everywhere will respect and honor Him.

verses.kjv: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
verses.decoded: Let God stand up and cause His enemies to run away; let those who hate Him flee from His presence.

verses.kjv: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.decoded: Just as smoke is blown away and wax melts before fire, let the wicked disappear when God is present.

verses.kjv: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
verses.decoded: But let the righteous be happy and celebrate before God; let them be filled with great joy.

verses.kjv: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
verses.decoded: Sing to God and praise His name; praise the one who rides the skies, called JAH, and be joyful before Him.

verses.kjv: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
verses.decoded: God is a father to those without fathers and a judge who defends widows, dwelling in His holy place.

verses.kjv: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
verses.decoded: God places lonely people into families; He frees those who are imprisoned, but those who rebel live in barren places.

verses.kjv: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
verses.decoded: O God, when You led Your people and marched ahead through the wilderness; pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.decoded: The earth trembled and the skies poured down when God appeared; even Mount Sinai shook before the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
verses.decoded: You, God, sent heavy rain to refresh and secure Your land when it was tired and dry.

verses.kjv: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
verses.decoded: Your people have lived there, and You, God, have provided good things for the poor.

verses.kjv: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
verses.decoded: The Lord gave the message, and a large group of people spread it.

verses.kjv: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
verses.decoded: The kings of armies quickly ran away, and the woman who stayed at home shared the captured goods.

verses.kjv: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
verses.decoded: Even if you have been in lowly places, you will be as beautiful as a dove’s wings covered with silver and gold feathers.

verses.kjv: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
verses.decoded: When God scattered the kings there, the place was as pure and white as snow on Mount Salmon.

verses.kjv: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
verses.decoded: God’s mountain is like the strong, high hills of Bashan.

verses.kjv: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.
verses.decoded: Why do you, high mountains, leap and dance? This is the mountain where God chooses to live; yes, the LORD will live there forever.

verses.kjv: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
verses.decoded: God’s chariots are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels; the Lord is among them, just as He was at Mount Sinai in the holy place.

verses.kjv: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them.
verses.decoded: You have gone up on high, leading captives in your train; you have received gifts from people, even from those who rebelled, so that the LORD God might live among them.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
verses.decoded: Praise the Lord, who blesses us every day with His benefits—the God who saves us. Pause and think about that.

verses.kjv: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.
verses.decoded: Our God is the God who saves us; the Sovereign Lord controls the path from death.

verses.kjv: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
verses.decoded: But God will strike the heads of His enemies and punish those who continue in their sins.

verses.kjv: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
verses.decoded: The Lord declares, 'I will bring my people back from Bashan and from the depths of the sea.'

verses.kjv: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
verses.decoded: So that your feet will be stained with the blood of your enemies, and even your dogs will share in it.

verses.kjv: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: They have witnessed your procession, O God—the procession of my God and King into the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
verses.decoded: Singers led the way, with musicians following behind; among them were young women playing tambourines.

verses.kjv: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
verses.decoded: Praise God in the assemblies; praise the Lord, you who come from the source of Israel.

verses.kjv: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.decoded: There is little Benjamin with its leader, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

verses.kjv: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
verses.decoded: Your God has commanded your strength; O God, strengthen what you have done for us.

verses.kjv: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
verses.decoded: Because of your temple in Jerusalem, kings will bring you gifts.

verses.kjv: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.
verses.decoded: Disarm the army of spearmen, the crowd of strong bulls and young calves; make them all submit with silver pieces. Scatter those who love war.

verses.kjv: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
verses.decoded: Leaders will come from Egypt; Ethiopia will soon reach out to God in worship.

verses.kjv: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
verses.decoded: All the kingdoms of the earth, sing to God; praise the Lord with joy; pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
verses.decoded: To the one who rules over the highest heavens from ancient times, He sends out His powerful voice.

verses.kjv: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
verses.decoded: Give strength and honor to God; His greatness is over Israel, and His power is seen in the heavens.

verses.kjv: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
verses.decoded: God is awe-inspiring from His holy places; the God of Israel gives strength and power to His people. Praise be to God!

verses.kjv: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
verses.decoded: Save me, God, because I am overwhelmed and drowning in trouble.

verses.kjv: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.decoded: I am sinking in deep mud with no solid ground to stand on; I have entered deep waters where floods overwhelm me.

verses.kjv: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
verses.decoded: I am tired from crying so much; my throat is dry and my eyes grow weak as I wait for God to help me.

verses.kjv: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
verses.decoded: Those who hate me for no reason are more numerous than the hairs on my head; my enemies who want to harm me unjustly are powerful, even though I have returned everything I never took.

verses.kjv: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
verses.decoded: God, you know my foolish mistakes, and my sins are not hidden from you.

verses.kjv: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
verses.decoded: Do not let those who trust in you, Lord God of armies, be put to shame because of me; do not let those who seek you be embarrassed because of me, God of Israel.

verses.kjv: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
verses.decoded: Because I suffer insults for your sake, shame covers my face.

verses.kjv: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother’s children.
verses.decoded: I have become a stranger to my own family and feel like an outsider even among my mother's children.

verses.kjv: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
verses.decoded: Because I am passionate about your house, I have been consumed; the insults aimed at you have fallen on me.

verses.kjv: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
verses.decoded: When I wept and humbled myself by fasting, people mocked me for it.

verses.kjv: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
verses.decoded: I wore sackcloth as my clothing and became a subject of gossip and mockery.

verses.kjv: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
verses.decoded: People who gather at the city gate talk against me, and I am mocked even by drunkards.

verses.kjv: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
verses.decoded: But I pray to you, Lord, at the right time; God, please hear me because of your great mercy and your faithful salvation.

verses.kjv: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.decoded: Rescue me from the mud so I won’t sink; save me from my enemies and from the deep waters that overwhelm me.

verses.kjv: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
verses.decoded: Don’t let the floodwaters overwhelm me, don’t let the deep swallow me, and don’t let the grave close its mouth over me.

verses.kjv: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
verses.decoded: Hear me, Lord, because your unfailing love is good; turn to me because of your great compassion.

verses.kjv: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
verses.decoded: Do not turn away from your servant; I am in trouble. Listen to me quickly.

verses.kjv: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
verses.decoded: Come close to my soul and rescue it; save me from my enemies.

verses.kjv: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
verses.decoded: You know my disgrace, shame, and dishonor; all my enemies stand before you.

verses.kjv: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
verses.decoded: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am filled with sorrow. I looked for someone to show pity, but there was no one; for comforters, but I found none.

verses.kjv: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.decoded: They gave me bitter poison instead of food, and vinegar instead of water when I was thirsty.

verses.kjv: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
verses.decoded: May their own table become a trap for them; may what should have been for their good become a snare.

verses.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
verses.decoded: May their eyes be blinded so they cannot see, and may their bodies tremble constantly.

verses.kjv: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
verses.decoded: Pour out your anger on them; let your fierce wrath catch hold of them.

verses.kjv: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
verses.decoded: Let their homes be left empty; let no one live in their tents.

verses.kjv: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
verses.decoded: They persecute the one you have struck down and talk about the pain of those you have wounded.

verses.kjv: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
verses.decoded: Let their guilt increase; do not let them enter your righteous presence.

verses.kjv: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.decoded: Erase them from the record of the living; do not include them among the righteous.

verses.kjv: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
verses.decoded: But I am poor and full of sorrow; may your salvation, O God, lift me up.

verses.kjv: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.decoded: I will praise God's name with a song and honor him with thanksgiving.

verses.kjv: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
verses.decoded: God prefers sincere praise and obedience more than sacrifices of strong oxen or bulls.

verses.kjv: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
verses.decoded: The humble will witness this and rejoice; those who seek God will find renewed life and hope.

verses.kjv: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
verses.decoded: God listens to the cries of the poor and does not ignore those who are imprisoned or oppressed.

verses.kjv: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
verses.decoded: Let the heavens and the earth praise God, along with the seas and all living creatures within them.

verses.kjv: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
verses.decoded: God will rescue Jerusalem and restore the cities of Judah so that people can live there securely and claim their inheritance.

verses.kjv: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.decoded: The descendants of God's servants will inherit the land, and those who love His name will live there.

verses.kjv: MAKE HASTE, O GOD, TO DELIVER ME; MAKE HASTE TO HELP ME, O LORD.
verses.decoded: God, please hurry and save me; quickly come to my aid, LORD.

verses.kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
verses.decoded: May those who want to harm me be ashamed and confused; may they be turned away in defeat.

verses.kjv: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
verses.decoded: May those who mock me with 'Aha! Aha!' be turned back and face the consequences of their shame.

verses.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
verses.decoded: May everyone who looks for you be filled with joy; may those who love your salvation always say, 'God is great!'

verses.kjv: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
verses.decoded: I am poor and in need; hurry to help me, God. You are my helper and savior; LORD, don’t delay.

verses.kjv: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
verses.decoded: Lord, I trust in you; please never let me be ashamed or embarrassed.

verses.kjv: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
verses.decoded: Save me because of your justice; help me escape danger. Listen to me and rescue me.

verses.kjv: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
verses.decoded: Be my safe place where I can always find refuge. You have promised to save me because you are my solid rock and strong fortress.

verses.kjv: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.decoded: Save me, God, from the control of evil people, from those who are unfair and cruel.

verses.kjv: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.
verses.decoded: You, Lord God, are my hope and the one I have trusted since I was young.

verses.kjv: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
verses.decoded: You have supported me since I was in my mother's womb; you brought me into this world. I will always praise you.

verses.kjv: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
verses.decoded: Many people are amazed by me, but you are my strong protection.

verses.kjv: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
verses.decoded: May I always speak words that praise and honor you all day long.

verses.kjv: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
verses.decoded: Don’t abandon me when I grow old or when I become weak.

verses.kjv: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
verses.decoded: My enemies talk against me and those who want to harm me plan together.

verses.kjv: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
verses.decoded: They say, 'God has abandoned him; chase him down and capture him because no one will save him.'

verses.kjv: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
verses.decoded: God, don’t be far away; hurry to help me, my God.

verses.kjv: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
verses.decoded: Let those who oppose me be ashamed and destroyed; let those who want to harm me be covered with disgrace.

verses.kjv: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
verses.decoded: But I will keep hoping and praise you more and more.

verses.kjv: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
verses.decoded: I will speak about your justice and salvation all day long because I cannot count how many times you have saved me.

verses.kjv: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
verses.decoded: I will rely on the power of the Lord God; I will speak about your righteousness, which is uniquely yours.

verses.kjv: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
verses.decoded: God, you have taught me since I was young, and until now I have told others about your amazing deeds.

verses.kjv: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
verses.decoded: Even when I am old and gray, God, don’t abandon me. Let me continue to show your strength to this generation and your power to those who will come after.

verses.kjv: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!
verses.decoded: Your righteousness, God, is supreme. You have done great things—there is no one like you!

verses.kjv: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.decoded: You have allowed me to face severe troubles, but you will revive me and raise me up from the depths of despair.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
verses.decoded: You will make me greater and surround me with comfort.

verses.kjv: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: I will praise you with the psaltery and celebrate your truth, God. I will sing to you with the harp, Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
verses.decoded: My lips will be full of joy when I sing to you, because you have saved my soul.

verses.kjv: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
verses.decoded: My tongue will speak about your righteousness all day long, because those who want to harm me will be ashamed and defeated.

verses.kjv: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king’s son.
verses.decoded: God, give the king your fair decisions and your righteousness to his son.

verses.kjv: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
verses.decoded: He will judge your people fairly and make just decisions for the poor.

verses.kjv: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
verses.decoded: The mountains and hills will bring peace to the people through justice.

verses.kjv: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
verses.decoded: He will judge the poor fairly, rescue the children of those in need, and crush the oppressors.

verses.kjv: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
verses.decoded: People will respect and honor you forever, as long as the sun and moon exist, for all generations.

verses.kjv: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
verses.decoded: He will come gently and refreshingly like rain on cut grass, like showers that nourish the earth.

verses.kjv: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
verses.decoded: During his reign, the righteous will thrive, and there will be great peace as long as the moon lasts.

verses.kjv: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
verses.decoded: His rule will extend from one sea to the other, and from the river to the farthest parts of the earth.

verses.kjv: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.decoded: People living in the wilderness will bow down to him, and his enemies will be defeated and humbled.

verses.kjv: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.decoded: Kings from distant lands like Tarshish, the islands, Sheba, and Seba will bring gifts to him.

verses.kjv: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
verses.decoded: All kings will bow down to him, and all nations will serve him.

verses.kjv: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
verses.decoded: He will rescue the needy when they call out, including the poor and those without anyone to help them.

verses.kjv: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
verses.decoded: He will protect the poor and needy and save their lives.

verses.kjv: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
verses.decoded: He will rescue them from lies and violence, and their lives will be precious to him.

verses.kjv: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
verses.decoded: He will live long, receive gold from Sheba, and people will pray for him and praise him every day.

verses.kjv: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
verses.decoded: There will be a small but abundant harvest on the mountaintops; its crops will be as plentiful as the forests of Lebanon. The people in the city will thrive like grass growing on the land.

verses.kjv: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
verses.decoded: His name will last forever, continuing like the eternal sun. People will be blessed because of him, and all nations will praise him.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone performs amazing deeds.

verses.kjv: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
verses.decoded: May his glorious name be praised forever, and may the whole earth be filled with his glory. Truly, truly.

verses.kjv: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.decoded: These are the final prayers of David, son of Jesse.

verses.kjv: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.
verses.decoded: God is truly good to Israel, especially to those who have pure hearts.

verses.kjv: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.decoded: But as for me, I almost lost my footing; I nearly stumbled.

verses.kjv: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.decoded: I was jealous of the foolish when I saw how well the wicked were doing.

verses.kjv: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
verses.decoded: They don’t suffer the usual troubles in death; their strength remains strong.

verses.kjv: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
verses.decoded: They don’t face troubles like other people do; they aren’t plagued like everyone else.

verses.kjv: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
verses.decoded: Pride surrounds them like a chain, and violence covers them like clothing.

verses.kjv: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
verses.decoded: Their eyes bulge with abundance; they have more than they ever wanted.

verses.kjv: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
verses.decoded: They are corrupt and speak evil about oppression; they speak arrogantly.

verses.kjv: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
verses.decoded: They speak boldly against God, and their words spread everywhere.

verses.kjv: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
verses.decoded: Because of this, God’s people turn back here, and they are given a full cup of suffering.

verses.kjv: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
verses.decoded: They say, 'Does God even know? Does the Most High have any understanding?'

verses.kjv: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
verses.decoded: Look, these are the wicked who succeed in the world and grow rich.

verses.kjv: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
verses.decoded: Truly, I have tried to keep my heart pure and my hands innocent, but it seemed pointless.

verses.kjv: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
verses.decoded: I have been troubled all day and disciplined every morning.

verses.kjv: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
verses.decoded: If I say I will speak this way, I would be insulting your people.

verses.kjv: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
verses.decoded: When I tried to understand this, it was too difficult and painful for me to bear.

verses.kjv: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
verses.decoded: But when I entered God's sanctuary, I finally understood what will happen to them in the end.

verses.kjv: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
verses.decoded: You place the wicked on unstable ground and cause them to fall into ruin.

verses.kjv: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
verses.decoded: Suddenly, they are destroyed and overwhelmed by fear.

verses.kjv: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
verses.decoded: Like a fading dream upon waking, Lord, you will reject their false appearances.

verses.kjv: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
verses.decoded: This made me deeply troubled and distressed inside.

verses.kjv: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
verses.decoded: I was foolish and ignorant, acting like an animal before you.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
verses.decoded: But I remain close to you; you hold me firmly by my right hand.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verses.decoded: You will guide me with your advice and then bring me into glory.

verses.kjv: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
verses.decoded: Who else do I have in heaven but you? And on earth, I desire no one else but you.

verses.kjv: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
