verses.decoded: My body and heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my eternal share.

verses.kjv: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
verses.decoded: Those who turn away from you will perish; you destroy all who abandon you.

verses.kjv: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
verses.decoded: But it is good for me to be close to God; I trust in the Lord so I can proclaim all your deeds.

verses.kjv: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
verses.decoded: O God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger burn against the people you care for?

verses.kjv: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
verses.decoded: Remember your people, whom you have chosen long ago; the tribe that belongs to you and that you saved; this Mount Zion where you live.

verses.kjv: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: Look down on the ruins that last forever, on everything the enemy has done to harm your sanctuary.

verses.kjv: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
verses.decoded: Your enemies shout loudly among your people; they raise their banners as a sign of victory.

verses.kjv: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
verses.decoded: Strong men were known for swinging their axes against the thick trees.

verses.kjv: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
verses.decoded: But now they destroy the carved decorations all at once using axes and hammers.

verses.kjv: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
verses.decoded: They have set fire to your sanctuary and destroyed the place where your name dwells.

verses.kjv: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
verses.decoded: They planned together to destroy everything; they have burned down all the places of worship of God in the land.

verses.kjv: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
verses.decoded: We no longer see any signs; there are no prophets left; no one knows how long this will last.

verses.kjv: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
verses.decoded: O God, how long will our enemies insult us? Will they keep insulting your name forever?

verses.kjv: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.
verses.decoded: Why do you hold back your hand, your powerful right hand? Come and save us now.

verses.kjv: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.decoded: God has been my King from ancient times, bringing salvation to the earth.

verses.kjv: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
verses.decoded: You divided the sea with your power; you crushed the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

verses.kjv: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
verses.decoded: You smashed the heads of the sea monster Leviathan and gave it as food to the creatures living in the desert.

verses.kjv: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
verses.decoded: You split open springs and rivers; you dried up mighty rivers.

verses.kjv: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
verses.decoded: The day belongs to you, and the night belongs to you too; you made the light and the sun.

verses.kjv: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
verses.decoded: You established all the boundaries of the earth; you created summer and winter.

verses.kjv: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
verses.decoded: Remember, Lord, that your enemies have insulted you, and foolish people have spoken against your name.

verses.kjv: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
verses.decoded: Do not let your beloved people be destroyed by the wicked; never forget your poor community.

verses.kjv: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
verses.decoded: Remember your covenant with us, because the earth’s darkest places are filled with cruelty.

verses.kjv: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
verses.decoded: Do not let those who are oppressed be put to shame; let the poor and needy praise your name.

verses.kjv: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
verses.decoded: Rise up, God, defend your own cause; remember how foolish people insult you every day.

verses.kjv: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
verses.decoded: Do not ignore the voices of your enemies; the noise of those who rebel against you grows louder every day.

verses.kjv: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
verses.decoded: We give thanks to you, O God; we give thanks because your name is near and your amazing deeds are known.

verses.kjv: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
verses.decoded: When I gather the people at the appointed time, I will judge fairly and justly.

verses.kjv: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
verses.decoded: Though the earth and everyone on it may fall apart, I hold up its foundations. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.decoded: I told the foolish not to act foolishly, and to the wicked not to be proud or arrogant.

verses.kjv: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
verses.decoded: Do not raise your pride arrogantly; do not be stubborn or rebellious in your speech.

verses.kjv: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
verses.decoded: No promotion or honor comes from the east, west, or south.

verses.kjv: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
verses.decoded: God is the judge; He brings down some and raises up others.

verses.kjv: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
verses.decoded: The LORD holds a cup filled with red wine mixed with spices; He pours it out, and all the wicked on earth will drink the bitter dregs.

verses.kjv: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.decoded: But I will always proclaim and praise the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.decoded: I will remove all power from the wicked, but the strength of the righteous will be lifted up.

verses.kjv: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
verses.decoded: This is a song for the lead musician, a Psalm by Asaph. God is recognized and honored in Judah; His name is highly respected throughout Israel.

verses.kjv: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
verses.decoded: God’s sanctuary is in Salem, and His home is in Zion.

verses.kjv: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
verses.decoded: There He shattered the weapons of war—the arrows, shields, swords, and the fight itself. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
verses.decoded: You are more glorious and majestic than the mountains where wild animals live.

verses.kjv: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.decoded: The brave warriors are defeated and lie down in death; none of the strong men could save themselves.

verses.kjv: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.decoded: When you rebuke, God of Jacob, even the chariots and horses fall motionless as if dead.

verses.kjv: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
verses.decoded: You alone are to be feared; who can stand before you when you are angry?

verses.kjv: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.decoded: You announced your judgment from heaven; the earth was afraid and became silent.

verses.kjv: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
verses.decoded: When God comes to judge, He saves all the humble and gentle people of the earth. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
verses.decoded: Human anger will ultimately bring you praise, but you will control and limit the rest of the anger.

verses.kjv: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
verses.decoded: Make promises and fulfill them to the LORD your God; let everyone near Him bring gifts to the one who is to be feared.

verses.kjv: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.decoded: He will destroy the plans of rulers; He is terrifying to the kings of the earth.

verses.kjv: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
verses.decoded: I called out to God loudly; I cried out to God, and He listened to me.

verses.kjv: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.decoded: During my time of trouble, I looked for the Lord; my pain continued through the night, and my soul would not find peace.

verses.kjv: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.decoded: When I thought about God, I became upset; I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.decoded: You keep my eyes open; I am so troubled that I cannot find words to speak.

verses.kjv: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.decoded: I have thought about the past, the long ago days.

verses.kjv: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
verses.decoded: I remember the songs I sang at night; I talk quietly with myself and search deeply within my spirit.

verses.kjv: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
verses.decoded: Will the Lord reject us forever? Will He never show us favor again?

verses.kjv: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
verses.decoded: Has His mercy completely ended forever? Has His promise failed for all generations?

verses.kjv: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
verses.decoded: Has God forgotten to be kind? Has He stopped showing compassion because He is angry? Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
verses.decoded: I said, This is my weakness; but I will remember the powerful acts of the Most High God.

verses.kjv: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
verses.decoded: I will remember what the Lord has done; I will surely remember Your amazing deeds from long ago.

verses.kjv: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
verses.decoded: I will think deeply about all Your works and speak about what You have done.

verses.kjv: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
verses.decoded: Your path, O God, is holy; who is as great a God as ours?

verses.kjv: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
verses.decoded: You are the God who performs wonders; You have shown Your power to the nations.

verses.kjv: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.decoded: With Your mighty arm, You have saved Your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
verses.decoded: The waters noticed you, O God; they were frightened. Even the deepest parts of the sea were disturbed.

verses.kjv: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.decoded: The clouds released rain; the sky thundered loudly; your arrows (lightning bolts) flashed everywhere.

verses.kjv: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
verses.decoded: Your thunder echoed through the heavens; lightning lit up the world; the earth shook and trembled.

verses.kjv: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
verses.decoded: Your path goes through the sea and mighty waters, but no one can trace where you have gone.

verses.kjv: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.decoded: You guided your people like a shepherd leads a flock, through the leadership of Moses and Aaron.

verses.kjv: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.decoded: Listen carefully, my people, to my teaching; pay close attention to what I say.

verses.kjv: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
verses.decoded: I will speak in stories and reveal hidden truths from the past.

verses.kjv: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.decoded: These are things we have heard and understood, passed down by our ancestors.

verses.kjv: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
verses.decoded: We will tell the next generation about the LORD’s praises, his power, and the amazing things he has done.

verses.kjv: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.decoded: God set up a covenant with Jacob and gave laws to Israel, commanding our ancestors to teach them to their children.

verses.kjv: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
verses.decoded: So future generations, including children yet to be born, would learn and tell these truths to their own children.

verses.kjv: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
verses.decoded: This is so they would put their trust in God, remember what he has done, and obey his commands.

verses.kjv: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
verses.decoded: So they would not be like their ancestors, who were stubborn and rebellious, refusing to be faithful to God.

verses.kjv: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.decoded: The Ephraimites, though armed and ready with bows, ran away when battle came.

verses.kjv: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
verses.decoded: They broke God’s covenant and refused to follow his laws.

verses.kjv: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
verses.decoded: They forgot all the amazing things God had done for them.

verses.kjv: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.decoded: God performed wonderful miracles before their ancestors in Egypt, especially near Zoan.

verses.kjv: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
verses.decoded: He parted the sea so they could cross, holding the waters back like a wall.

verses.kjv: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.decoded: During the day, he guided them with a cloud, and at night with a pillar of fire.

verses.kjv: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
verses.decoded: He split rocks in the desert and provided water flowing like a deep river.

verses.kjv: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.decoded: He made water flow from the rock, creating streams that ran like rivers.

verses.kjv: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
verses.decoded: But they sinned even more by angering God, the Most High, while in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
verses.decoded: They tested God in their hearts by demanding food to satisfy their cravings.

verses.kjv: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.decoded: They spoke against God, asking, 'Can God prepare a meal for us in the desert?'

verses.kjv: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
verses.decoded: God struck the rock and water poured out in abundance; can He also give bread and meat to His people?

verses.kjv: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
verses.decoded: So the LORD heard this and became angry; He kindled a fire against Jacob and was furious with Israel.

verses.kjv: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.decoded: Because they did not believe in God or trust in His saving power.

verses.kjv: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.decoded: Even though He commanded the clouds above and opened the gates of heaven,

verses.kjv: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
verses.decoded: He rained down manna for them to eat and gave them heavenly bread.

verses.kjv: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.
verses.decoded: People ate food like angels' bread; God gave them enough meat to satisfy them.

verses.kjv: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
verses.decoded: He sent an east wind to blow from the sky and, by His power, brought in a south wind.

verses.kjv: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
verses.decoded: He rained down meat on them like dust and birds as numerous as the sand by the sea.

verses.kjv: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
verses.decoded: He let it fall in the middle of their camp, all around where they lived.

verses.kjv: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
verses.decoded: They ate and were fully satisfied because God gave them what they wanted.

verses.kjv: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
verses.decoded: They did not turn away from their cravings; even while the food was still in their mouths,

verses.kjv: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
verses.decoded: God's anger came against them and killed the strongest among them, striking down the best young men of Israel.

verses.kjv: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
verses.decoded: Despite all this, they continued to sin and did not trust God because of the amazing things He had done.

verses.kjv: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
verses.decoded: So God wasted their lives in emptiness and filled their years with hardship.

verses.kjv: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
verses.decoded: When God struck them down, they turned back to Him and began to seek Him earnestly.

verses.kjv: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
verses.decoded: They remembered that God was their strong foundation and the exalted One who saved them.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
verses.decoded: But even so, they spoke false praises and lied to God with their words.

verses.kjv: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
verses.decoded: Their hearts were not loyal to God, and they were not faithful to His agreement.

verses.kjv: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.decoded: But because He was full of compassion, He forgave their sins and did not destroy them; many times He held back His anger and did not bring His full punishment.

verses.kjv: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.decoded: He remembered that they were only human, like a breath of wind that passes and does not return.

verses.kjv: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
verses.decoded: How often they rebelled against Him in the wilderness and caused Him sorrow in the desert!

verses.kjv: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: Yes, they turned away and tested God, challenging the power of the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
verses.decoded: They forgot the power of His hand and the day He saved them from their enemies.

verses.kjv: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
verses.decoded: How He performed His miracles in Egypt and showed His wonders in the land of Zoan.

verses.kjv: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
verses.decoded: He turned their rivers into blood and made their streams undrinkable.

verses.kjv: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.decoded: He sent various kinds of flies that attacked them and frogs that ruined their land.

verses.kjv: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.decoded: He allowed the caterpillars to destroy their crops and the locusts to consume their hard work.

verses.kjv: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
verses.decoded: He ruined their grapevines with hail and their sycamore trees with frost.

verses.kjv: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.decoded: He allowed hail to kill their cattle and lightning to strike their sheep.

verses.kjv: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
verses.decoded: He unleashed his fierce anger and trouble on them by sending harmful angels among them.

verses.kjv: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.decoded: He prepared the path for his anger, not sparing anyone from death but allowing disease to take their lives.

verses.kjv: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
verses.decoded: He struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, the strongest leaders in the homes of Ham’s descendants.

verses.kjv: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.decoded: But he led his people out like sheep and guided them safely through the wilderness like a shepherd with his flock.

verses.kjv: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.decoded: He led them safely without fear, while the sea covered their enemies.

verses.kjv: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
verses.decoded: He brought them to the edge of his holy place, to this mountain that his power had claimed.

verses.kjv: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.decoded: He drove out the nations ahead of them, gave them their land by dividing it, and settled the tribes of Israel in their homes.

verses.kjv: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
verses.decoded: But they tested and angered the Most High God and did not obey his laws.

verses.kjv: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.decoded: They turned away and acted unfaithfully like their ancestors; they were unreliable like a crooked bow.

verses.kjv: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.decoded: They angered him by worshiping at high places and made him jealous by worshiping idols.

verses.kjv: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
verses.decoded: When God heard this, he became very angry and deeply despised Israel.

verses.kjv: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
verses.decoded: So he abandoned the tabernacle at Shiloh, the tent where he had dwelt among people.

verses.kjv: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy’s hand.
verses.decoded: God allowed Israel's power to be captured and their honor to fall into the hands of their enemies.

verses.kjv: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.decoded: He handed his people over to their enemies' swords because he was angry with those he had chosen.

verses.kjv: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
verses.decoded: Their young men were destroyed by fire, and their young women were not praised or married.

verses.kjv: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.decoded: Their priests were killed by the sword, and their widows did not mourn.

verses.kjv: Then the LORD awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
verses.decoded: Then the Lord woke up as if from sleep, like a strong warrior shouting loudly, as if drunk with wine.

verses.kjv: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.decoded: He struck down his enemies from behind and caused them to be forever disgraced.

verses.kjv: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.decoded: He rejected the tent of Joseph and did not choose the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.decoded: Instead, he chose the tribe of Judah, the beloved Mount Zion.

verses.kjv: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
verses.decoded: He built his sanctuary like a grand palace, firmly established forever like the earth itself.

verses.kjv: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
verses.decoded: He also chose David, his servant, and brought him from tending sheep.

verses.kjv: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
verses.decoded: From caring for pregnant sheep, he brought David to lead Jacob’s people and Israel, his inheritance.

verses.kjv: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.decoded: David led them with a sincere heart and guided them with skillful hands.

verses.kjv: O GOD, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
verses.decoded: O God, foreign nations have invaded your land; they have defiled your holy temple and destroyed Jerusalem, turning it into ruins.

verses.kjv: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
verses.decoded: They have left the bodies of your servants to be eaten by birds of the sky and the flesh of your holy people to be devoured by wild animals.

verses.kjv: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
verses.decoded: They have spilled the blood of your people all around Jerusalem like water, and no one is there to bury the dead.

verses.kjv: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
verses.decoded: We have become a disgrace to our neighbors, mocked and ridiculed by those around us.

verses.kjv: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
verses.decoded: How long, LORD? Will you stay angry forever? Will your jealousy continue to burn like fire?

verses.kjv: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
verses.decoded: Pour out your anger on the nations that do not know you and on the kingdoms that have not called on your name.

verses.kjv: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
verses.decoded: Because they have destroyed Jacob’s people and ruined their homes.

verses.kjv: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
verses.decoded: Please do not remember the sins of our ancestors; let your mercy come quickly to help us, for we are deeply humbled.

verses.kjv: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name’s sake.
verses.decoded: Help us, God who saves us, for the sake of your glory; rescue us and forgive our sins because of your name.

verses.kjv: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
verses.decoded: Why should the nations say, 'Where is their God?' Let your power be known among the nations by avenging the blood of your servants who were killed.

verses.kjv: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
verses.decoded: Let the cries of prisoners reach you; by your great power, protect those who are doomed to die.

verses.kjv: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
verses.decoded: Repay our neighbors seven times over for the insults they have hurled at you, LORD.

verses.kjv: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
verses.decoded: Then we, your people and the sheep of your pasture, will thank you forever and proclaim your praise to every generation.

verses.kjv: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
verses.decoded: Listen, Shepherd of Israel, you who guide Joseph like a flock; you who sit between the cherubim, shine your light.

verses.kjv: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
verses.decoded: Awaken your power, Lord, before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh; come and save us.

verses.kjv: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.decoded: Restore us, God; let your face shine on us, and we will be saved.

verses.kjv: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
verses.decoded: Lord God of heavenly armies, how long will you be angry and ignore the prayers of your people?

verses.kjv: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
verses.decoded: You have fed us with sorrow and given us tears to drink in large amounts.

verses.kjv: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.decoded: You have made us a source of conflict for our neighbors, and our enemies mock us.

verses.kjv: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.decoded: Restore us again, God of heavenly armies; let your face shine on us, and we will be saved.

verses.kjv: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
verses.decoded: You brought a vine out of Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.

verses.kjv: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
verses.decoded: You cleared the ground for it, made it take deep root, and it spread throughout the land.

verses.kjv: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
verses.decoded: Its branches shaded the hills, and its boughs were like the majestic cedars.

verses.kjv: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
verses.decoded: Its branches reached out to the sea, and its shoots extended to the river.

verses.kjv: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
verses.decoded: Why did you break down its protective walls so that everyone passing by can pick its fruit?

verses.kjv: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
verses.decoded: Wild boars from the forest destroy it, and wild animals from the fields eat it.

verses.kjv: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
verses.decoded: Please come back, God of heavenly armies; look down from heaven, see, and care for this vine.

verses.kjv: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.decoded: The vineyard your right hand planted, the branch you made strong for yourself.

verses.kjv: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
verses.decoded: It has been destroyed by fire and cut down; they are destroyed when you show your displeasure.

verses.kjv: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.decoded: May your power rest on the one you favor, the human you have made strong for your purpose.

verses.kjv: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
verses.decoded: Then we will not turn away from you; bring us back to life, and we will call on your name.

verses.kjv: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.decoded: Restore us again, Lord Almighty; let your favor shine on us, and we will be saved.

verses.kjv: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
verses.decoded: For the lead musician on the Gittith, a psalm by Asaph: Sing loudly to God, our strength; shout joyfully to the God of Jacob.

verses.kjv: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
verses.decoded: Prepare a song and bring the tambourine, the sweet harp, and the psaltery.

verses.kjv: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
verses.decoded: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, during the appointed time, on our sacred festival day.

verses.kjv: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
verses.decoded: This was a command for Israel, a law given by the God of Jacob.

verses.kjv: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.
verses.decoded: He established this as a reminder for Joseph when he came out of Egypt, a land where I heard a language I did not understand.

verses.kjv: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
verses.decoded: I freed their shoulders from heavy burdens and their hands from working at the pots.

verses.kjv: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
verses.decoded: You called me when you were in trouble, and I rescued you; I answered you from the thunderous place and tested you at the waters of Meribah. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
verses.decoded: Listen, my people, and I will speak to you; Israel, if you will listen to me,

verses.kjv: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
verses.decoded: You must have no foreign gods among you and must not worship any other gods.

verses.kjv: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.decoded: I am the LORD your God who brought you out of Egypt; open your mouth wide, and I will satisfy you.

verses.kjv: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
verses.decoded: But my people refused to listen to me; Israel rejected me.

verses.kjv: So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
verses.decoded: So I let them follow their own desires, and they chose their own plans.

verses.kjv: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
verses.decoded: If only my people had listened to me and Israel had followed my ways!

verses.kjv: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
verses.decoded: I would have quickly defeated their enemies and fought against those who opposed them.

verses.kjv: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
verses.decoded: Those who hate the LORD would have humbled themselves before him, but their punishment would last forever.

verses.kjv: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
verses.decoded: I would have fed them the best wheat and satisfied you with honey from the rock.

verses.kjv: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
verses.decoded: God stands in the assembly of powerful beings; He judges among the divine beings.

verses.kjv: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
verses.decoded: How long will you judge unfairly and favor the wicked? Pause and think about this.

verses.kjv: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
verses.decoded: Protect the poor and orphans; give justice to those who are suffering and in need.

verses.kjv: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.decoded: Rescue the poor and needy; save them from the power of the wicked.

verses.kjv: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
verses.decoded: They do not know or understand; they continue in darkness, and the very foundations of the earth are shaken.

verses.kjv: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.
verses.decoded: I said, 'You are gods,' and all of you are children of the Most High.

verses.kjv: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
verses.decoded: But you will die like mere humans and fall like any other ruler.

verses.kjv: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
verses.decoded: Rise up, God, and judge the earth, for You will inherit all the nations.

verses.kjv: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
verses.decoded: God, do not stay silent or quiet; do not remain still or inactive.

verses.kjv: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
verses.decoded: Look, your enemies are causing chaos, and those who hate you are becoming bold.

verses.kjv: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
verses.decoded: They have made secret plans against your people and conspired against those you protect.

verses.kjv: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
verses.decoded: They have agreed, 'Let’s destroy them as a nation so that Israel’s name is forgotten.'

verses.kjv: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
verses.decoded: They have united with one purpose; they have formed an alliance against you.

verses.kjv: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.decoded: The dwellings of Edom, the Ishmaelites, Moab, and the Hagarenes;

verses.kjv: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.decoded: Gebal, Ammon, Amalek, the Philistines, and the people of Tyre;

verses.kjv: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.decoded: Assyria has joined them; they have helped the descendants of Lot. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
verses.decoded: Treat them as you did the Midianites, Sisera, and Jabin at the Kishon River:

verses.kjv: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
verses.decoded: They were destroyed at Endor and became like manure on the ground.

verses.kjv: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
verses.decoded: Make their leaders like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their rulers like Zebah and Zalmunna.

verses.kjv: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
verses.decoded: Those who said, 'Let’s take over the places dedicated to God as our own.'

verses.kjv: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
verses.decoded: God, make them scatter like a wheel spinning or like dry straw blown by the wind.

verses.kjv: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
verses.decoded: Like fire that burns wood and flames that set mountains ablaze;

verses.kjv: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
verses.decoded: Chase them away with your storm and terrify them with your powerful winds.

verses.kjv: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
verses.decoded: Make them ashamed so that they will turn to you, Lord.

verses.kjv: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.decoded: Let them be confused and distressed forever; let them be ashamed and destroyed.

verses.kjv: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
verses.decoded: So that everyone will know that you, whose name is Jehovah alone, are the highest ruler over the whole earth.

verses.kjv: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
verses.decoded: How lovely are your dwelling places, Lord Almighty!

verses.kjv: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
verses.decoded: My soul yearns and even faints for the courts of the Lord; my heart and body cry out for the living God.

verses.kjv: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
verses.decoded: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for her young—near your altars, Lord Almighty, my King and my God.

verses.kjv: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
verses.decoded: Blessed are those who live in your house; they will always praise you. Pause and think about that.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
verses.decoded: Blessed is the person who finds strength in you, whose heart is set on the right path.

verses.kjv: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
verses.decoded: Those who go through the valley of Baca make it a place of springs; the autumn rains also cover it with pools.

verses.kjv: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
verses.decoded: They go from strength to strength; each one appears before God in Zion.

verses.kjv: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.decoded: Lord God Almighty, hear my prayer; listen, God of Jacob. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
verses.decoded: Look, God, our shield; pay attention to the face of your anointed one.

verses.kjv: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.decoded: One day in your courts is better than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in God’s house than live in the homes of the wicked.

verses.kjv: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.decoded: The Lord God is like the sun and a shield; he gives grace and glory and will not withhold good from those who live honestly.

verses.kjv: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
verses.decoded: Lord Almighty, blessed is the person who trusts in you.

verses.kjv: Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.decoded: Lord, you have been kind to your land; you have restored the people of Israel from exile.

verses.kjv: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.decoded: You have forgiven the sins of your people and have completely covered their wrongdoings. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
verses.decoded: You have removed your anger and turned away from your fierce wrath.

verses.kjv: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
verses.decoded: Turn us back to you, God who saves us, and stop being angry with us.

verses.kjv: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
verses.decoded: Will you stay angry with us forever? Will your anger continue through all generations?

verses.kjv: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
verses.decoded: Won't you bring us back to life so your people can rejoice in you again?

verses.kjv: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
verses.decoded: Show us your mercy, Lord, and save us.

verses.kjv: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.decoded: I will listen to what God the Lord says, because he will speak peace to his people and his faithful ones. But may they not return to foolish ways.

verses.kjv: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.decoded: Surely his salvation is near to those who respect him, so that his glory can live in our land.

verses.kjv: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.decoded: Mercy and truth have come together; righteousness and peace have embraced.

verses.kjv: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.decoded: Truth will grow from the earth, and righteousness will come down from heaven.

verses.kjv: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
verses.decoded: The Lord will give what is good, and our land will produce a rich harvest.

verses.kjv: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
verses.decoded: Righteousness will lead the way for him and guide us to follow in his path.

verses.kjv: Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
verses.decoded: LORD, please listen to me and hear my prayer, because I am humble and in need.

verses.kjv: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
verses.decoded: Protect my life because I am devoted to you; save your servant who trusts in you, my God.

verses.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
verses.decoded: Have mercy on me, LORD, because I pray to you every day.

verses.kjv: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.decoded: Make your servant happy, LORD, because I put my hope in you.

verses.kjv: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
verses.decoded: You, LORD, are good and willing to forgive; you have great mercy for everyone who calls on you.

verses.kjv: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.decoded: LORD, listen carefully to my prayer and pay attention to my requests.

verses.kjv: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
verses.decoded: When I am in trouble, I will call to you, because you will answer me.

verses.kjv: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
verses.decoded: There is no god like you, LORD, and no one does the amazing things you do.

verses.kjv: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
verses.decoded: All the nations you created will come and worship you, LORD, and honor your name.

verses.kjv: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.
verses.decoded: You are great and perform amazing deeds; you alone are God.

verses.kjv: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
verses.decoded: Show me your path, LORD; I will follow your truth. Help me to respect and honor your name wholeheartedly.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
verses.decoded: I will praise you, LORD my God, with all my heart and honor your name forever.

verses.kjv: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
verses.decoded: Your mercy toward me is great; you have saved my life from the depths of death.

verses.kjv: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
verses.decoded: God, proud and cruel people have come against me and want to harm me, but they do not honor you.

verses.kjv: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, long suffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
verses.decoded: But you, LORD, are full of compassion, kindness, patience, abundant mercy, and truth.

verses.kjv: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
verses.decoded: Please turn to me and show me mercy; give your strength to your servant, and save the son of your servant woman.

verses.kjv: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
verses.decoded: Show me a sign of your goodness so those who hate me will see it and be ashamed, because you, Lord, have helped and comforted me.

verses.kjv: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.decoded: [A Psalm or Song by the descendants of Korah.] His foundation is laid in the sacred mountains.

verses.kjv: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.decoded: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the homes of Israel.

verses.kjv: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
verses.decoded: Wonderful things are said about you, O city of God. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
verses.decoded: I will speak of Rahab and Babylon to those who know me; look, Philistia, Tyre, and Ethiopia—people from there were born in you.

verses.kjv: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.decoded: People will say about Zion, 'This person and that person were born there,' and the Most High himself will make her secure.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
verses.decoded: When the LORD records the people, he will note that this person was born there. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
verses.decoded: Both singers and musicians will be there; all my sources of joy come from you.

verses.kjv: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
verses.decoded: O LORD, God who saves me, I have cried out to you day and night.

verses.kjv: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
verses.decoded: Please let my prayer reach you; listen carefully to my cry for help.

verses.kjv: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
verses.decoded: My soul is overwhelmed with troubles, and I feel like I am close to death.

verses.kjv: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
verses.decoded: I am considered among those who descend to the grave; I feel powerless like a dead man.

verses.kjv: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
verses.decoded: I am like one freed among the dead, like those who lie in the grave whom you no longer remember and who are beyond your care.

verses.kjv: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
verses.decoded: You have put me in the deepest pit, in utter darkness and deep waters.

verses.kjv: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
verses.decoded: Your anger weighs heavily on me, and you have overwhelmed me with all your waves of trouble. Pause and think about this.

verses.kjv: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.decoded: You have pushed my friends far away from me; you have made me detestable to them. I am trapped and cannot escape.

verses.kjv: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
verses.decoded: My eyes grow weak from sorrow; LORD, I call to you every day and reach out my hands to you.

verses.kjv: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
verses.decoded: Will you show your miracles to those who are dead? Will the dead rise up to praise you? Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
verses.decoded: Can your unfailing love be told in the grave, or your faithfulness in the place of death?

verses.kjv: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.decoded: Can your miracles be known in darkness, or your righteousness in the land where people are forgotten?

verses.kjv: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
verses.decoded: But I have cried out to you, LORD, and my prayer will reach you early in the morning.

verses.kjv: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
verses.decoded: LORD, why have you rejected me? Why do you hide your face from me?

verses.kjv: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
verses.decoded: I have been suffering and close to death since I was young; your terrors overwhelm me and confuse my mind.

verses.kjv: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.decoded: Your intense anger overwhelms me; your frightening judgments have destroyed me.

verses.kjv: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
verses.decoded: These troubles surround me constantly, like water flooding in from all sides.

verses.kjv: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
verses.decoded: You have pushed away my loved ones and friends, and those I know are left in darkness.

verses.kjv: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.decoded: I will sing about the LORD’s kindness forever; I will tell everyone about your faithfulness through all generations.

verses.kjv: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
verses.decoded: I have declared that your mercy will last forever, and your faithfulness is as permanent as the heavens.

verses.kjv: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
verses.decoded: I have made a special agreement with my chosen one; I have promised my servant David,

verses.kjv: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
verses.decoded: I will establish your descendants forever and build your throne for all generations. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
verses.decoded: The heavens will praise your amazing works, LORD, and your faithfulness will be celebrated among your holy people.

verses.kjv: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
verses.decoded: Who in heaven can compare to the LORD? Who among the powerful beings is like the LORD?

verses.kjv: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
verses.decoded: God is to be deeply respected among his holy people and honored by everyone around him.

verses.kjv: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
verses.decoded: LORD God of heavenly armies, who is as powerful as you? Who is as faithful all around you?

verses.kjv: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
verses.decoded: You control the roaring sea; when its waves rise, you calm them.

verses.kjv: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
verses.decoded: You crushed Rahab (a symbol for Egypt or chaos) like a defeated enemy; you scattered your foes with your powerful strength.

verses.kjv: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
verses.decoded: The heavens belong to you, and so does the earth; you created the world and everything in it.

verses.kjv: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
verses.decoded: You made the north and the south; even Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon will celebrate your name.

verses.kjv: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
verses.decoded: You have a powerful arm; your hand is strong, and your right hand is lifted high in strength.

verses.kjv: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
verses.decoded: Justice and fairness are the foundation of your throne; mercy and truth lead the way before you.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
verses.decoded: Blessed are those who hear the joyful message; they will live, LORD, in the light of your presence.

verses.kjv: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
verses.decoded: They will celebrate your name all day long, and they will be honored because of your righteousness.

verses.kjv: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
verses.decoded: You are the source of their strength and glory; because you favor us, our power will be lifted high.

verses.kjv: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.
verses.decoded: The LORD is our protector, and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

verses.kjv: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.decoded: Then you spoke in a vision to your chosen one and said, 'I have given strength to a mighty leader; I have raised up someone selected from the people.'

verses.kjv: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.decoded: I have found David, my servant, and I have anointed him with my sacred oil.

verses.kjv: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.decoded: My power will support him; my strength will make him strong.

verses.kjv: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.decoded: No enemy will overpower him, and no wicked person will harm him.

verses.kjv: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
verses.decoded: I will defeat his enemies right in front of him and punish those who hate him.

verses.kjv: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.decoded: My loyalty and kindness will always be with him, and his power will be lifted high because of my name.

verses.kjv: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
verses.decoded: I will give him power over the seas and rivers.

verses.kjv: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
verses.decoded: He will call to me, 'You are my father, my God, and the solid rock of my salvation.'

verses.kjv: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
verses.decoded: I will make him my firstborn, giving him a status above all the kings on earth.

verses.kjv: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.decoded: I will always show him mercy, and my covenant with him will never fail.

verses.kjv: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.decoded: I will make his descendants last forever, and his throne will endure as long as the heavens exist.

verses.kjv: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
verses.decoded: But if his descendants turn away from my law and do not follow my commands,

verses.kjv: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
verses.decoded: If they disrespect my laws and fail to obey my commands;

verses.kjv: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.decoded: Then I will punish their sins with discipline and correct their wrongdoing with punishment.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.decoded: But I will never completely remove my love from him, nor will I allow my faithfulness to fail.

verses.kjv: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
verses.decoded: I will not break my covenant or change what I have promised.

verses.kjv: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
verses.decoded: I have sworn by my holiness that I will never lie to David.

verses.kjv: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
verses.decoded: His descendants will last forever, and his throne will shine like the sun in my presence.

verses.kjv: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
verses.decoded: It will be firmly established forever like the moon, a reliable witness in the sky. Pause and think about this.

verses.kjv: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
verses.decoded: But you have rejected and despised him; you have been angry with your chosen king.

verses.kjv: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
verses.decoded: You have broken the covenant with your servant and thrown his crown to the ground in disgrace.

verses.kjv: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
verses.decoded: You have destroyed all his defenses and ruined his fortresses.

verses.kjv: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
verses.decoded: Everyone who passes by plunders him; he has become a disgrace to those around him.

verses.kjv: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.decoded: You have empowered his enemies and made all his foes celebrate.

verses.kjv: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.decoded: You have dulled his sword and have not let him stand strong in battle.

verses.kjv: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.decoded: You have taken away his honor and thrown his throne to the ground.

verses.kjv: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.decoded: You have cut short his youthful days and covered him with disgrace. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.decoded: How long, LORD? Will you keep yourself hidden forever? Will your anger continue to burn like fire?

verses.kjv: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
verses.decoded: Remember how brief my life is; why have you made all people meaningless?

verses.kjv: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
verses.decoded: Who is the person that lives and does not face death? Can anyone save their soul from the power of the grave? Pause and think about this.

verses.kjv: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
verses.decoded: Lord, where are your earlier acts of love and faithfulness that you promised to David?

verses.kjv: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
verses.decoded: Remember, Lord, the insults your servants have suffered; I carry the shame of many powerful people close to my heart.

verses.kjv: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
verses.decoded: Your enemies have insulted you, LORD; they have mocked the path of your chosen king.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.decoded: May the LORD be praised forever. Amen and Amen.

verses.kjv: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.decoded: Lord, you have been our home and refuge through every generation.

verses.kjv: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
verses.decoded: Before the mountains were created, before you made the earth and the world, you have always been God, from eternity to eternity.

verses.kjv: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
verses.decoded: You cause people to return to dust and say, 'Return, children of humans.'

verses.kjv: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
verses.decoded: To you, a thousand years are like yesterday that has already gone by, or like a few hours during the night.

verses.kjv: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
verses.decoded: You sweep people away like a flood; they are like a brief sleep. In the morning, they are like grass that grows fresh.

verses.kjv: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
verses.decoded: In the morning it flourishes and grows, but by evening it is cut down and withers.

verses.kjv: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
verses.decoded: We are destroyed by your anger and troubled by your wrath.

verses.kjv: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
verses.decoded: You have made our sins known to yourself; our hidden wrongs are exposed in your presence.

verses.kjv: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
verses.decoded: Because of your anger, all our days pass away; our years go by like a story that is told.

verses.kjv: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verses.decoded: Our lives usually last seventy years, or eighty if we are strong, but even then, they are filled with hard work and pain. Life ends quickly, and we are gone.

verses.kjv: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
verses.decoded: Who can understand the full power of your anger? Your wrath is as great as the fear you inspire.

verses.kjv: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
verses.decoded: Teach us to recognize how brief our lives are so that we may live wisely.

verses.kjv: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
verses.decoded: Come back, Lord! How long will this continue? Have mercy on your servants.

verses.kjv: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.decoded: Satisfy us with your love each morning so that we may rejoice and be glad all our lives.

verses.kjv: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.
verses.decoded: Make us happy in proportion to the difficult days and years we have endured.

verses.kjv: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
verses.decoded: May your deeds be visible to your servants, and may your glory be seen by their children.

verses.kjv: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
verses.decoded: May the Lord our God’s favor be with us; make the work we do successful and lasting.

verses.kjv: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.decoded: Anyone who lives close to God, the Most High, will find safety and protection under His power.

verses.kjv: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
verses.decoded: I declare that the LORD is my safe place and strong protector; I trust completely in Him.

verses.kjv: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
verses.decoded: God will rescue you from hidden traps set by enemies and from deadly diseases.

verses.kjv: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
verses.decoded: God will protect you like a bird shelters its young under its wings; His faithfulness will be your defense.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.decoded: You won’t fear dangers that come at night or attacks that happen during the day.

verses.kjv: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
verses.decoded: You won’t be afraid of deadly diseases spreading in the dark or disasters striking at midday.

verses.kjv: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.decoded: Thousands may fall around you, but harm will not come near you.

verses.kjv: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
verses.decoded: You will witness with your own eyes how the wicked are punished.

verses.kjv: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
verses.decoded: Since you have made the LORD your safe place and home,

verses.kjv: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
verses.decoded: No harm or disease will come near where you live.

verses.kjv: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.decoded: God will command His angels to protect you wherever you go.

verses.kjv: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.decoded: They will lift you up so you won’t hurt yourself by stumbling.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
verses.decoded: You will overcome dangerous enemies like lions and snakes, even powerful threats like dragons.

verses.kjv: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
verses.decoded: Because you love me, I will rescue you and honor you because you know and trust in me.

verses.kjv: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
verses.decoded: When you call to me, I will answer you. I will be with you in hard times, save you, and give you honor.

verses.kjv: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
verses.decoded: I will bless them with a long life and reveal to them my salvation.

verses.kjv: IT IS A GOOD THING TO GIVE THANKS UNTO THE LORD, AND TO SING PRAISES UNTO THY NAME, O MOST HIGH:
verses.decoded: This is a song for the Sabbath day. It is good to thank the LORD and to praise your name, O Most High God.

verses.kjv: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
verses.decoded: To declare your unfailing love in the morning and your faithfulness every evening.

verses.kjv: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
verses.decoded: Play music on a ten-stringed instrument, the psaltery, and the harp with a deep, thoughtful sound.

verses.kjv: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
verses.decoded: LORD, your works make me glad; I rejoice in what your hands have done.

verses.kjv: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.decoded: O LORD, your works are amazing, and your plans are beyond understanding.

verses.kjv: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
verses.decoded: A senseless person does not know this, and a fool cannot understand it.

verses.kjv: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
verses.decoded: Even when the wicked grow quickly like grass and sinners seem to prosper, they will be destroyed forever.

verses.kjv: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.
verses.decoded: But you, LORD, remain exalted forever.

verses.kjv: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.decoded: Look, LORD, your enemies will perish; all who do evil will be scattered.

verses.kjv: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
verses.decoded: But you will lift me up like a strong horn; I will be anointed with fresh oil.

verses.kjv: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
verses.decoded: My eyes will see my enemies defeated, and my ears will hear the downfall of the wicked who oppose me.

verses.kjv: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.decoded: The righteous will thrive like palm trees and grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.kjv: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.decoded: Those who are established in the LORD’s presence will flourish in God’s courts.

verses.kjv: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
verses.decoded: They will continue to bear fruit even in old age; they will stay healthy and vibrant.

verses.kjv: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.decoded: This shows that the LORD is just; he is my rock, and there is no wrongdoing in him.

verses.kjv: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
verses.decoded: The LORD rules as king, dressed in majesty and strength; he has wrapped himself in power. The world is firmly established and cannot be shaken.

verses.kjv: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
verses.decoded: Your throne has been established from ancient times; you have existed forever.

verses.kjv: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
verses.decoded: The floods roar loudly, O LORD; their waves rise and crash.

verses.kjv: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
