verses.decoded: But the LORD above is stronger than the roaring of many waters, even stronger than the powerful waves of the sea.

verses.kjv: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
verses.decoded: Your laws are completely trustworthy; holiness is fitting for your house, O LORD, forever.

verses.kjv: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
verses.decoded: O LORD God, the one who is rightful judge and avenger, show yourself now.

verses.kjv: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
verses.decoded: Rise up, you who judge the earth; give the proud what they deserve.

verses.kjv: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.decoded: LORD, how long will the wicked continue to succeed and prosper?

verses.kjv: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
verses.decoded: How long will they keep speaking harsh and arrogant words? How long will evildoers brag about themselves?

verses.kjv: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
verses.decoded: They crush your people, O LORD, and oppress those you have chosen.

verses.kjv: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
verses.decoded: They kill widows and foreigners, and murder orphans.

verses.kjv: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.
verses.decoded: But they say, 'The LORD won’t notice, and the God of Jacob won’t care.'

verses.kjv: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
verses.decoded: Pay attention, you foolish people; when will you become wise?

verses.kjv: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.decoded: The one who made the ear—won’t he hear? The one who formed the eye—won’t he see?

verses.kjv: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
verses.decoded: The one who disciplines nations—won’t he correct them? The one who teaches people knowledge—won’t he understand?

verses.kjv: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
verses.decoded: The LORD knows human thoughts; they are meaningless.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
verses.decoded: Blessed is the person you discipline, O LORD, and teach through your law;

verses.kjv: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.decoded: So that you may give him relief during hard times, until the wicked are punished.

verses.kjv: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.decoded: For the LORD will not reject his people or abandon those he owns.

verses.kjv: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.decoded: Justice will be restored, and all who are sincere will pursue it.

verses.kjv: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.decoded: Who will stand up for me against those who do evil? Who will defend me against those who commit wrongdoing?

verses.kjv: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
verses.decoded: If the LORD had not helped me, my spirit would have been silent and still.

verses.kjv: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
verses.decoded: When I felt like I was about to fall, your mercy, LORD, supported me.

verses.kjv: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.decoded: Though I have many worries, your comfort brings joy to my soul.

verses.kjv: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
verses.decoded: Can the throne of wickedness have any relationship with you, the one who creates evil plans through false laws?

verses.kjv: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.decoded: They band together against the righteous and accuse innocent people unjustly.

verses.kjv: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
verses.decoded: But the LORD is my protector; my God is my strong and safe shelter.

verses.kjv: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.
verses.decoded: He will repay them for their sins and destroy them because of their wickedness; yes, the LORD our God will destroy them.

verses.kjv: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.decoded: Come, let us sing to the LORD; let us shout joyfully to the rock who saves us.

verses.kjv: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
verses.decoded: Let us come before Him with thanks and sing joyful songs to Him.

verses.kjv: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
verses.decoded: The LORD is a great God and the supreme King above all other gods.

verses.kjv: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
verses.decoded: The depths of the earth and the strength of the mountains are in His hands.

verses.kjv: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
verses.decoded: The sea belongs to Him because He made it; His hands formed the dry land.

verses.kjv: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
verses.decoded: Come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD who made us.

verses.kjv: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.decoded: He is our God, and we are like sheep in His care. Today, if you listen to His voice,

verses.kjv: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.decoded: Do not harden your hearts like you did when you rebelled and were tested in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
verses.decoded: When your ancestors tested me, challenged me, and witnessed my miracles.

verses.kjv: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
verses.decoded: For forty years I was angry with that generation because they were stubborn and did not understand my ways.

verses.kjv: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
verses.decoded: So I promised in my anger that they would not enter my place of peace and rest.

verses.kjv: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
verses.decoded: Sing a new song to the Lord; sing to the Lord, all the earth.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.decoded: Sing to the Lord and praise his name; proclaim his salvation every day.

verses.kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
verses.decoded: Tell about his glory among the nations and his amazing deeds to all people.

verses.kjv: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.decoded: The Lord is great and deserves much praise; he is to be respected more than all other gods.

verses.kjv: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.decoded: All the gods of other nations are idols, but the Lord created the heavens.

verses.kjv: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.decoded: Honor and majesty surround him; strength and beauty fill his temple.

verses.kjv: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.decoded: All families of the nations, give the Lord glory and power.

verses.kjv: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.decoded: Give the Lord the glory that belongs to his name; bring an offering and come into his temple.

verses.kjv: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
verses.decoded: Worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness; let all the earth stand in awe of him.

verses.kjv: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
verses.decoded: Declare among the nations that the Lord is king; the world is firmly established and will not be shaken. He will judge the people fairly.

verses.kjv: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
verses.decoded: Let the heavens be joyful, let the earth be glad; let the sea roar and everything in it.

verses.kjv: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
verses.decoded: Let the fields be joyful, and everything in them; let all the trees of the forest sing for joy.

verses.kjv: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
verses.decoded: For the Lord is coming; he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world fairly and the people with truth.

verses.kjv: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
verses.decoded: The LORD rules over everything; let the whole earth be joyful, and let the many islands be glad.

verses.kjv: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
verses.decoded: Dark clouds and thick darkness surround him; his throne is established in righteousness and justice.

verses.kjv: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
verses.decoded: Fire moves ahead of him, destroying all his enemies nearby.

verses.kjv: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
verses.decoded: His lightning flashes light up the world; the earth saw it and shook with fear.

verses.kjv: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.decoded: The mountains melted like wax when the LORD, the ruler of the whole earth, appeared.

verses.kjv: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
verses.decoded: The skies proclaim his justice, and everyone sees his glory.

verses.kjv: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.
verses.decoded: Let everyone who worships carved idols be ashamed; but all you gods, worship him.

verses.kjv: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
verses.decoded: Zion heard this and was joyful; the people of Judah celebrated your just decisions, LORD.

verses.kjv: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.decoded: For you, LORD, are supreme over the whole earth; you are honored above all other gods.

verses.kjv: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.decoded: Those who love the LORD, hate what is evil; he protects the lives of his faithful and rescues them from evil people.

verses.kjv: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.decoded: Light shines for the righteous, and joy comes to those with honest hearts.

verses.kjv: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.decoded: Be glad in the LORD, you who are righteous; praise him when you remember how holy he is.

verses.kjv: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
verses.decoded: Sing a new song to the LORD because He has done amazing things. His powerful hand and holy strength have won the victory.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
verses.decoded: The LORD has revealed His salvation; He has clearly shown His righteousness to all nations.

verses.kjv: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.decoded: He has not forgotten His kindness and faithfulness to Israel; people everywhere have witnessed God's salvation.

verses.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
verses.decoded: Everyone on earth, shout joyfully to the LORD; make a loud sound, be happy, and sing praises.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
verses.decoded: Sing to the LORD using the harp and your voice to perform songs of praise.

verses.kjv: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
verses.decoded: Make joyful sounds with trumpets and horns before the LORD, the King.

verses.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.decoded: Let the sea and everything in it roar with joy; let the whole world and all its people celebrate.

verses.kjv: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
verses.decoded: Let the rivers applaud by clapping their hands; let the hills rejoice together.

verses.kjv: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
verses.decoded: This is because the LORD is coming to judge the earth; He will judge the world fairly and treat all people justly.

verses.kjv: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
verses.decoded: The LORD rules as king; all the people should respect and fear Him. He sits enthroned above the cherubim, and the earth shakes at His presence.

verses.kjv: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
verses.decoded: The LORD is mighty in Zion (Jerusalem) and exalted above everyone.

verses.kjv: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
verses.decoded: Let the people praise your powerful and awe-inspiring name, because it is holy.

verses.kjv: The king’s strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.decoded: The king’s power delights in justice; you establish fairness and carry out righteous judgment in Israel.

verses.kjv: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD our God and worship at His footstool, because He is holy.

verses.kjv: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
verses.decoded: Moses and Aaron were among His priests, and Samuel was one who called on His name; when they prayed, the LORD answered them.

verses.kjv: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
verses.decoded: God spoke to them through the cloudy pillar; they obeyed His laws and commands.

verses.kjv: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
verses.decoded: You answered them, LORD our God; you are a forgiving God, yet you punish those who persist in wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD our God and worship Him on His holy mountain, because the LORD our God is holy.

verses.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
verses.decoded: Shout happily to the LORD, all the earth!

verses.kjv: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
verses.decoded: Serve the LORD with happiness; come into his presence singing songs of joy.

verses.kjv: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.decoded: Remember that the LORD is God. He made us, and we belong to him; we are his people, like sheep cared for in his pasture.

verses.kjv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
verses.decoded: Come into his presence with thankfulness and praise; give thanks to him and honor his name.

verses.kjv: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
verses.decoded: The LORD is good. His love never ends, and his faithfulness lasts forever, through all generations.

verses.kjv: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
verses.decoded: I will sing about kindness and justice; Lord, I will sing to you.

verses.kjv: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.decoded: I will live wisely and with integrity. When will you come to me? I will live faithfully in my own home.

verses.kjv: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
verses.decoded: I will not look at anything evil; I hate the actions of those who do wrong, and I will not associate with them.

verses.kjv: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
verses.decoded: A twisted heart will stay away from me; I will not associate with evil people.

verses.kjv: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
verses.decoded: Anyone who secretly speaks badly about others I will remove; I will not tolerate arrogant and proud people.

verses.kjv: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
verses.decoded: I will watch over the faithful people in the land so they can live with me; those who live with integrity will serve me.

verses.kjv: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.decoded: Anyone who acts deceitfully will not live in my house; liars will not remain in my presence.

verses.kjv: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will quickly remove all the wicked from the land to eliminate evil from God's city.

verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.
verses.decoded: Lord, please listen to my prayer and hear my cry.

verses.kjv: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
verses.decoded: Don't turn away from me when I am in trouble; listen carefully and answer me quickly when I call.

verses.kjv: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
verses.decoded: My life is fading away like smoke, and my bones feel like they are burning.

verses.kjv: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.decoded: My heart is broken and weak like dried grass, so much that I forget to eat.

verses.kjv: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
verses.decoded: Because of my constant groaning, my bones feel like they are sticking to my skin.

verses.kjv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
verses.decoded: I feel lonely and isolated, like a pelican or an owl living alone in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
verses.decoded: I stay awake and feel as alone as a sparrow sitting by itself on a rooftop.

verses.kjv: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
verses.decoded: My enemies insult me constantly, and those who hate me have made a firm agreement against me.

verses.kjv: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.decoded: I have eaten ashes as if they were food, and mixed my drink with tears.

verses.kjv: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
verses.decoded: Because of your anger and wrath, you have raised me up and then brought me down.

verses.kjv: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
verses.decoded: My life is passing away quickly like a fading shadow, and I am weak like dried grass.

verses.kjv: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
verses.decoded: But you, Lord, will last forever, and people will remember you through all generations.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
verses.decoded: You will rise and show mercy to Zion, because the right time to help her has come.

verses.kjv: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
verses.decoded: Your servants love the very stones of Zion and cherish its dust.

verses.kjv: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
verses.decoded: Then the nations will respect the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth will honor your glory.

verses.kjv: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
verses.decoded: When the Lord restores Jerusalem, he will show his glory.

verses.kjv: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
verses.decoded: He listens to the prayers of the poor and will not ignore them.

verses.kjv: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
verses.decoded: This will be recorded for future generations, so that those yet to be born will praise the Lord.

verses.kjv: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
verses.decoded: For the Lord has looked down from his holy place in heaven and seen the earth.

verses.kjv: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.decoded: He listens to the cries of prisoners and frees those sentenced to death.

verses.kjv: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.decoded: He will make known the Lord’s name in Jerusalem and praise in Zion.

verses.kjv: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
verses.decoded: When all the peoples and nations come together to worship the Lord.

verses.kjv: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
verses.decoded: He has made me weak on my journey and shortened my life.

verses.kjv: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
verses.decoded: I prayed, 'Lord, don’t take me away in the middle of my life; your existence lasts forever.'

verses.kjv: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
verses.decoded: Long ago you established the earth’s foundation; the heavens are your creation.

verses.kjv: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
verses.decoded: They will all wear out and disappear, but you remain forever; like changing clothes, you renew them.

verses.kjv: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
verses.decoded: But you remain unchanged, and your life never ends.

verses.kjv: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
verses.decoded: The descendants of your servants will live on and be established in your presence.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD, my soul; everything inside me, praise his holy name.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all the good things he has done for you.

verses.kjv: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
verses.decoded: He forgives all your sins and heals all your illnesses.

verses.kjv: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
verses.decoded: He rescues your life from death and surrounds you with love and compassion.

verses.kjv: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
verses.decoded: He fills you with good things, renewing your strength like an eagle’s.

verses.kjv: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
verses.decoded: The LORD brings justice and fairness for all who are treated unfairly.

verses.kjv: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: He revealed his ways to Moses and showed his deeds to the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
verses.decoded: The LORD is kind and loving, patient, and full of mercy.

verses.kjv: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
verses.decoded: He doesn’t stay angry forever or keep punishing us endlessly.

verses.kjv: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
verses.decoded: He doesn’t treat us as our sins deserve or pay us back for our wrongs.

verses.kjv: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
verses.decoded: Just as the sky is far above the earth, so great is his mercy for those who respect him.

verses.kjv: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.decoded: He has taken our sins as far away from us as east is from west.

verses.kjv: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
verses.decoded: Just like a father feels compassion for his children, the LORD feels compassion for those who respect him.

verses.kjv: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
verses.decoded: He understands how we are made and remembers that we are fragile like dust.

verses.kjv: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
verses.decoded: People’s lives are like grass or flowers in a field—they bloom for a while and then fade.

verses.kjv: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
verses.decoded: Like a wind that blows over it and then it disappears, the place where it was will never recognize it again.

verses.kjv: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;
verses.decoded: But God's mercy lasts forever for those who respect Him, and His faithfulness extends to their grandchildren.

verses.kjv: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
verses.decoded: This is for those who obey His agreement and remember to follow His commands.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
verses.decoded: God has set up His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over everything.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD, you mighty angels who carry out His commands and listen carefully to His word.

verses.kjv: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD, all His armies and servants who do what He wants.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD, all His creations everywhere He rules; praise the LORD, my soul.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD, my soul. LORD my God, you are truly great; you are dressed in glory and majesty.

verses.kjv: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
verses.decoded: You cover yourself with light like a robe and spread out the sky like a curtain.

verses.kjv: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
verses.decoded: You set the beams of your palace over the waters; you make the clouds your chariot and ride on the wings of the wind.

verses.kjv: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
verses.decoded: You make your angels like spirits and your servants like blazing fire.

verses.kjv: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
verses.decoded: You established the earth’s foundations so it will never be shaken.

verses.kjv: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.decoded: You covered the earth with the deep waters like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.kjv: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
verses.decoded: When you commanded, the waters fled; when you thundered, they hurried away.

verses.kjv: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
verses.decoded: The waters flow up the mountains and down the valleys to the place you set for them.

verses.kjv: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
verses.decoded: You set limits so the waters cannot cross them and cover the earth again.

verses.kjv: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
verses.decoded: You send springs into the valleys that flow between the hills.

verses.kjv: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.decoded: These waters provide drink for every wild animal; even the wild donkeys satisfy their thirst.

verses.kjv: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
verses.decoded: Birds make their homes near these waters and sing from the branches.

verses.kjv: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
verses.decoded: You water the hills from your chambers; the earth is full and satisfied with what you have made.

verses.kjv: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
verses.decoded: You make grass grow for the cattle and plants for people to use, so they can produce food from the earth.

verses.kjv: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.
verses.decoded: You provide wine to cheer people’s hearts, oil to make their faces glow, and bread to strengthen them.

verses.kjv: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
verses.decoded: The trees that belong to the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which He has planted.

verses.kjv: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
verses.decoded: Birds build their nests there; the stork makes her home in the fir trees.

verses.kjv: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
verses.decoded: The high hills provide shelter for wild goats, and the rocks are a safe place for rock hyraxes.

verses.kjv: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
verses.decoded: He set the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.

verses.kjv: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
verses.decoded: You bring darkness, and it becomes night; then all the forest animals come out and move about.

verses.kjv: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
verses.decoded: Young lions roar as they hunt for their food, depending on God to provide.

verses.kjv: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
verses.decoded: When the sun rises, they come together and rest in their dens.

verses.kjv: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
verses.decoded: People go out to work and labor until evening.

verses.kjv: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
verses.decoded: O LORD, how many and varied are your works! You made them all with wisdom; the earth is full of your wealth.

verses.kjv: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
verses.decoded: The great and vast sea is full of countless living creatures, both small and large.

verses.kjv: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
verses.decoded: Ships sail there, and there is the Leviathan, which you formed to play in the sea.

verses.kjv: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
verses.decoded: All these creatures depend on you to provide their food at the right time.

verses.kjv: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
verses.decoded: When you give food, they gather it; when you open your hand, they are satisfied with good things.

verses.kjv: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
verses.decoded: If you hide your face, they become frightened; if you take away their breath, they die and return to dust.

verses.kjv: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
verses.decoded: When you send out your Spirit, life is created, and you renew the surface of the earth.

verses.kjv: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
verses.decoded: The LORD's glory will last forever; He takes joy in everything He has made.

verses.kjv: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
verses.decoded: When God looks at the earth, it shakes; when He touches the mountains, they release smoke.

verses.kjv: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.decoded: I will praise the LORD with songs all my life; I will worship God as long as I live.

verses.kjv: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
verses.decoded: Thinking about God brings me joy; I will be happy because of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: May sinners disappear from the earth and the wicked vanish. My soul, bless the LORD; praise the LORD!

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the LORD; call on His name and tell others about the amazing things He has done.

verses.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.decoded: Sing songs of praise to Him; speak about all the wonderful things He has done.

verses.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.decoded: Take pride in His holy name; may those who seek the LORD be filled with joy.

verses.kjv: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
verses.decoded: Look for the LORD and His power; always seek His presence.

verses.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.decoded: Remember the amazing things He has done, His miracles, and the promises He has spoken.

verses.kjv: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
verses.decoded: You descendants of Abraham, His servant, and children of Jacob, His chosen ones.

verses.kjv: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.decoded: The LORD is our God; His laws and decisions govern the whole earth.

verses.kjv: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
verses.decoded: He has kept His covenant forever, the promise He made to thousands of generations.

verses.kjv: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
verses.decoded: The covenant He made with Abraham and the oath He gave to Isaac;

verses.kjv: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
verses.decoded: He confirmed it to Jacob as a law and to Israel as an everlasting covenant.

verses.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
verses.decoded: He said, 'I will give you the land of Canaan as your inheritance.'

verses.kjv: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
verses.decoded: Back then, they were few in number, just a small group and foreigners in the land.

verses.kjv: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
verses.decoded: When they traveled from one nation to another, moving among different kingdoms and peoples;

verses.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
verses.decoded: God did not allow anyone to harm them; He even warned kings to protect them.

verses.kjv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Do not harm my chosen ones or my prophets.'

verses.kjv: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
verses.decoded: He also caused a famine in the land, breaking the entire supply of food.

verses.kjv: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
verses.decoded: He sent a man ahead of them—Joseph—who was sold as a slave.

verses.kjv: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
verses.decoded: They hurt his feet with chains; he was put in iron shackles.

verses.kjv: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
verses.decoded: Until the time came for his promise to be fulfilled; God’s word tested him.

verses.kjv: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
verses.decoded: The king sent for him and released him; the leader of the people set him free.

verses.kjv: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
verses.decoded: He made him master of his household and ruler over all his possessions.

verses.kjv: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
verses.decoded: He controlled the leaders as he wished and taught the officials wisdom.

verses.kjv: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.decoded: Israel (Jacob) and his family moved to Egypt and lived there temporarily.

verses.kjv: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.decoded: God made his people grow in number and become stronger than their enemies.

verses.kjv: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
verses.decoded: He caused the Egyptians to hate his people and mistreat his servants.

verses.kjv: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.decoded: God sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

verses.kjv: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.decoded: They performed God’s signs and miracles in Egypt.

verses.kjv: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
verses.decoded: God sent darkness over the land, and the Egyptians did not disobey his command.

verses.kjv: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.decoded: He turned the waters into blood, killing the fish.

verses.kjv: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.decoded: Frogs swarmed everywhere, even in the homes of their rulers.

verses.kjv: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
verses.decoded: He spoke, and various kinds of flies and lice appeared throughout their land.

verses.kjv: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
verses.decoded: He sent hail instead of rain, with fire flashing through the land.

verses.kjv: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
verses.decoded: He struck down their grapevines and fig trees and destroyed the trees in their territory.

verses.kjv: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
verses.decoded: He spoke, and locusts and caterpillars came in countless numbers,

verses.kjv: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.decoded: They ate all the plants in the land and destroyed all the crops.

verses.kjv: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
verses.decoded: He struck down all the firstborn in their land, the leaders of their power.

verses.kjv: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
verses.decoded: He brought them out carrying silver and gold, and not a weak person was among their tribes.

verses.kjv: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
verses.decoded: Egypt was glad when they left because they were afraid of them.

verses.kjv: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
verses.decoded: He spread a cloud to protect them and provided fire to light the night.

verses.kjv: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.decoded: The people asked, and He gave them quail and satisfied them with heavenly bread.

verses.kjv: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.decoded: He struck the rock, and water flowed out, running like a river through the dry land.

verses.kjv: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
verses.decoded: Because He remembered His holy promise to Abraham, His servant.

verses.kjv: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
verses.decoded: He brought His people out with joy and His chosen ones with singing.

verses.kjv: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
verses.decoded: He gave them the lands of other nations, and they took possession of the work of those peoples.

verses.kjv: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: So that they would obey His laws and keep His commands. Praise the LORD!

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD because he is good; his mercy lasts forever.

verses.kjv: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?
verses.decoded: Who can fully declare the mighty works of the LORD? Who can completely praise him?

verses.kjv: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
verses.decoded: Blessed are those who follow justice and always do what is right.

verses.kjv: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
verses.decoded: Remember me, LORD, with the kindness you show to your people; come to me with your salvation.

verses.kjv: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
verses.decoded: So I can witness the blessings on your chosen ones, rejoice with your people, and take pride in your inheritance.

verses.kjv: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
verses.decoded: We have sinned along with our ancestors; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.

verses.kjv: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
verses.decoded: Our ancestors did not understand your miracles in Egypt; they forgot your many mercies and angered you at the Red Sea.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
verses.decoded: Yet God saved them to honor his name and to show his mighty power.

verses.kjv: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
verses.decoded: He commanded the Red Sea to dry up, leading them through the waters like a dry desert.

verses.kjv: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.decoded: He rescued them from their enemies who hated them and redeemed them from their foes.

verses.kjv: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
verses.decoded: The waters overwhelmed their enemies; not one survived.

verses.kjv: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
verses.decoded: Then they believed God's promises and praised him with songs.

verses.kjv: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
verses.decoded: But they quickly forgot what God had done and did not wait for his guidance.

verses.kjv: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
verses.decoded: Instead, they craved greatly in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.

verses.kjv: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.decoded: God gave them what they wanted but caused their souls to suffer hunger and emptiness.

verses.kjv: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.
verses.decoded: They were jealous of Moses and also of Aaron, who was dedicated to the Lord.

verses.kjv: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.decoded: The ground opened up and swallowed Dathan and covered Abiram and their followers.

verses.kjv: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
verses.decoded: A fire broke out among them and burned up the wicked people.

verses.kjv: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
verses.decoded: They made a golden calf at Mount Horeb and worshiped the idol they had melted.

verses.kjv: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
verses.decoded: They traded their honor for the image of a bull that eats grass.

verses.kjv: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
verses.decoded: They forgot the God who saved them and performed great miracles in Egypt.

verses.kjv: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
verses.decoded: Amazing miracles in the land of Egypt, and powerful acts at the Red Sea.

verses.kjv: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
verses.decoded: God said He would destroy them, but Moses, His chosen one, intervened to stop His anger and save them.

verses.kjv: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
verses.decoded: They rejected the beautiful land and did not trust God's promise.

verses.kjv: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Instead, they complained in their tents and did not listen to the Lord’s voice.

verses.kjv: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
verses.decoded: So God raised His hand against them to defeat them in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
verses.decoded: He planned to destroy their descendants among the nations and scatter them across the lands.

verses.kjv: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.decoded: They worshiped Baal of Peor and ate food offered to idols.

verses.kjv: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
verses.decoded: They angered God with their sinful actions, and a plague broke out among them.

verses.kjv: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
verses.decoded: Then Phinehas took action and punished the offenders, and the plague stopped.

verses.kjv: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
verses.decoded: And this was credited to him as righteousness for all generations forever.

verses.kjv: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
verses.decoded: They also angered God at the waters of conflict, causing trouble for Moses because of them.

verses.kjv: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
verses.decoded: Because they provoked his spirit, Moses spoke carelessly with his words.

verses.kjv: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:
verses.decoded: They failed to destroy the nations that the LORD had commanded them to remove.

verses.kjv: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
verses.decoded: Instead, they mixed with the foreign peoples and adopted their practices.

verses.kjv: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
verses.decoded: They worshiped their idols, which became a trap for them.

verses.kjv: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
verses.decoded: They even sacrificed their sons and daughters to demons.

verses.kjv: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
verses.decoded: They spilled innocent blood—the blood of their own children—sacrificing them to the idols of Canaan, and the land was stained with this blood.

verses.kjv: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
verses.decoded: They became defiled by their own actions and committed spiritual unfaithfulness through their own ideas.

verses.kjv: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
verses.decoded: Because of this, the LORD’s anger burned against His people, and He rejected His own inheritance.

verses.kjv: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
verses.decoded: He handed them over to foreign nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.

verses.kjv: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.decoded: Their enemies oppressed them, and they were forced into submission.

verses.kjv: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
verses.decoded: Many times God rescued them, but they continued to anger Him with their plans and were humbled because of their sins.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
verses.decoded: Yet He paid attention to their suffering when He heard their cries for help.

verses.kjv: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.decoded: He remembered His covenant with them and showed compassion because of His great mercy.

verses.kjv: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
verses.decoded: He caused those who held them captive to feel compassion for them.

verses.kjv: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
verses.decoded: Save us, Lord our God, and bring us back from the nations so we can thank your holy name and celebrate your praise.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel, forever and ever! Let everyone say, 'Amen!' Praise the Lord!

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the LORD because he is good; his mercy lasts forever.

verses.kjv: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
verses.decoded: Let those whom the LORD has saved from their enemies say so.

verses.kjv: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
verses.decoded: He has gathered them from all over—east, west, north, and south.

verses.kjv: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
verses.decoded: They wandered alone in the wilderness and couldn’t find a city to live in.

verses.kjv: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.decoded: They were hungry and thirsty, and their strength gave out.

verses.kjv: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.decoded: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them from their suffering.

verses.kjv: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.decoded: He guided them on the right path to reach a city where they could live.

verses.kjv: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.decoded: May people praise the LORD for his goodness and his amazing works for humanity!

verses.kjv: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.decoded: He satisfies those who long for him and fills the hungry with good things.

verses.kjv: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
verses.decoded: Those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death, trapped in suffering and chains;

verses.kjv: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
verses.decoded: Because they rebelled against God’s commands and rejected the advice of the Most High,

verses.kjv: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
verses.decoded: He caused them to suffer greatly; they fell and had no one to help them.

verses.kjv: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.decoded: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them from their suffering.

verses.kjv: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
verses.decoded: He brought them out of darkness and death’s shadow and broke their chains apart.

verses.kjv: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.decoded: May people praise the LORD for his goodness and his amazing works for humanity!

verses.kjv: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.decoded: He has broken the strong bronze gates and cut through the iron bars.

verses.kjv: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
verses.decoded: Foolish people suffer because of their sins and wrongdoings.

verses.kjv: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
verses.decoded: Their spirit rejects all food, and they come close to death.

verses.kjv: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
verses.decoded: Then they call out to the LORD in their trouble, and He rescues them from their suffering.

verses.kjv: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
verses.decoded: He sent His message, healed them, and saved them from ruin.

verses.kjv: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.decoded: How I wish people would praise the LORD for His kindness and the amazing things He does for humanity!

verses.kjv: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
verses.decoded: Let them offer thanksgivings and joyfully tell others about His deeds.

verses.kjv: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
verses.decoded: Those who sail out on the sea and do business on the vast waters;

verses.kjv: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.decoded: They witness the LORD’s power and miracles in the ocean depths.

verses.kjv: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
verses.decoded: He commands the stormy wind, which raises the waves high.

verses.kjv: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
verses.decoded: The waves rise to the sky and then sink to the depths; those on the sea are terrified.

verses.kjv: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit’s end.
verses.decoded: They stagger back and forth like a drunk, completely overwhelmed and helpless.

verses.kjv: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
verses.decoded: Then they call out to the LORD in their trouble, and He rescues them from their distress.

verses.kjv: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
verses.decoded: He calms the storm and quiets the waves.

verses.kjv: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
verses.decoded: Then they are happy because the sea is calm, and He brings them safely to their destination.

verses.kjv: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.decoded: If only people would praise the LORD for His kindness and for the amazing things He does for humanity!

verses.kjv: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
verses.decoded: Let them honor Him publicly among the people and praise Him in the gathering of leaders.

verses.kjv: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
verses.decoded: He can turn flowing rivers into dry deserts and springs of water into dry land;

verses.kjv: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.decoded: He can change fertile land into barren salt flats because of the wickedness of those living there.

verses.kjv: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
verses.decoded: He can transform deserts into lakes and dry land into springs of water.

verses.kjv: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
verses.decoded: There He allows hungry people to settle and build a city to live in;

verses.kjv: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
verses.decoded: They plant crops and vineyards that produce abundant harvests.

verses.kjv: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.decoded: He blesses them so they multiply greatly and their livestock do not diminish.

verses.kjv: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
verses.decoded: But then they become few and weak again because of oppression, suffering, and grief.

verses.kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
verses.decoded: He brings disgrace on leaders and makes them wander lost in barren wastelands with no path.

verses.kjv: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
verses.decoded: But He lifts up the poor from their suffering and makes their families grow like a flock of sheep.

verses.kjv: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.decoded: The righteous will witness this and be glad, while all wrongdoing will be silenced.

verses.kjv: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Those who are wise and pay attention to these things will understand the LORD's faithful love.

verses.kjv: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.decoded: God, my heart is steady and determined; I will sing and praise you with all my being.

verses.kjv: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.decoded: Wake up, psaltery and harp; I will get up early to praise you.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.decoded: I will praise you, LORD, among your people and sing your praises among all nations.

verses.kjv: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.decoded: Your mercy is higher than the heavens, and your faithfulness reaches beyond the skies.

verses.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
verses.decoded: Be lifted high, God, above the heavens, and let your glory be over all the earth.

verses.kjv: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.decoded: Save your chosen ones; rescue them with your powerful right hand and answer me.

verses.kjv: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.decoded: God has spoken in holiness; I will be glad and distribute Shechem, dividing the valley of Succoth.

verses.kjv: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
verses.decoded: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine, Ephraim is the power of my head, and Judah is my leader.

verses.kjv: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
verses.decoded: Moab is like my basin; I will throw my shoe over Edom; I will conquer Philistia.

verses.kjv: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.decoded: Who will lead me into the fortified city? Who will guide me into Edom?

verses.kjv: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
verses.decoded: Won’t you, God, who has rejected us, go out with our armies?

verses.kjv: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.decoded: Help us in trouble, because human help is useless.

verses.kjv: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.decoded: With God’s help, we will be strong and victorious; he will defeat our enemies.

verses.kjv: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
verses.decoded: Do not stay silent, O God, whom I praise;

verses.kjv: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.decoded: Because wicked and deceitful people have spoken against me with lies.

verses.kjv: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
verses.decoded: They surrounded me with hateful words and attacked me without reason.

verses.kjv: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
verses.decoded: Even though they oppose me because of my love, I devote myself to prayer.

verses.kjv: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.decoded: They repay my kindness with evil and hate me for my love.

verses.kjv: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
verses.decoded: Appoint a wicked person to oppose him, and let an adversary stand at his right side.

verses.kjv: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
verses.decoded: When he is judged, let him be found guilty, and let his prayers be considered sinful.

verses.kjv: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
verses.decoded: May his life be short, and may someone else take his position.

verses.kjv: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.decoded: May his children be left without a father, and his wife become a widow.

verses.kjv: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
verses.decoded: May his children wander as beggars, searching for food even in ruined places.

verses.kjv: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
verses.decoded: May thieves take everything he owns, and strangers steal the fruit of his work.

verses.kjv: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
verses.decoded: May no one show him mercy or care for his orphaned children.

verses.kjv: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.decoded: May his descendants be destroyed, and may their name disappear in the next generation.

verses.kjv: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.decoded: May the LORD remember the sins of his ancestors and not forgive his mother's sins.

verses.kjv: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.decoded: May their sins remain before the LORD always, so He will erase their memory from the earth.

verses.kjv: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
verses.decoded: Because he refused to show mercy and instead oppressed the poor and needy, even trying to kill those who are brokenhearted.

verses.kjv: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
verses.decoded: Since he loved to curse, may curses come upon him; because he did not enjoy blessings, may they be far from him.

verses.kjv: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
verses.decoded: He wrapped himself in curses like a garment; may those curses penetrate deep inside him, like water and oil reaching his bones.

verses.kjv: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.decoded: May the curse be like the clothes he wears and the belt he always has on.

verses.kjv: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
verses.decoded: May this be the punishment from the LORD for my enemies and those who speak evil against me.

verses.kjv: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
verses.decoded: But do this for me, O God, for the sake of your name; because your mercy is great, save me.

verses.kjv: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.decoded: I am poor and needy, and my heart is deeply hurt.

verses.kjv: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
verses.decoded: I disappear like a fading shadow; I am tossed around like a locust in the wind.

verses.kjv: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
verses.decoded: My knees grow weak from fasting, and my body wastes away.

verses.kjv: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
verses.decoded: I have become a disgrace to them; when they see me, they shake their heads in scorn.

verses.kjv: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
verses.decoded: Help me, LORD my God; save me because of your mercy.

verses.kjv: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.
verses.decoded: So they will know that it is your doing, LORD, that you have done this.

verses.kjv: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
verses.decoded: Let them curse, but you bless; when they stand up, may they be ashamed, but let your servant rejoice.

verses.kjv: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
verses.decoded: May my enemies be wrapped in shame and cover themselves with their own disgrace like a cloak.

verses.kjv: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.decoded: I will praise the LORD loudly with my voice; yes, I will praise him among many people.

verses.kjv: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
verses.decoded: He will stand beside the poor, ready to save them from those who wrongly judge and condemn their lives.

verses.kjv: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.decoded: The LORD said to my Lord, 'Sit at my right side until I put your enemies under your feet.'

verses.kjv: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
verses.decoded: The LORD will send your powerful scepter from Zion; rule firmly among your enemies.

verses.kjv: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.decoded: Your people will willingly follow you on the day you show your power, dressed in holy splendor from the dawn; you are like fresh morning dew.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.decoded: The LORD has made a solemn promise and will not change His mind: You are a priest forever, following the example of Melchizedek.

verses.kjv: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.decoded: The Lord, standing at your right side, will defeat kings on the day He shows His anger.

verses.kjv: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
verses.decoded: He will judge the nations, fill the lands with dead bodies, and strike down leaders across many countries.

verses.kjv: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
verses.decoded: He will refresh himself by drinking from a stream along the way; therefore, he will hold his head high in victory.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD! I will praise the LORD with all my heart, among the righteous and in the gathered assembly.

verses.kjv: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.decoded: The LORD’s works are great and admired by all who delight in them.

verses.kjv: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: His deeds are honorable and glorious; his righteousness lasts forever.

verses.kjv: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.decoded: He has made his amazing works memorable; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

verses.kjv: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.decoded: He provides food for those who fear him; he always remembers his covenant.

verses.kjv: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
verses.decoded: He has shown his people the power of his works, so they may inherit the lands of other nations.

verses.kjv: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
verses.decoded: Everything God has made is true and just; all his commands are reliable.

verses.kjv: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.decoded: They remain firmly established forever, carried out in truth and fairness.

verses.kjv: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
verses.decoded: He has provided redemption for his people and established his covenant forever; his name is holy and worthy of respect.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Respecting the LORD is the start of wisdom; those who obey his commands gain good understanding. His praise lasts forever.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the person who respects the LORD and finds great joy in following His commands.

verses.kjv: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.decoded: His children will be strong and influential on earth; the descendants of the righteous will be blessed.

verses.kjv: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: His home will be filled with wealth and prosperity, and his integrity will last forever.

verses.kjv: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.decoded: For the honest person, light shines even in dark times; he is kind, compassionate, and just.

verses.kjv: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.decoded: A good person is generous and willing to lend; he manages his affairs wisely and with good judgment.

verses.kjv: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.decoded: He will never be shaken; the righteous will be remembered forever.

verses.kjv: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
verses.decoded: He will not fear bad news because his heart is steady, trusting in the LORD.

verses.kjv: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
verses.decoded: His heart is firm and he will not be afraid until he sees his wishes fulfilled against his enemies.

verses.kjv: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.decoded: He has shared and given to the poor; his righteousness lasts forever, and he will be honored and respected.

verses.kjv: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.decoded: The wicked will see this and be upset; they will grind their teeth and disappear, because their hopes will fail.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, you servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
verses.decoded: May the name of the LORD be praised now and forever.

verses.kjv: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’s name is to be praised.
verses.decoded: From sunrise to sunset, the LORD’s name should be praised.

verses.kjv: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
verses.decoded: The LORD is exalted above all nations, and His glory is higher than the heavens.

verses.kjv: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
verses.decoded: Who is like the LORD our God, who lives on high?

verses.kjv: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
verses.decoded: He humbles Himself to look down on the things in heaven and on earth!

verses.kjv: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
verses.decoded: He lifts the poor from the dust and raises the needy from the garbage heap;

verses.kjv: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.decoded: to give them a place among princes, even among the princes of His people.

verses.kjv: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: He makes the barren woman live in a home and be a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!

verses.kjv: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.decoded: When Israel left Egypt, the family of Jacob left a land of foreign language and culture;

verses.kjv: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
verses.decoded: Judah became God's holy place, and Israel became His kingdom.

verses.kjv: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
verses.decoded: The sea saw this and fled; the Jordan River was pushed back.

verses.kjv: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
verses.decoded: The mountains jumped like rams, and the small hills like young sheep.

verses.kjv: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
verses.decoded: Why did you, O sea, run away? Why were you pushed back, O Jordan River?

verses.kjv: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
verses.decoded: Why did you, mountains, jump like rams, and you small hills like lambs?

verses.kjv: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
verses.decoded: Earth, shake in fear before the Lord, the God of Jacob;

verses.kjv: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.decoded: Who turned solid rock into flowing water, and hard flint into a spring.

verses.kjv: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake.
verses.decoded: Not to us, Lord, not to us, but to your name be the glory because of your mercy and faithfulness.

verses.kjv: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
verses.decoded: Why should the nations say, 'Where is their God now?'

verses.kjv: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
verses.decoded: But our God is in heaven; He does whatever He wants.

verses.kjv: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.decoded: Their idols are made of silver and gold, crafted by human hands.

verses.kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
