verses.decoded: They have mouths but cannot speak; they have eyes but cannot see.

verses.kjv: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
verses.decoded: They have ears but cannot hear; they have noses but cannot smell.

verses.kjv: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
verses.decoded: They have hands but cannot feel; feet but cannot walk; they make no sound with their throats.

verses.kjv: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.decoded: Those who make idols are like them, and so are all who trust in them.

verses.kjv: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
verses.decoded: Israel, trust in the LORD; He is their help and shield.

verses.kjv: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
verses.decoded: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD; He is your help and shield.

verses.kjv: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
verses.decoded: All who fear the LORD, trust in Him; He is your help and shield.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.decoded: The LORD has remembered us and will bless us—He will bless Israel and the house of Aaron.

verses.kjv: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.
verses.decoded: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both the humble and the mighty.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.decoded: The LORD will increase you and your children more and more.

verses.kjv: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
verses.decoded: You are blessed by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

verses.kjv: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD’s: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
verses.decoded: The sky and everything above belongs to the LORD, but he has given the earth to humanity.

verses.kjv: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.
verses.decoded: Those who have died do not praise the LORD; those who have gone into silence cannot worship Him.

verses.kjv: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.
verses.decoded: But we will praise the LORD now and forever. Praise the LORD!

verses.kjv: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
verses.decoded: I love the LORD because he listened to me when I called out and prayed.

verses.kjv: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
verses.decoded: Because he turned his ear to listen to me, I will pray to him all my life.

verses.kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.decoded: I was surrounded by the fear of death and the pains of the grave held me tight; I experienced distress and sadness.

verses.kjv: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
verses.decoded: Then I called out to the LORD, saying, 'LORD, please save my life.'

verses.kjv: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
verses.decoded: The LORD is kind and just; our God is full of mercy.

verses.kjv: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
verses.decoded: The LORD protects those who are vulnerable; I was in trouble, and he helped me.

verses.kjv: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.decoded: Rest now, my soul, for the LORD has been generous to you.

verses.kjv: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.decoded: You saved my life from death, wiped away my tears, and kept me from stumbling.

verses.kjv: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.decoded: I will live and follow the LORD while I am alive.

verses.kjv: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
verses.decoded: I trusted God, so I spoke out, even though I was deeply troubled.

verses.kjv: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
verses.decoded: In my panic, I said, 'Everyone is untrustworthy.'

verses.kjv: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
verses.decoded: What can I give back to the LORD for all the good things he has done for me?

verses.kjv: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will accept salvation and call on the LORD’s name.

verses.kjv: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
verses.decoded: I will fulfill my promises to the LORD publicly, among all his people.

verses.kjv: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
verses.decoded: The death of God’s faithful people is very valuable to the LORD.

verses.kjv: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
verses.decoded: Lord, I am truly your servant; I belong to you, just like a child belongs to their mother. You have freed me from my troubles.

verses.kjv: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will give you a thankful offering and will call on the name of the Lord.

verses.kjv: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,
verses.decoded: I will fulfill my promises to the Lord openly, in front of all his people.

verses.kjv: In the courts of the LORD’s house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will do this in the temple courts, right here in Jerusalem. Praise the Lord!

verses.kjv: O Praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
verses.decoded: Everyone in all nations, praise the LORD; all people, give him your praise.

verses.kjv: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: Because God’s loving kindness is great toward us, and His faithfulness lasts forever. Praise the LORD!

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the LORD because He is good; His mercy lasts forever.

verses.kjv: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Let Israel declare that His mercy lasts forever.

verses.kjv: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Let the priests, descendants of Aaron, say that His mercy lasts forever.

verses.kjv: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Let those who respect and honor the LORD say that His mercy lasts forever.

verses.kjv: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.
verses.decoded: I cried out to the LORD when I was in trouble; He answered me and gave me freedom and safety.

verses.kjv: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
verses.decoded: The LORD is with me, so I will not be afraid. What can anyone do to me?

verses.kjv: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
verses.decoded: The LORD supports me alongside those who help me; so I will see my enemies defeated.

verses.kjv: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
verses.decoded: It is safer to trust the LORD than to rely on people.

verses.kjv: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
verses.decoded: It is better to trust the LORD than to depend on rulers or leaders.

verses.kjv: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
verses.decoded: Enemies from all nations surrounded me, but I will defeat them by the power of the LORD.

verses.kjv: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
verses.decoded: They surrounded me on all sides, but I will overcome them through the LORD’s name.

verses.kjv: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
verses.decoded: They swarmed around me like bees, but they will be put out like burning thorns; I will defeat them by the LORD’s name.

verses.kjv: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
verses.decoded: They tried hard to make me fall, but the LORD helped me stand.

verses.kjv: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
verses.decoded: The LORD is my strength and my song; He has become my salvation.

verses.kjv: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
verses.decoded: There is joy and victory in the homes of the righteous because the LORD’s powerful hand brings success.

verses.kjv: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
verses.decoded: The LORD's powerful hand is lifted high; His strong hand does mighty things.

verses.kjv: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will not die but live, and I will proclaim what the LORD has done.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
verses.decoded: The LORD has disciplined me severely, but He did not let me die.

verses.kjv: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:
verses.decoded: Open the gates of righteousness for me; I will enter and praise the LORD.

verses.kjv: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
verses.decoded: This is the LORD’s gate, through which the righteous will enter.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
verses.decoded: I will praise You because You have listened to me and saved me.

verses.kjv: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
verses.decoded: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

verses.kjv: This is the LORD’s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
verses.decoded: This is the LORD’s work; it is wonderful to us.

verses.kjv: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.decoded: This is the day the LORD has made; let us rejoice and be glad today.

verses.kjv: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
verses.decoded: Save us now, LORD; please, LORD, send us success.

verses.kjv: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the LORD; we bless you from the LORD’s house.

verses.kjv: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
verses.decoded: God is the LORD who has given us light; tie the sacrifice firmly to the altar’s horns.

verses.kjv: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
verses.decoded: You are my God, and I will praise You; You are my God, I will honor You.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the LORD because He is good; His mercy lasts forever.

verses.kjv: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Happy are those who live without fault and follow the LORD’s teachings.

verses.kjv: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
verses.decoded: Happy are those who obey His commands and earnestly seek Him with all their heart.

verses.kjv: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
verses.decoded: They do no wrong but live according to His ways.

verses.kjv: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
verses.decoded: You have commanded us to carefully obey your instructions.

verses.kjv: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
verses.decoded: I wish my life would be guided to follow your laws!

verses.kjv: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
verses.decoded: Then I will not be ashamed when I obey all your commands.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
verses.decoded: I will praise you sincerely when I understand your just decisions.

verses.kjv: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
verses.decoded: I will obey your laws; please do not completely abandon me.

verses.kjv: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
verses.decoded: How can a young person live a pure life? By carefully following your word.

verses.kjv: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
verses.decoded: I have searched for you with all my heart; please don’t let me stray from your commands.

verses.kjv: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.decoded: I have stored your word in my heart so I won’t sin against you.

verses.kjv: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
verses.decoded: You are blessed, LORD; please teach me your laws.

verses.kjv: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
verses.decoded: I have spoken aloud all the decisions you have made.

verses.kjv: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.decoded: I find joy in following your teachings as much as in great wealth.

verses.kjv: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
verses.decoded: I will think deeply about your instructions and honor your ways.

verses.kjv: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
verses.decoded: I will find joy in your laws; I will always remember your word.

verses.kjv: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
verses.decoded: GIMEL. Be generous to your servant so I may live and obey your word.

verses.kjv: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
verses.decoded: Open my eyes so I can see the amazing things in your law.

verses.kjv: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.decoded: I am a stranger on this earth; don’t hide your commandments from me.

verses.kjv: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
verses.decoded: My soul is deeply longing for your laws all the time.

verses.kjv: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
verses.decoded: You have corrected the proud and cursed who stray from your commandments.

verses.kjv: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
verses.decoded: Take away shame and disgrace from me because I have obeyed your laws.

verses.kjv: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
verses.decoded: Even leaders spoke against me, but I focused on meditating on your laws.

verses.kjv: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
verses.decoded: Your laws are my joy and my advisors.

verses.kjv: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.decoded: DALETH. My soul is close to death; give me life according to your word.

verses.kjv: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
verses.decoded: I have told you my path, and you listened; now teach me your laws.

verses.kjv: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
verses.decoded: Help me understand your commands so I can speak of your amazing deeds.

verses.kjv: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
verses.decoded: My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow; strengthen me with your word.

verses.kjv: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
verses.decoded: Keep me away from falsehood; graciously give me your law.

verses.kjv: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
verses.decoded: I have chosen the path of truth and have set your laws before me.

verses.kjv: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
verses.decoded: I have held firmly to your teachings; Lord, don’t let me be put to shame.

verses.kjv: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
verses.decoded: I will eagerly follow your commands when you give me a willing and open heart.

verses.kjv: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
verses.decoded: Teach me, Lord, the way of your laws, and I will obey them completely.

verses.kjv: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
verses.decoded: Give me understanding so I can obey your law fully and sincerely.

verses.kjv: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.decoded: Lead me in the path of your commands, because I find joy in following them.

verses.kjv: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.decoded: Turn my heart toward your teachings, not toward greed or selfish desires.

verses.kjv: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
verses.decoded: Keep my eyes from looking at worthless things; give me life by guiding me in your way.

verses.kjv: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
verses.decoded: Make your word firm and reliable for your servant who reveres you.

verses.kjv: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
verses.decoded: Remove the shame I dread, because your laws are good.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
verses.decoded: I have eagerly desired your commands; bring me to life through your righteousness.

verses.kjv: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
verses.decoded: Lord, let your loving kindness and salvation come to me, just as you promised.

verses.kjv: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
verses.decoded: Then I will have a reply for those who insult me, because I trust your word.

verses.kjv: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
verses.decoded: Don’t ever take away the truth from my lips, because I rely on your laws.

verses.kjv: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: I will obey your law forever without stopping.

verses.kjv: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
verses.decoded: I will live freely because I follow your commands.

verses.kjv: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.decoded: I will talk about your teachings even in front of kings, and I will not feel embarrassed.

verses.kjv: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
verses.decoded: I will find joy in your commandments because I love them.

verses.kjv: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
verses.decoded: I will raise my hands in respect to your commandments, which I love, and I will think deeply about your laws.

verses.kjv: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
verses.decoded: Remember your promise to your servant, which has given me hope.

verses.kjv: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
verses.decoded: Your word gives me comfort during my troubles; it has revived me.

verses.kjv: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
verses.decoded: Proud people have mocked me, but I have not turned away from your law.

verses.kjv: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
verses.decoded: I recalled your ancient decisions, Lord, and that gave me comfort.

verses.kjv: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
verses.decoded: I am filled with horror because of those wicked people who abandon your law.

verses.kjv: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.decoded: Your laws have been like songs to me while I am away from home.

verses.kjv: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
verses.decoded: I have thought about your name, Lord, during the night and have obeyed your law.

verses.kjv: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
verses.decoded: I have this blessing because I have obeyed your commands.

verses.kjv: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
verses.decoded: You are my inheritance, Lord; I have promised to obey your words.

verses.kjv: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
verses.decoded: I earnestly asked for your favor with all my heart; please be kind to me as you promised.

verses.kjv: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.decoded: I considered my actions and turned to follow your teachings.

verses.kjv: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
verses.decoded: I hurried and did not wait to obey your commandments.

verses.kjv: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.decoded: Groups of evil people have trapped me, but I have not forgotten your law.

verses.kjv: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.decoded: At midnight I get up to thank you for your fair and just decisions.

verses.kjv: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
verses.decoded: I am a friend to everyone who respects you and follows your commands.

verses.kjv: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
verses.decoded: Lord, your mercy fills the whole earth; please teach me your laws.

verses.kjv: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
verses.decoded: You have treated your servant well, Lord, just as you promised.

verses.kjv: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
verses.decoded: Teach me to make wise decisions and gain understanding because I trust your commands.

verses.kjv: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
verses.decoded: Before I suffered, I wandered away, but now I obey your word.

verses.kjv: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
verses.decoded: You are good and do good things; please teach me your laws.

verses.kjv: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
verses.decoded: Proud people have lied about me, but I will fully obey your rules with all my heart.

verses.kjv: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
verses.decoded: Their hearts are selfish and greedy, but I find joy in your law.

verses.kjv: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
verses.decoded: It is good that I have suffered because it helped me learn your laws.

verses.kjv: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.decoded: Your words are worth more to me than thousands of gold and silver coins.

verses.kjv: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
verses.decoded: You made me with your hands; please give me understanding so I can learn your commands.

verses.kjv: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
verses.decoded: Those who respect you will be happy to see me because I trust in your word.

verses.kjv: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
verses.decoded: Lord, I know your decisions are fair, and you have faithfully allowed me to suffer.

verses.kjv: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.decoded: Please let your loving kindness comfort me, just as you promised in your word to your servant.

verses.kjv: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
verses.decoded: May your tender mercy come to me so that I may live, because I find joy in your law.

verses.kjv: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
verses.decoded: May the proud be put to shame because they treated me wrongly without reason; but I will focus on your teachings.

verses.kjv: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
verses.decoded: May those who respect you turn to me, along with those who understand your laws.

verses.kjv: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
verses.decoded: Keep my heart steady in following your laws so that I will not be ashamed.

verses.kjv: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
verses.decoded: My soul is weary waiting for your salvation, but I continue to trust your word.

verses.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.decoded: My eyes grow tired waiting for your promise, asking, 'When will you comfort me?'

verses.kjv: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
verses.decoded: I feel worn out like a bottle exposed to smoke, but I have not forgotten your laws.

verses.kjv: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.decoded: How long will your servant endure? When will you judge those who persecute me?

verses.kjv: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
verses.decoded: The proud have set traps for me that go against your law.

verses.kjv: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
verses.decoded: All your commands are trustworthy, but I am being wrongly persecuted; please help me.

verses.kjv: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
verses.decoded: They nearly destroyed me on earth, but I have not abandoned your teachings.

verses.kjv: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
verses.decoded: Revive me with your loving kindness, and I will obey your instructions.

verses.kjv: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
verses.decoded: Lord, your word is established forever in heaven.

verses.kjv: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
verses.decoded: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; you created the earth, and it remains.

verses.kjv: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
verses.decoded: Your laws still stand today because everyone serves you.

verses.kjv: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.decoded: If I had not found joy in your law, I would have been destroyed during my troubles.

verses.kjv: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.decoded: I will always remember your instructions because they have given me life.

verses.kjv: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
verses.decoded: I belong to you; save me because I have looked for your teachings.

verses.kjv: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.decoded: Evil people are waiting to harm me, but I will focus on your promises.

verses.kjv: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.decoded: I have realized that nothing is perfect, but your command is vast and endless.

verses.kjv: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
verses.decoded: Oh, how I love your law! I think about it all day long.

verses.kjv: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
verses.decoded: Your commandments have made me wiser than my enemies because I always keep them with me.

verses.kjv: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.decoded: I understand more than all my teachers because I think deeply about your promises.

verses.kjv: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
verses.decoded: I have more insight than the elders because I follow your instructions.

verses.kjv: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
verses.decoded: I have avoided every wrong path so that I can obey your word.

verses.kjv: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
verses.decoded: I have not turned away from your laws because you have taught me.

verses.kjv: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.decoded: Your words are so sweet to me, even sweeter than honey in my mouth!

verses.kjv: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
verses.decoded: Your instructions give me understanding, so I hate every false path.

verses.kjv: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.decoded: Your word is like a lamp that lights my feet and a light that guides my path.

verses.kjv: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
verses.decoded: I have made a solemn promise, and I will keep it: to obey your just laws.

verses.kjv: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
verses.decoded: I am deeply troubled; please revive me, Lord, by your promise.

verses.kjv: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
verses.decoded: Please accept my sincere prayers, Lord, and teach me your laws.

verses.kjv: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.decoded: My life is always at risk, yet I do not forget your law.

verses.kjv: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
verses.decoded: Evil people have set traps for me, but I have not turned away from your teachings.

verses.kjv: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.decoded: I have accepted your laws as my eternal inheritance because they bring joy to my heart.

verses.kjv: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
verses.decoded: I am determined to obey your rules always, until the very end.

verses.kjv: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
verses.decoded: I hate worthless ideas, but I love your law.

verses.kjv: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
verses.decoded: You are my refuge and my protection; I trust in your promises.

verses.kjv: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
verses.decoded: Stay away from me, you who do wrong, because I follow God’s commandments.

verses.kjv: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.decoded: Support me by your promise so I may live, and don’t let me be ashamed of my trust in you.

verses.kjv: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
verses.decoded: Keep me steady and I will be safe; I will always obey your laws.

verses.kjv: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
verses.decoded: You have defeated everyone who turns away from your laws because their lies are worthless.

verses.kjv: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.decoded: You remove all the wicked from the earth like worthless impurities; that’s why I love your laws.

verses.kjv: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
verses.decoded: My body shakes with fear of you; I am afraid of your decisions.

verses.kjv: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.decoded: I have acted with fairness and justice; do not abandon me to those who oppress me.

verses.kjv: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
verses.decoded: Guarantee the safety of your servant; do not let the proud harm me.

verses.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
verses.decoded: My eyes grow weak as I long for your salvation and your righteous promises.

verses.kjv: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
verses.decoded: Treat your servant with mercy and teach me your laws.

verses.kjv: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
verses.decoded: I am your servant; please give me understanding so I can learn your teachings.

verses.kjv: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
verses.decoded: Lord, it is time for you to act because they have ignored your law.

verses.kjv: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.decoded: That is why I love your commandments more than the finest gold.

verses.kjv: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
verses.decoded: I consider all your rules to be right, and I hate every false path.

verses.kjv: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.decoded: Your teachings are wonderful, so my soul obeys them.

verses.kjv: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.decoded: Your words bring light and give understanding to those who are simple.

verses.kjv: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
verses.decoded: I opened my mouth and gasped because I deeply longed for your commandments.

verses.kjv: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
verses.decoded: Look upon me and be merciful, just as you always are to those who love your name.

verses.kjv: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.decoded: Guide my steps by your word, and don’t let sin control me.

verses.kjv: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
verses.decoded: Rescue me from human oppression, and I will obey your laws.

verses.kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
verses.decoded: Let your favor shine on your servant, and teach me your laws.

verses.kjv: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
verses.decoded: Tears stream down my eyes because those around me do not follow your law.

verses.kjv: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
verses.decoded: You, LORD, are righteous, and your decisions are fair and just.

verses.kjv: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
verses.decoded: The laws you have given are right and completely trustworthy.

verses.kjv: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
verses.decoded: My passion overwhelms me because my enemies ignore your teachings.

verses.kjv: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
verses.decoded: Your word is pure and refined; that’s why I love it deeply.

verses.kjv: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
verses.decoded: I may be insignificant and looked down upon, but I never forget your commands.

verses.kjv: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
verses.decoded: Your righteousness lasts forever, and your law is completely true.

verses.kjv: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
verses.decoded: I am overwhelmed by trouble and pain, but your commands bring me joy.

verses.kjv: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.decoded: Your laws are forever right; please give me understanding so I may live.

verses.kjv: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
verses.decoded: With all my heart I cried out; hear me, LORD, and I will obey your laws.

verses.kjv: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
verses.decoded: I called out to you; save me so that I may obey your teachings.

verses.kjv: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
verses.decoded: Before dawn, I rose and cried out, placing my hope in your word.

verses.kjv: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
verses.decoded: I stay awake through the night, meditating on your word.

verses.kjv: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
verses.decoded: Hear me with your unfailing love, LORD; give me life according to your justice.

verses.kjv: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
verses.decoded: Those who do evil come close to harm; they have turned away from your law.

verses.kjv: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
verses.decoded: You, Lord, are close to me, and all your commands are true.

verses.kjv: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.decoded: I have known from long ago that your laws are established forever.

verses.kjv: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
verses.decoded: Remember my suffering and rescue me, because I have not forgotten your law.

verses.kjv: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
verses.decoded: Defend my case and save me; bring me to life by your promises.

verses.kjv: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
verses.decoded: Salvation is distant from the wicked because they do not seek your laws.

verses.kjv: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
verses.decoded: Lord, your loving kindness is abundant; bring me to life according to your decisions.

verses.kjv: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
verses.decoded: I have many enemies and those who persecute me, but I do not turn away from your laws.

verses.kjv: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
verses.decoded: I saw those who break your laws and was deeply saddened because they do not follow your word.

verses.kjv: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.decoded: See how much I love your rules; bring me to life, Lord, because of your unfailing love.

verses.kjv: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Your word has been true from the start, and all your just decisions last forever.

verses.kjv: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
verses.decoded: Leaders have unfairly persecuted me, but I respect and fear your word.

verses.kjv: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.decoded: I am joyful because of your word, like someone who discovers a great treasure.

verses.kjv: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
verses.decoded: I hate and detest lies, but I love your law.

verses.kjv: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.decoded: I praise you seven times a day because of your just decisions.

verses.kjv: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
verses.decoded: Those who love your law experience great peace, and nothing will cause them to stumble.

verses.kjv: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
verses.decoded: Lord, I have trusted in your salvation and have obeyed your commands.

verses.kjv: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.decoded: My soul has followed your teachings, and I love them very much.

verses.kjv: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
verses.decoded: I have obeyed your rules and teachings because you see everything I do.

verses.kjv: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.decoded: Let my prayer come close to you, Lord; give me understanding based on your word.

verses.kjv: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
verses.decoded: Let my request come before you; save me as you have promised in your word.

verses.kjv: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
verses.decoded: My lips will praise you when you teach me your laws.

verses.kjv: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.decoded: My tongue will speak about your word because all your commands are right and just.

verses.kjv: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.decoded: Please help me with your hand, because I have chosen to follow your rules.

verses.kjv: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
verses.decoded: I have eagerly waited for your salvation, Lord, and your law brings me joy.

verses.kjv: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
verses.decoded: Let my soul live so it can praise you, and let your decisions support me.

verses.kjv: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.decoded: I have wandered away like a lost sheep; please find me, your servant, because I have not forgotten your commands.

verses.kjv: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
verses.decoded: When I was in trouble, I called out to the LORD, and He listened to me.

verses.kjv: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.decoded: Save me, LORD, from people who speak lies and use deceitful words.

verses.kjv: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
verses.decoded: What punishment should come to you, false tongue? What will you receive for your lies?

verses.kjv: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.decoded: Like sharp arrows from a strong warrior and burning coals from juniper wood.

verses.kjv: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.decoded: I am miserable that I live among hostile people, like staying in the lands of Mesech and Kedar.

verses.kjv: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
verses.decoded: I have lived for a long time among those who hate peace.

verses.kjv: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.decoded: I want peace, but when I try to talk, they choose to fight.

verses.kjv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
verses.decoded: I will look up to the hills—where will my help come from?

verses.kjv: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
verses.decoded: My help comes from the LORD, the Creator of heaven and earth.

verses.kjv: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.decoded: He will not let your foot slip; the one who watches over you will never fall asleep.

verses.kjv: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.decoded: Indeed, the one who protects Israel never slumbers or sleeps.

verses.kjv: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.decoded: The LORD is your protector; He is like a shade at your right side.

verses.kjv: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.decoded: The sun will not harm you during the day, nor the moon at night.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
verses.decoded: The LORD will protect you from all harm and keep your life safe.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.decoded: The LORD will watch over your coming and going now and forever.

verses.kjv: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: I was happy when they said to me, 'Let’s go to the LORD’s temple.'

verses.kjv: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Our feet will stand inside your gates, Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
verses.decoded: Jerusalem is built like a city closely joined together.

verses.kjv: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
verses.decoded: The tribes of the LORD go up there, the tribes of Israel, to worship and thank the LORD’s name.

verses.kjv: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.decoded: There are thrones for judgment there, the thrones of King David’s family.

verses.kjv: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
verses.decoded: Pray for Jerusalem’s peace; those who love you will be successful.

verses.kjv: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.decoded: May there be peace inside your walls and success in your palaces.

verses.kjv: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
verses.decoded: Because of my brothers and friends, I will say, 'Peace be with you.'

verses.kjv: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
verses.decoded: Because of the LORD’s temple, I will do what is best for you.

verses.kjv: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
verses.decoded: I lift my eyes to you, Lord, who lives in heaven.

verses.kjv: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
verses.decoded: Just as servants watch their master's hand and a young woman watches her mistress's hand, we watch the Lord our God, waiting patiently for his mercy.

verses.kjv: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.decoded: Lord, have mercy on us, because we are overwhelmed by scorn and disrespect.

verses.kjv: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
verses.decoded: Our souls are deeply hurt by the mocking of those who are comfortable and the arrogance of the proud.

verses.kjv: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
verses.decoded: If the LORD had not been on our side, let Israel say now,

verses.kjv: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
verses.decoded: If the LORD had not been on our side when people rose up against us,

verses.kjv: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.decoded: They would have quickly destroyed us when their anger burned against us.

verses.kjv: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
verses.decoded: We would have been overwhelmed like by rushing waters flooding over us.

verses.kjv: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.decoded: Powerful and proud waters would have swept over us completely.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD, who did not allow us to become their victims.

verses.kjv: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.decoded: Our lives have escaped like a bird caught in a trap that has been broken; we are free.

verses.kjv: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.decoded: Our help comes from the LORD, the Creator of heaven and earth.

verses.kjv: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
verses.decoded: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken and lasts forever.

verses.kjv: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
verses.decoded: Just as mountains surround Jerusalem, the LORD surrounds his people now and forever.

verses.kjv: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.decoded: The punishment of the wicked will not fall on the righteous, so the righteous won’t be tempted to do wrong.

verses.kjv: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.decoded: LORD, please bless those who are good and honest in their hearts.

verses.kjv: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
verses.decoded: Those who turn away to follow evil will be led away with other wrongdoers, but peace will be upon Israel.

verses.kjv: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.decoded: When the LORD restored Zion's captivity, it felt like a dream to us.

verses.kjv: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
verses.decoded: Our mouths were filled with laughter and our tongues with songs of joy; the nations around us said, 'The LORD has done great things for them.'

verses.kjv: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
verses.decoded: The LORD has done wonderful things for us, and we are very happy.

verses.kjv: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
verses.decoded: LORD, restore our fortunes like the refreshing streams in the southern desert.

verses.kjv: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.decoded: Those who plant their seeds while crying will harvest with joy.

verses.kjv: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.decoded: The one who goes out weeping while carrying valuable seed will surely return with joyful harvest bundles.

verses.kjv: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
verses.decoded: If the Lord does not build the house, those who build it are wasting their time; if the Lord does not protect the city, the guards stay awake for nothing.

verses.kjv: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
verses.decoded: It's pointless to work yourself to exhaustion worrying; God gives rest and peace to those he loves.

verses.kjv: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
verses.decoded: Children are a gift from the Lord; they are a reward from Him.

verses.kjv: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
verses.decoded: Children are like arrows in the hands of a skilled warrior.

verses.kjv: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
verses.decoded: Blessed is the man who has many children; they will bring him honor and confidence when facing challenges.

verses.kjv: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
verses.decoded: Everyone who respects and reveres the Lord and follows His path is truly blessed.

verses.kjv: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.decoded: You will enjoy the results of your hard work; you will be happy, and things will go well for you.

verses.kjv: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
verses.decoded: Your wife will be like a healthy, fruitful vine beside your home, and your children will be like strong olive trees surrounding your table.

verses.kjv: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
verses.decoded: Look, this is the kind of blessing a person receives when they respect and honor the Lord.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.decoded: The Lord will bless you from His holy place, and you will witness the prosperity of Jerusalem throughout your life.

verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children, and peace upon Israel.
verses.decoded: You will live to see your grandchildren, and peace will be upon Israel.

verses.kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
verses.decoded: Many times they have oppressed me since I was young, let Israel now declare it.

verses.kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.decoded: They have oppressed me many times since my youth, but they have never defeated me.

verses.kjv: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
verses.decoded: Like farmers plowing a field, they have harshly beaten me, leaving deep marks on my back.

verses.kjv: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.decoded: The LORD is just; He has broken the power of the wicked.

verses.kjv: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
verses.decoded: May everyone who hates Zion be ashamed and turned away.

verses.kjv: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
verses.decoded: May they be like grass on the rooftops that dries up before it fully grows.

verses.kjv: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
verses.decoded: Grass that the reaper does not gather, nor the one who bundles grain holds close.

verses.kjv: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Passersby do not even say, 'May the LORD bless you'; no one blesses them in the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
verses.decoded: From the deepest troubles, I have called out to you, Lord.

verses.kjv: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.decoded: Lord, please listen to me; pay close attention to my prayers.

verses.kjv: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
verses.decoded: If you, Lord, kept a record of sins, who could ever survive?

verses.kjv: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verses.decoded: But you offer forgiveness, so people can respect and revere you.

verses.kjv: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.decoded: I patiently wait for the Lord; my soul waits, and I put my hope in his promises.

verses.kjv: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
verses.decoded: My soul waits for the Lord more eagerly than those who watch for the dawn.

verses.kjv: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.decoded: Israel, put your hope in the Lord, because he is merciful and offers abundant redemption.

verses.kjv: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.decoded: He will save Israel by forgiving all their sins.

verses.kjv: Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
verses.decoded: Lord, I am not proud or arrogant, and I do not concern myself with things beyond my understanding.

verses.kjv: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
verses.decoded: I have calmed and settled my soul, like a young child who has stopped depending on its mother.

verses.kjv: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
verses.decoded: May Israel put their hope in the Lord now and forever.

verses.kjv: Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:
verses.decoded: A song of ascent. Lord, remember David and all the hardships he endured.

verses.kjv: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
verses.decoded: How he made a solemn oath to the Lord, the powerful God of Jacob;

verses.kjv: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.decoded: I will not enter my own house or lie down to sleep;

verses.kjv: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
verses.decoded: I will not let my eyes close or my eyelids rest,

verses.kjv: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
verses.decoded: Until I find a place for the Lord, a dwelling for the powerful God of Jacob.

verses.kjv: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
verses.decoded: We heard about it in Ephrathah; we discovered it in the nearby forests.

verses.kjv: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
verses.decoded: We will enter his dwelling places and worship at his footstool.

verses.kjv: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
verses.decoded: Rise up, Lord, and come to your resting place, along with the ark that symbolizes your power.

verses.kjv: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
verses.decoded: May your priests be dressed in righteousness, and may your faithful people rejoice loudly.

verses.kjv: For thy servant David’s sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
verses.decoded: For the sake of your servant David, do not reject your chosen king.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.decoded: The Lord has made a true oath to David and will not break it: one of your descendants will sit on your throne.

verses.kjv: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
verses.decoded: If your descendants obey my covenant and follow my teachings, their children will rule on your throne forever.

verses.kjv: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
verses.decoded: The Lord has chosen Zion and desires it as his permanent home.

verses.kjv: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.decoded: This is my eternal resting place; here I will live because I have chosen it.

verses.kjv: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.decoded: I will richly bless her food supply and satisfy her needy with bread.

verses.kjv: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.decoded: I will dress her priests in salvation, and her faithful people will shout with joy.

verses.kjv: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
verses.decoded: There I will cause the strength of David to grow; I have set a light for my chosen king.

verses.kjv: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
verses.decoded: I will put shame on his enemies, but his crown will shine brightly.

verses.kjv: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.decoded: Look how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!

verses.kjv: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
verses.decoded: It is like the valuable oil poured on the head, flowing down Aaron’s beard and onto the edges of his robe;

verses.kjv: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
verses.decoded: Like the dew on Mount Hermon and the mountains of Zion, where the LORD has promised blessing and eternal life.

verses.kjv: Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Look, all you servants of the Lord who stand in His house at night, bless the Lord.

verses.kjv: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
verses.decoded: Raise your hands in the holy place and praise the Lord.

verses.kjv: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
verses.decoded: May the Lord, who created heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD! Praise the name of the LORD! You servants of the LORD, praise him!

verses.kjv: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,
verses.decoded: You who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courtyards of our God’s temple,

verses.kjv: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD, for he is good! Sing praises to his name, because it is enjoyable.

verses.kjv: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
verses.decoded: The LORD has chosen Jacob for himself and made Israel his special possession.

verses.kjv: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.decoded: I know that the LORD is great, and our Lord is greater than all other gods.

verses.kjv: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
verses.decoded: Whatever the LORD wants, he does in heaven, on earth, in the seas, and in all the depths.

verses.kjv: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
verses.decoded: He makes the clouds rise from the ends of the earth; he creates lightning for the rain; he brings the wind out of his storehouses.

verses.kjv: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
verses.decoded: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, both humans and animals.

verses.kjv: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
verses.decoded: He sent signs and wonders among you, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his officials.

verses.kjv: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
verses.decoded: He struck down great nations and killed powerful kings;

verses.kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
verses.decoded: Sihon, king of the Amorites, Og, king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;

verses.kjv: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
verses.decoded: He gave their land as an inheritance, a possession to Israel, his people.

verses.kjv: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
verses.decoded: Your name, LORD, lasts forever; your reputation continues through all generations.

verses.kjv: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
verses.decoded: The LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

verses.kjv: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.decoded: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold, crafted by human hands.

verses.kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.decoded: They have mouths but cannot speak; they have eyes but cannot see;

verses.kjv: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.decoded: They have ears but cannot hear; there is no breath at all in their mouths.

verses.kjv: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.decoded: Those who make these idols are like them, and so are all who trust in them.

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD, you people of Israel; praise the LORD, you descendants of Aaron;

verses.kjv: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD, you descendants of Levi; you who respect the LORD, praise the LORD.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD from Zion, his holy mountain in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the LORD because He is good; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the God above all gods; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the Lord above all lords; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the one who alone performs great miracles; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the one who created the heavens with wisdom; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the one who spread the earth over the waters; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the one who made the great lights; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.decoded: The sun to govern the day; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: The moon and stars to govern the night; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the one who struck down Egypt’s firstborn; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.decoded: Who brought Israel out from among them; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: With a strong hand and outstretched arm; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.decoded: Who divided the Red Sea into parts; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.decoded: And made Israel walk through it on dry ground; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: But swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea; His faithful love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the one who guided his people through the desert, because his love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the one who defeated powerful kings, because his love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the one who killed well-known kings, because his love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the one who defeated Sihon, king of the Amorites, because his love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the one who defeated Og, king of Bashan, because his love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.decoded: He gave their land as an inheritance, because his love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: He gave this land as an inheritance to Israel, his servant, because his love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.decoded: He remembered us when we were in trouble, because his love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: He saved us from our enemies, because his love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: He provides food for all living creatures, because his love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the God of heaven, because his love lasts forever.

verses.kjv: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.decoded: By the rivers of Babylon, we sat down and wept as we remembered Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
verses.decoded: We hung our harps on the willow trees nearby.

verses.kjv: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
verses.decoded: Our captors demanded that we sing songs, and those who destroyed us wanted us to entertain them by singing songs from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: How shall we sing the LORD’s song in a strange land?
verses.decoded: How can we sing the Lord’s song in a foreign land?

verses.kjv: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
verses.decoded: If I forget you, Jerusalem, may my right hand lose its skill.

verses.kjv: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
verses.decoded: If I fail to remember you, may my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth; if I do not consider Jerusalem my greatest joy.

verses.kjv: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
verses.decoded: Lord, remember the people of Edom on the day Jerusalem was destroyed; they said, 'Tear it down completely to its very foundation.'

verses.kjv: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
verses.decoded: O Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is the one who repays you as you have treated us.

verses.kjv: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
verses.decoded: Blessed is the one who seizes your infants and smashes them against the rocks.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.decoded: I will wholeheartedly praise you; I will sing praises to you even in the presence of other gods.

verses.kjv: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
verses.decoded: I will worship facing your holy temple and praise your name for your unfailing love and faithfulness, because you have honored your promises above your own reputation.

verses.kjv: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
verses.decoded: When I called out to you, you answered me and gave me inner strength.

verses.kjv: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
verses.decoded: All the rulers of the earth will praise you, Lord, when they hear what you say.

verses.kjv: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.
verses.decoded: They will sing praises as they follow the Lord’s path because the Lord’s glory is great.

verses.kjv: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
verses.decoded: Even though the Lord is exalted, he cares for the humble, but he distances himself from the proud.

verses.kjv: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
verses.decoded: Even when I face difficulties, you will restore me; you will protect me from my enemies and save me with your powerful hand.

verses.kjv: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verses.decoded: The Lord will complete what concerns me; your mercy lasts forever. Do not abandon the work you have made.

verses.kjv: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
verses.decoded: Lord, you have examined me and know everything about me.

verses.kjv: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.decoded: You know when I sit down and when I stand up; you understand my thoughts even from a distance.

verses.kjv: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
verses.decoded: You watch over all my ways, whether I am walking or resting.

verses.kjv: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
verses.decoded: Before I even speak, Lord, you already know what I will say.

verses.kjv: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
verses.decoded: You surround me on every side and have placed your hand of protection on me.

verses.kjv: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
verses.decoded: Your knowledge is amazing and beyond my understanding; it is too great for me to grasp.

verses.kjv: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
verses.decoded: Where can I go to escape your Spirit? Where can I run away from your presence?

verses.kjv: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
verses.decoded: If I go up to heaven, you are there; if I lie down in the depths, you are there too.

verses.kjv: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.decoded: If I fly with the morning light and live at the farthest edges of the sea,

verses.kjv: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.decoded: Even there, your hand will guide me and hold me securely.

verses.kjv: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
verses.decoded: If I say, 'Darkness will hide me,' even the night will shine around me.

verses.kjv: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
verses.decoded: But darkness is not dark to you; night shines as brightly as day, for darkness and light are the same to you.

verses.kjv: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.
verses.decoded: You created my innermost being and formed me in my mother's womb.

verses.kjv: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.decoded: I praise you because I am wonderfully made; your works are amazing, and I know that very well.

verses.kjv: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.decoded: You saw my body being formed in secret, carefully made deep inside the earth.

verses.kjv: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
verses.decoded: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my parts were recorded in your book before any of them existed.

verses.kjv: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
verses.decoded: God, your thoughts about me are so valuable; their total number is beyond measure!

verses.kjv: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
verses.decoded: If I tried to count them, they would be more than the grains of sand; when I wake up, you are still with me.

verses.kjv: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
verses.decoded: Surely, God, you will destroy the wicked; so stay away from me, you violent people.

verses.kjv: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
verses.decoded: They speak evil against you, and your enemies misuse your name.

verses.kjv: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
verses.decoded: Do I not hate those who hate you, Lord? Am I not upset with those who oppose you?

verses.kjv: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
verses.decoded: I hate them completely and consider them my enemies.

verses.kjv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verses.decoded: Examine me, God, and understand my heart; test me and know what I am thinking.

verses.kjv: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.decoded: See if there is any harmful way in me, and guide me on the eternal path.

verses.kjv: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
verses.decoded: Lord, save me from evil people; protect me from those who use violence.

verses.kjv: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
verses.decoded: They plan evil in their hearts and constantly come together to fight.

verses.kjv: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.
verses.decoded: Their words are as sharp as snakes’ fangs; poison is under their lips. Pause and think about this.

verses.kjv: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
verses.decoded: Lord, protect me from wicked people and violent men who plan to ruin my path.

verses.kjv: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
verses.decoded: Proud people have set traps and nets to catch me along the road. Pause and think about this.

verses.kjv: I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
verses.decoded: I said to the Lord, 'You are my God; please listen to my prayers, Lord.'
