verses.kjv: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.decoded: God, the Lord, the source of my salvation, you have protected me during times of conflict.

verses.kjv: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.decoded: Lord, do not allow the wicked to succeed in their plans or fulfill their desires, so they won’t become proud. Pause and think about this.

verses.kjv: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.decoded: Let those who surround me be caught by the harm caused by their own words.

verses.kjv: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
verses.decoded: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into fire and deep pits so they never rise again.

verses.kjv: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.decoded: Do not let a wicked person gain power on earth; evil will chase and defeat violent people.

verses.kjv: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
verses.decoded: I am confident that the Lord defends the cause of those who suffer and protects the rights of the poor.

verses.kjv: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
verses.decoded: The righteous will surely thank you, Lord; those who live rightly will live in your presence.

verses.kjv: Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
verses.decoded: Lord, I call out to you; please hurry to help me. Listen carefully when I pray to you.

verses.kjv: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
verses.decoded: May my prayer rise to you like sweet incense, and may my raised hands be like the evening offering.

verses.kjv: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
verses.decoded: Lord, guard my words; control what I say.

verses.kjv: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.decoded: Do not let me desire to do evil or join those who commit wrongdoing, and don’t let me enjoy their pleasures.

verses.kjv: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
verses.decoded: If a good person corrects me, it will be a kindness; their rebuke will be like healing oil and won’t harm me. Even then, I will pray for them when they face trouble.

verses.kjv: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
verses.decoded: When their leaders fall in hard places, they will listen to my words because they are pleasant.

verses.kjv: Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
verses.decoded: Our bones lie scattered at the entrance of the grave, like pieces of wood chopped on the ground.

verses.kjv: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
verses.decoded: But I look to you, Lord God; I trust in you. Don’t abandon me or leave me helpless.

verses.kjv: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
verses.decoded: Protect me from the traps they have set and the schemes of those who do evil.

verses.kjv: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
verses.decoded: Let the wicked be caught in their own traps, but let me escape safely.

verses.kjv: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
verses.decoded: A wise song of David, a prayer he made when he was hiding in a cave: I called out to the LORD loudly; I earnestly prayed to the LORD.

verses.kjv: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
verses.decoded: I told Him all my problems and shared my troubles openly.

verses.kjv: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
verses.decoded: When I felt completely crushed inside, You understood the path I was taking. Secret traps were set for me along the way.

verses.kjv: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
verses.decoded: I looked to my right side and saw no one who recognized me; no safe place was left, and no one cared about my life.

verses.kjv: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
verses.decoded: I called out to You, LORD, saying, You are my safe place and my share among those who are alive.

verses.kjv: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.decoded: Listen to my prayer because I am in deep trouble; save me from those who chase me, for they are more powerful than I am.

verses.kjv: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
verses.decoded: Free me from this prison so I can praise Your name; good people will surround me because You will bless me generously.

verses.kjv: Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
verses.decoded: Lord, listen to my prayer and pay attention to my requests. Answer me because you are faithful and just.

verses.kjv: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.decoded: Do not judge me, your servant, because no one can be declared innocent in your eyes.

verses.kjv: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
verses.decoded: My enemy is attacking me relentlessly; they have brought me down and made me feel like I am living in darkness, as if I were dead.

verses.kjv: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
verses.decoded: Because of this, my spirit is crushed and my heart feels empty and hopeless.

verses.kjv: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
verses.decoded: I think back on past times and reflect on all the things you have done; I consider the amazing things you have created.

verses.kjv: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
verses.decoded: I reach out to you; my soul longs for you like a dry land longs for rain. Pause and reflect.

verses.kjv: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
verses.decoded: Lord, answer me quickly because my spirit is weak. Don’t turn away from me, or I will be like those who descend into the grave.

verses.kjv: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.decoded: Let me experience your faithful love early each day, because I trust you. Show me the right path to follow, as I put my hope in you.

verses.kjv: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
verses.decoded: Save me from my enemies, Lord. I run to you for protection and safety.

verses.kjv: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
verses.decoded: Show me how to follow your will because you are my God. Your Spirit is good; guide me to live rightly.

verses.kjv: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name’s sake: for thy righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.decoded: Revive me, Lord, for the sake of your name. Because you are righteous, rescue me from my distress.

verses.kjv: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
verses.decoded: Because of your mercy, defeat my enemies and destroy those who harm me, for I am your servant.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD, my strength, who trains my hands for battle and my fingers for fighting.

verses.kjv: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
verses.decoded: He is my kindness, my strong refuge, my safe tower, my rescuer, my shield, and the one I trust; he makes my people submit to me.

verses.kjv: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
verses.decoded: LORD, what is human beings that you notice them? What are people that you care about them?

verses.kjv: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.decoded: People are like a breath or a fleeting shadow; their lives quickly disappear.

verses.kjv: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.decoded: LORD, bend down the skies and come near; touch the mountains so they smoke.

verses.kjv: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
verses.decoded: Send out lightning to scatter the enemies; shoot your arrows to destroy them.

verses.kjv: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
verses.decoded: Reach down your hand from above; rescue me and save me from overwhelming dangers, from the control of hostile people.

verses.kjv: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.decoded: Their words are worthless lies, and their right hand is full of deceit.

verses.kjv: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.decoded: I will sing a new song to you, God; I will praise you with a harp and a ten-stringed instrument.

verses.kjv: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.decoded: He gives victory to kings and saved David, his servant, from deadly swords.

verses.kjv: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
verses.decoded: Rescue me and save me from hostile people whose words are lies and whose right hands are deceitful.

verses.kjv: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
verses.decoded: May our sons grow strong and healthy like young plants; may our daughters be like polished stones, beautifully shaped like those in a palace.

verses.kjv: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
verses.decoded: May our barns be full with plenty of grain, and may our sheep produce thousands and tens of thousands in our towns.

verses.kjv: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
verses.decoded: May our oxen be strong and able to work; may there be no theft or violence, and no complaints in our streets.

verses.kjv: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.
verses.decoded: Blessed is the nation whose people live like this; truly blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD.

verses.kjv: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: I will praise you, my God and King, and I will bless your name forever.

verses.kjv: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: Every day I will bless you and praise your name forever.

verses.kjv: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
verses.decoded: The LORD is great and worthy of much praise; his greatness cannot be measured or understood.

verses.kjv: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
verses.decoded: Each generation will praise your works and tell the next about your mighty deeds.

verses.kjv: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
verses.decoded: I will talk about the glorious honor of your majesty and your amazing deeds.

verses.kjv: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
verses.decoded: People will speak of the power of your awesome deeds, and I will proclaim your greatness.

verses.kjv: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
verses.decoded: They will joyfully remember your great kindness and sing about your righteousness.

verses.kjv: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
verses.decoded: The LORD is gracious and full of compassion, patient, and very merciful.

verses.kjv: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.decoded: The LORD is good to everyone, and his tender mercy extends over all he has made.

verses.kjv: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.
verses.decoded: All your creations will praise you, LORD, and your faithful followers will bless you.

verses.kjv: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
verses.decoded: They will speak about the glory of your kingdom and talk about your power.

verses.kjv: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
verses.decoded: To make known to all people your mighty deeds and the glorious majesty of your kingdom.

verses.kjv: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
verses.decoded: Your kingdom is eternal, and your rule lasts through all generations.

verses.kjv: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
verses.decoded: The LORD supports everyone who falls and lifts up those who are bowed down.

verses.kjv: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
verses.decoded: Everyone looks to you, and you give them their food at the right time.

verses.kjv: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.decoded: You open your hand and satisfy the needs of every living creature.

verses.kjv: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
verses.decoded: The LORD is just in everything he does and kind in all his actions.

verses.kjv: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
verses.decoded: The LORD is close to everyone who sincerely calls on him.

verses.kjv: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.decoded: He will grant the wishes of those who respect him; he listens to their prayers and rescues them.

verses.kjv: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
verses.decoded: The LORD protects everyone who loves him, but he will bring down all who do evil.

verses.kjv: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: I will always praise the LORD, and may all people honor his holy name forever.

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul!

verses.kjv: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
verses.decoded: As long as I live, I will praise the LORD; I will sing praises to my God while I have breath.

verses.kjv: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
verses.decoded: Do not put your trust in rulers or in mere humans, who cannot save you.

verses.kjv: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.decoded: When their breath leaves them, they return to the earth, and on that day their plans come to nothing.

verses.kjv: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:
verses.decoded: Blessed is the one who has the God of Jacob as their helper, whose hope is in the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:
verses.decoded: He is the Creator of heaven, earth, the sea, and everything in them; He always remains faithful and true.

verses.kjv: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:
verses.decoded: He defends the oppressed, gives food to the hungry, and frees those who are imprisoned.

verses.kjv: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:
verses.decoded: The LORD gives sight to the blind, lifts up those who are bowed down, and loves those who live right.

verses.kjv: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
verses.decoded: The LORD watches over foreigners, supports orphans and widows, but causes the plans of the wicked to fail.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: The LORD will reign forever—your God, O Zion—through all generations. Praise the LORD!

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD! It is good to sing praises to our God; it is enjoyable and fitting to give Him praise.

verses.kjv: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.decoded: The LORD strengthens Jerusalem and brings together the scattered people of Israel.

verses.kjv: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
verses.decoded: He heals those who are brokenhearted and comforts those who are hurting.

verses.kjv: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
verses.decoded: He counts the stars and calls each one by name.

verses.kjv: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
verses.decoded: Our Lord is great and powerful; His understanding has no limit.

verses.kjv: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
verses.decoded: The LORD raises up those who are humble but brings the wicked down.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
verses.decoded: Sing to the LORD with thankfulness; praise our God with music.

verses.kjv: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.decoded: He covers the sky with clouds, sends rain to the earth, and makes grass grow on the mountains.

verses.kjv: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
verses.decoded: He provides food for the animals and for the young ravens when they call out.

verses.kjv: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.decoded: He does not take pleasure in a horse’s strength or in a man’s speed.

verses.kjv: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
verses.decoded: The LORD delights in those who respect Him and trust in His unfailing love.

verses.kjv: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem; praise your God, Zion.

verses.kjv: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.decoded: He has made your city gates strong and has blessed your children living inside you.

verses.kjv: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.decoded: He gives peace to your borders and fills you with the best wheat.

verses.kjv: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
verses.decoded: He sends His command to the earth; His word moves quickly.

verses.kjv: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
verses.decoded: He makes snow fall like soft wool and spreads frost like ashes.

verses.kjv: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
verses.decoded: He sends out ice in small pieces; who can survive His intense cold?

verses.kjv: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.decoded: He sends His command and the ice melts; He blows the wind and the waters flow.

verses.kjv: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
verses.decoded: He reveals His teachings and laws to Jacob, His rules and decisions to Israel.

verses.kjv: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: He has not treated any other nation this way; they do not know His laws. Praise the LORD!

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the skies; praise Him in the highest places.

verses.kjv: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
verses.decoded: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His heavenly armies.

verses.kjv: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
verses.decoded: Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, all shining stars.

verses.kjv: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
verses.decoded: Praise Him, highest heavens, and the waters above the skies.

verses.kjv: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.decoded: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for He commanded and they came into existence.

verses.kjv: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
verses.decoded: He established them forever; His command will never be revoked.

verses.kjv: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD from the earth—sea creatures and all the deep oceans.

verses.kjv: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
verses.decoded: Fire, hail, snow, mist, and stormy winds that obey His commands, praise Him.

verses.kjv: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
verses.decoded: Mountains and hills; all fruit-bearing trees and mighty cedars, praise Him.

verses.kjv: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
verses.decoded: Wild animals and livestock; small creatures and birds in flight, praise Him.

verses.kjv: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
verses.decoded: Kings of the earth and all people; rulers and judges everywhere, praise Him.

verses.kjv: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
verses.decoded: Young men and women; old men and children, all praise the LORD.

verses.kjv: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
verses.decoded: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name is supreme; His glory surpasses earth and sky.

verses.kjv: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: He raises the power of His people, the praise of all His faithful ones—especially the children of Israel, His close people. Praise the LORD!

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD. Sing a new song to the LORD and praise Him among His holy people.

verses.kjv: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.decoded: Let Israel be glad in their Creator; let the people of Zion celebrate their King.

verses.kjv: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.decoded: Let them praise His name with dancing; sing praises to Him with tambourines and harps.

verses.kjv: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.decoded: The LORD delights in His people and will honor the humble by giving them salvation.

verses.kjv: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.decoded: Let God’s people rejoice in His glory and sing loudly even in their private moments.

verses.kjv: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand;
verses.decoded: May God’s praises always be on their lips, and may they be ready to fight with the double-edged sword in their hands.

verses.kjv: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
verses.decoded: To carry out justice against the nations and punish the peoples.

verses.kjv: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.decoded: To imprison their kings with chains and their leaders with iron shackles.

verses.kjv: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: To carry out the written judgment against them—this is the honor given to all God’s holy people. Praise the LORD!

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD! Praise God in His holy place; praise Him in the heavens where His power is displayed.

verses.kjv: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.decoded: Praise Him for the great things He has done; praise Him because of His supreme greatness.

verses.kjv: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.decoded: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet; praise Him with the psaltery and harp.

verses.kjv: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
verses.decoded: Praise Him with the timbrel and dancing; praise Him with stringed instruments and flutes.

verses.kjv: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
verses.decoded: Praise Him with loud cymbals; praise Him with cymbals that ring out loudly.

verses.kjv: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD!
